titles.title: 4th and Loud
titles.description: For Gene Simmons, the fact one of the world's biggest media markets had not been the home of a pro football franchise since 1995 presented a business opportunity he couldn't ignore. So Simmons -- whose entrepreneurial instincts helped build Kiss into one of the world's most successful rock 'n' roll bands -- created the LA KISS of the Arena Football League, and "4th and Loud" chronicles that process along with the team's inaugural season. The team's co-owners include Kiss frontman and co-founder Paul Stanley, Kiss manager Doc McGhee, managing partner and owner Brett Bouchy, and president and owner Schuyler Hoversten. All appear on the series, as well as the squad's star players.

Their mother's sickness also recalls the traumatic loss of their brother Joseph when they were children.

Desperate to salvage his relationship -- and more importantly -- his sex life -- Malcolm hires a coterie of paranormal specialists, which includes a priest and ghostbusters, to banish the unwelcome intruder from Kisha's body.

He has a new girlfriend named Megan (Jaime Pressly), and they and Megan's children are moving into their dream home. Soon afterward, Malcolm is once again plagued by supernatural shenanigans -- only this time, it's not just the house that's haunted. A demon has attached itself to Malcolm, and shows no signs of letting go.

Whether they're trying to make the perfect roasted chicken with crispy skin or examining the science behind cooking with baking powder, team members try to offer unbiased and useful tips that can save viewers money, time and effort in their own kitchens. The basic team is frequently joined by other test cooks, as well as blind-taste judges.

titles.title: American Genius
titles.description: From the producers of the multiple-award-winning miniseries "The Men Who Built America," National Geographic Channel chronicles competitions in innovation that pit history's brightest minds in the race to lay claim to the future. For them, the greatest challenge wasn't beating the odds -- it was beating their adversaries. From Steve Jobs vs. Bill Gates to William Hurst vs. Joseph Pulitzer, each hourlong episode focuses on a specific rivalry, delving into fierce power struggles, deceit, fluke timing and raw ambition out of which great ideas turned into reality. The conflicts play out through re-enactments that feature interviews with modern-day visionaries like Bill Nye, Steve Wozniak, Jack Welch, Steve Wynn and Michio Kaku.

When not working, the ladies are one another's best friends while facing their own relationships, upcoming nuptials and their overall lives as young women.

Can Slade turn his life around and become a better person before it's too late?

When David discovers the horrible truth, he contemplates committing suicide before the next full moon causes him to transform from man to murderous beast.

titles.title: Anger Management
titles.description: Following his tumultuous, and highly publicized, departure from hit sitcom "Two and a Half Men," Charlie Sheen returns to series television in this comedy loosely based on the 2003 Adam Sandler film "Anger Management." Sheen stars as Charlie, a former professional baseball player whose career was ended by an injury caused by his anger issues. Charlie went back to school after his playing career ended and now works as a therapist who specializes in anger management. In addition to weekly sessions with his primary group of patients, Charlie does pro bono counseling for a group of inmates at a state prison. Even though he now helps others control their anger problems, Charlie continues to battle his own anger issues. Complicating his life are his relationships with his own therapist -- his ex-wife, whose positive outlook frustrates Charlie -- and his teenage daughter, who has obsessive-compulsive disorder.

titles.description: Homicide detectives David Quinn and Vince Velazquez are veterans of the Atlanta Police Department. They are sitting down to share some of the grittiest stories of their careers. Quinn and Velazquez recall these cases and talk about their personal experiences while solving the crimes. They have tackled hundreds of cold cases together, with anything from murder to everyday crime, and they try to bring these criminals to justice and give peace to the victims' families. "Through each compelling case, audiences will feel like what they are watching unfold is happening in real time," says Tia A. Smith, the senior director of original programming and production.

episodes.title: Tropical Family Resort
episodes.description: Tammy and Sam are so busy, their backyard has fallen into disrepair and their 2 kids never use it. Brian and Sarah bring this yard back to life, and then some, with a new dining and lounge area and a fully functional pool house.

episodes.title: Neighborhood Party House

titles.title: Baggage
titles.description: Contestants on this dating game show don't want to hear the elimination line "I'm sorry, but you have too much baggage." How much is acceptable among three contestants in each episode is determined by the "dater," who hears the candidates' intimate secrets and hidden flaws, as well as their attempts to deflect these traits by describing their positive attributes. After two elimination rounds leave one remaining contestant, it's the dater's turn to reveal his or her own baggage ... and then the contestant decides to go forward with the date or not. Jerry Springer hosts.

With a wham! and a pow! and a zip! ... our heroes just might win.

Robert Capa and his platoon of 2nd Infantry Division soldiers are ordered to hold a vital road junction against the German aggressors. Somehow, Capa and his men must find the strength to stand against their enemy in the fight known as "The Battle of the Bulge."

If they break a rule, the collar explodes. Their mission: kill each other and be the last one standing. The last survivor is allowed to leave the island. If there is more than one survivor, the collars explode and kill them all.

When she encounters charming publisher Shepherd Henderson (James Stewart), she decides to make him hers by casting a love spell. Gillian takes added pleasure in doing so because Henderson is engaged to her old college rival (Janice Rule). However, Gillian finds herself actually falling for Shepherd, which poses a problem: She will lose her powers if she falls in love.

In retribution, Union major and old friend Thomas Crail (Dana Andrews) must follow orders by burning down their home and arresting Shirley's brother (John Shepperd). Incensed, Shirley springs Starr from jail and joins his rebels. But after marrying Starr, Shirley discovers the outlaw life is not what she thought it would be.

Buck Roberts (Buck Jones) poses as a former criminal, Tim McCall (Tim McCoy) impersonates a cattle buyer and Sandy Hopkins (Raymond Hatton) assumes the role of a saloon handyman. They quietly gather information and use it to close in on the dastardly outlaw.

It's 1715, and as Flint fights for the survival of New Providence Island -- a debauched paradise teeming with pirates, prostitutes, thieves and fortune seekers -- in the wake of threats from British and Spanish forces, he aligns himself with Eleanor Guthrie, daughter of the local kingpin, to hunt the ultimate prize and ensure his people's survival. But standing in the way are rival captains, Eleanor's intrusive father, and perhaps the bigger obstacle of all: John Silver, a young, fast-talking, authority-flouting sailor recently added to Flint's crew.

titles.description: Ben Cartwright is the patriarch of an all-male Nevada ranching family. Set during and after the Civil War, "Bonanza" is the story of life on the family's thousand-acre spread, known as the Ponderosa, near Virginia City. Ben has his three sons, each with a different (and deceased) mother. Serious eldest son Adam hopes to follow in his father's footsteps; middle son Hoss is a gentle giant -- physically strong, but sometimes naive; and youngest son Little Joe is the most impetuous and romantic of the offspring.

titles.title: Brockmire
titles.description: Hank Azaria and Amanda Peet co-star in "Brockmire," a half-hour comedy series that began years ago as a viral short video on the Funny or Die website. The series centers on the fall of Jim Brockmire, a once-famed major league baseball announcer who suffers an embarrassing on-air meltdown caused by his wife's serial infidelity, leading to a decade away from the booth. Older and presumably wiser, Brockmire attempts to reclaim his career, reputation and love life by returning behind the mic, but the setting -- a broken-down rust belt town, home of the minor league's Morristown Frackers -- is not quite what he envisioned. Strong-willed, hard-drinking owner Julia James has a complicated relationship with Brockmire, while whiz-kid intern Charles is simultaneously entertained by and terrified of the new announcer.

titles.title: Building to the Sky
titles.description: Skyscrapers have dominated city landscapes for more than 100 years. Since debuting as 10-story buildings in the late 19th century, these tall towers have constantly evolved as architects and structural engineers pushed the boundaries of what's possible. This series unlocks the inner workings of these goliaths, spotlighting what cities such as Chicago, London, Melbourne and Tokyo are doing to transform their skylines with designs that seem to defy gravity. Each episode gives viewers exclusive looks at high-rises, among them Chicago's 82-story Aqua; the 1,500-feet-tall Petronas Twin Towers in Kuala Lumpur; the landmark Jin Mao Tower in Shanghai; and the Burj Khalifa in Dubai, the world's tallest skyscraper.

titles.title: Bukowski: Born Into This

Using interviews with Bukowski and other footage, filmmaker John Dullaghan tells the story of a man who struggles to make a living while he writes from the heart. Then, after editor John Martin of Black Sparrow Press discovers Bukowski, his work becomes much more widely read. The film also includes comments from famous fans Bono, Sean Penn and Harry Dean Stanton.

titles.title: Bunk
titles.description: Offbeat games and bizarre challenges are the foundation for the on-the-spot comedy created in this new breed of game show. The contestants, a roster of comedians that includes Alex Borstein, Ben Garant, Thomas Lennon, Bobby Moynihan, Kumail Nanjiani and Nicole Parker, play games such as "Top This Lie," where they must out-fib host Kurt Braunohler in a rapid-fire succession of untruths, and "Wordy and the Tramp," where they provide answers to a series of disconnected questions while they and the host bounce on trampolines. The players are also challenged to -- among many other wacky tasks -- invent new sins, break harsh news to children, compose and sing original songs about grandmothers, and decide what mankind will evolve into next.

Pharaoh Coffin (George Coulouris) is trying to block California from statehood. But Trumbo's never taken kindly to men in power, and he's soon dangerously at odds with Coffin.

titles.title: Camilla: My Darling Wife, Our Future Queen
titles.description: A look back at Camilla's tumultuous journey toward becoming the Duchess of Cornwall; insight into the challenges that she must face as Prince Charles's wife and the future queen.

titles.title: Camp
titles.description: At Camp Ovation, kids of all ages spend their summer expressing themselves through dance, music and theater. Vlad (Daniel Letterle) is a singer-songwriter and first-time camper caught between talented but insecure Ellen (Joanna Chilcoat) and provocative Jill (Alana Allen). Besides romance, the campers grapple with complicated issues, including sexual identity, self-respect and parental pressure, as they grow closer together and prove their talents to the bitter camp director (Don Dixon).

titles.title: Camp Dread
titles.description: Cast members (Felissa Rose, Brian Gallagher) on a new reality-TV show soon learn that a devious filmmaker (Eric Roberts) has tricked them into a very real fight for their lives.

titles.title: Camp Raiders
titles.description: Kruger National Park; wildlife create havoc and provide amusement while rummaging through visitors' campsites.

titles.title: Camp X-Ray
titles.description: A female guard at Guantánamo Bay forms an unlikely friendship with one of the facility's longtime detainees.

titles.title: Can't Take It Back
titles.description: Two teenage girls bring a dark curse upon themselves when they leave hateful comments on a dead classmate's Facebook page.

titles.title: Canal Street
titles.description: A Chicago lawyer embraces his undying faith when his teenage son is accused of murdering a classmate.

titles.title: Candy Cane Christmas
titles.description: A woman searches for a new tradition to lift her holiday spirits when her neighbors decide to skip the annual Christmas decoration festivities.

titles.title: Cannabis: Through the Ages
titles.description: Exploring the role of cannabis in the evolution of civilizations around the globe as it has been applied in more than 30,000 products ranging in use from war and exploration to medicine and intoxication.

titles.title: Cannibal Comedian
titles.description: Fed up with his lack of ambition, a psychopathic cannibal tries his hand at stand-up comedy in an attempt to satisfy his appetite for normalcy.

titles.title: Cannibal! The Musical
titles.description: A man (Juan Schwartz) convicted of cannibalism tells a reporter his story, complete with singing and dancing.

titles.title: Capricorn One
titles.description: Three astronauts (James Brolin, Sam Waterston, O.J. Simpson) are about to launch into space on the first mission to Mars. But when a mechanical failure surfaces that would kill the three men, NASA removes them from the Capricorn One capsule. To prevent a public outcry, NASA launches the capsule unmanned and requires the astronauts to film fake mission footage in a studio. However, the plan is compromised when an ambitious journalist (Elliott Gould) discovers the conspiracy.

titles.title: Captain Kidd
titles.description: British pirate William Kidd captures Adm. Blayne's treasure ship and hides the bounty in a cave. Three years later, Kidd, posing as a sea captain, offers his services to the king as an escort ship. Seeking a social position, Kidd also negotiates for Blayne's title and lands, if he can prove Blayne was associated with piracy. On his mission, Kidd is unaware that Blayne's son, Adam (also Scott), is among the crew, determined to clear his father's name.

titles.title: Car Crews With Supercar Blondie
titles.description: Alexandra Hirschi, aka Supercar Blondie, explores alternative car cultures across the United States.

episodes.title: Los Angeles
episodes.description: Alexandra Hirschi, aka Supercar Blondie, explores alternative car cultures across the United States.

episodes.title: Houston
episodes.description: Given special access to a $2 million exclusive McLaren Senna, Supercar Blondie digs under the surface to uncover gang feuds in the SLAB (Slow, Low and Bangin') community and meets up with legendary hip hop artists Slim Thug and Paul Wall.

episodes.title: Las Vegas
episodes.description: Supercar Blondie arrives in Las Vegas in a $1 million Lamborghini SVJ roadster; taken under the wing of Patrick, founder of the Junkyard Pirates, Alex is brought into the rat rod world, home to American mavericks and outsiders.

episodes.title: Miami
episodes.description: In Miami, Supercar Blondie gets the keys to a $5 million Pagani Huayra L'Ultimo as she explores the sub-culture of lowriders with the seal of approval from Horacio Pagani himself.

episodes.title: Detroit
episodes.description: Supercar Blondie arrives in Motor City in the dead of winter, but she is given access to a new $500 thousand Ford GT, which raises her spirits; her goal is to learn more about muscle cars and her journey takes her in different directions.

episodes.title: New York
episodes.description: Supercar Blondie hits New York City in a $4 million Lamborghini Centenario; she is on a quest to track down the players in the underground drift driving scene and to visit the exclusive Manhattan Motor Club.

titles.title: Cardi B: The Hustle
titles.description: Cardi B is one of the most famous artists of the last decade. Despite being a "regula degula schmegula" girl from the Bronx, she became one of the most influential female artists of all time. She knew if she wanted to reach her dreams, she would have to work... Hard. On the streets, there's a fine line between wrong and right, good and bad. Her journey to the top, although successful, isn't seen as ideal. But she isn't ashamed of it. She started from the bottom and hustled her way to the top.

titles.title: Carnage Park
titles.description: A psychotic sniper (Pat Healy) terrorizes a bank robber (James Landry Hébert) and his hostage (Ashley Bell) in the California desert.

titles.title: Carnival of Souls
titles.description: Mary Henry ends up the sole survivor of a fatal car accident through mysterious circumstances. Trying to put the incident behind her, she moves to Utah and takes a job as a church organist. But her fresh start is interrupted by visions of a fiendish man. As the visions begin to occur more frequently, Mary finds herself drawn to the deserted carnival on the outskirts of town. The strangely alluring carnival may hold the secret to her tragic past.

titles.title: Carolina's Calling
titles.description: Two engineers cause an explosion so forceful that it demolishes their lab and sends a blast into space, striking an unsuspecting alien ship. The ship plummets from the sky and lands in a remote area of South Carolina, forcing him to find a way home.

titles.title: Carrie Underwood: Country Idol
titles.description: Carrie Underwood, winner of 2005's "American Idol," and her fast track to stardom.

titles.title: Cashback
titles.description: Would-be artist Ben (Sean Biggerstaff) realizes he has an extraordinary way of dealing with the tedium of his dead-end job stocking shelves at a store - he has acquired the ability to halt time and explore the world while the rest of the earth's population remains frozen in place. Ben's unusual talent helps him forget about a nasty breakup with his ex-girlfriend Suzy (Michelle Ryan), but he begins to stop time so often that he may miss out on a new romance with his coworker Sharon (Emilia Fox).

titles.title: Casino Jack and the United States of Money
titles.description: This documentary tracks the high life and eventual downfall of wealthy lobbyist and businessman Jack Abramoff, who was convicted of conspiracy and fraud, among other charges, in a corruption scandal during the George W. Bush administration. The film details Abramoff's decadent and lavish lifestyle and reveals the shady dealings that led to his getting arrested, which ultimately resulted in a prison sentence for him and tarnished reputations for others.

titles.title: Castle Freak
titles.description: Terror strikes when a blind woman and her friends travel to a mysterious Albanian castle that harbors dark secrets.

titles.title: Castle of the Creeping Flesh
titles.description: A mad scientist tries to revive his dead daughter by an operation, but there are certain body parts he needs that he can't get. His problem is solved when a group of drunken partygoers stumble into his castle.

titles.title: Cat Ballou
titles.description: When hired gun Tim Strawn (Lee Marvin) kills her rancher father, Cat Ballou (Jane Fonda) becomes an outlaw set on vengeance. Enlisting the help of washed-up gunslinger Kid Shelleen (also Marvin) as well as the handsome bandit Clay Boone (Michael Callan), Cat strikes back at the land-development company that employed Strawn, and eventually targets the assassin himself. Adding to the lively comedic mood of the film are narrative song performances by Nat King Cole and Stubby Kaye.

titles.title: Caught in Providence
titles.description: Real people with real cases enter Providence Municipal Court to stand before Chief Municipal Court Judge Frank Caprio. Caprio hears cases involving traffic, parking, and arraignments for criminal offenses. There's always a bit of fun when the cameras are rolling, but Caprio makes it clear that he is there to do his job. Judge Frank Caprio is the Chief Municipal Judge in Providence, R.I. and former Chairman of the Rhode Island Board of Governors. He was appointed in 1985 and has been reappointed six times.

titles.title: Cemetery Man
titles.description: Something is causing the dead to rise from their graves as flesh-eating zombies, and cemetery custodian Francesco Dellamorte grows tired of killing them all for the second time. However, the town politicians won't listen to him, so Francesco is on his own. One day, he falls for a beautiful woman whose husband has recently died -- but their affair is tragically interrupted by zombies, sending Francesco into a tailspin of madness and woe.

titles.title: Centurion
titles.description: In ancient Scotland, the Ninth Legion liberates a Roman officer named Quintus Dias (Michael Fassbender) from his Pict captors. The soldiers are in pursuit of the Pict leader, and Quintus joins their quest. Soon afterward, the Romans' Pict guide betrays them, resulting in the slaughter of all but a handful of men. The Roman survivors try desperately to reach safety, as the indigenous warriors pick them off one by one.

titles.title: Ceremony
titles.description: An obsessed young man (Michael Angarano) crashes the wedding of his older former lover (Uma Thurman) in a misguided attempt to reignite romantic sparks.

titles.title: Certain Women
titles.description: Three strong-willed women (Kristen Stewart, Laura Dern, Michelle Williams) strive to forge their own paths amidst the wide-open plains of the American Northwest: a lawyer who finds herself contending with both office sexism and a hostage situation; a wife and mother whose determination to build her dream home puts her at odds with the men in her life; and a young law student who forms an ambiguous bond with a lonely ranch hand.

titles.title: Cézanne et moi
titles.description: Painter Paul Cézanne (Guillaume Gallienne) develops a strong friendship with writer Émile Zola (Guillaume Canet) in 19th-century France.

titles.title: Chad Daniels: As Is
titles.description: Chad Daniels presents a classic collection of his material. Topics include aggravation at the Detroit airport, bonding over racist family, creating Kardashian family mottos, the issues keeping us from creating an All-Star Team of Americans, and how to conduct a sex talk with a teen.

titles.title: Chadwick Boseman: The King
titles.description: The actor's performances elevated the biographical genre; knowing his life would be short, he devoted it to his work, leaving an everlasting imprint.

titles.title: Chai Lai Angels: Dangerous Flowers
titles.description: Five beautiful operatives must rescue a Japanese karate master's kidnapped daughter.

titles.title: Charles and Camilla: Against All Odds
titles.description: Prince Charles and Camilla, Duchess of Cornwall, who shared a love story fraught with challenges; marrying 35 years after they first met, they became a widely-accepted couple, despite having faced years of scandal and torment by the media.

titles.title: Charlie Says
titles.description: Years after the shocking murders that made the name Charles Manson synonymous with pure evil, the three women who killed for him -- Leslie Van Houten, Patricia Krenwinkel and Susan Atkins -- remain under the spell of the infamous cult leader. Confined to an isolated cellblock, the trio seem destined to live out the rest of their lives under the delusion that their crimes were part of a cosmic plan, until an empathetic graduate student attempts to rehabilitate them.

titles.title: Charlie's Christmas Wish
titles.description: A Christmas wish is granted.

titles.title: Chasing 3000
titles.description: Mickey (Ray Liotta) recounts the cross-country journey of his 15-year-old self (Trevor Morgan) and his young brother, Roger (Rory Culkin), who suffers from muscular dystrophy, to see baseball player Roberto Clemente's 3,000th hit. Their mother (Lauren Holly) doesn't know where they went, so the cops track down the stolen car as they travel to Pittsburgh. Determined to see their idol's historic event, the boys will do anything to get to the baseball stadium, including hitch a ride on a train.

titles.title: Cheyenne
titles.description: Debuting in 1955, "Cheyenne" made history as television's first hourlong western and introduced brawny actor Clint Walker to the world as the jack-of-all-trades loner Cheyenne Bodie. Raised by an American Indian tribe after the death of his parents, the physically imposing Cheyenne calls upon the many skills learned from his past as he wanders the Old West, finding action and adventure at every turn. Like many other productions during the Golden Age of Television, "Cheyenne" had its share of guest stars who would later become famous in their own right, including Rod Taylor, Dennis Hopper, George Kennedy, James Garner, Richard Crenna and Michael Landon.

titles.title: Chuck
titles.description: He was the pride of Bayonne, N.J., a man who went 15 rounds in the ring with Muhammad Ali. But before all of that, Chuck Wepner was a liquor salesman and father with a modest prizefighting career whose life changed overnight when, in 1975, he was chosen to take on Ali in a highly publicized title match. It's the beginning of a wild ride through the exhilarating highs and humbling lows of sudden fame, but what happens when your 15 minutes in the spotlight are up?

titles.title: Churchill & the Queen
titles.description: Historians reflect on the life of Winston Churchill, a skilled strategist and wartime personality, but Churchill's power lay in the way he used his speech and writing to leverage control of the British population.

titles.title: Churchill: The Road to Victory
titles.description: Military veteran and politician Winston Churchill takes office as prime minister in 1940, then leads Britain through trying times and on to victory in World War II.

titles.title: Cimarron
titles.description: In 1889, adventurous lawyer and newspaper editor Yancey Cravat (Richard Dix) convinces his genteel wife, Sabra (Irene Dunne), to join him in the rush to populate Osage, Oklahoma. After they begin to settle into the community, Yancey leaves to go further west. Alone, Sabra inherits his editorial duties and struggles to bring civilization to the rough frontier town. Over a tumultuous 40 years, the couple are repeatedly separated and reunited as Oklahoma makes its long journey to statehood.

Mankiewicz, depicting Cleopatra's manipulation of Julius Caesar and Marc Antony in her ill-fated attempt to save the Egyptian empire. This threesome in one of the most famous and gloriously powerful love triangles ever to be captured on film.

titles.title: Client 9: The Rise and Fall of Eliot Spitzer
titles.description: In the late 2000s, New York Governor Eliot Spitzer is a rising star in the Democratic Party. He's a no-nonsense politician and former attorney general who holds corporations accountable for unethical business practices. But, just one year after he becomes governor, Spitzer resigns after being outed as a frequent client of an expensive and elite escort service. Along with political colleagues and friends, a remorseful Spitzer talks about how his infidelity affected his life and career.

titles.title: Climate Crisis: Extinction
titles.description: Greta Thunberg discusses how the current state of the world is heading towards mass extinction for both animals and humankind if governments fail to take action against the greedy companies leading humanity towards this fate.

titles.title: Cold Blooded: The Clutter Family Murders
titles.description: As chronicled in Truman Capote's landmark book, "In Cold Blood," this docuseries takes a fresh, in-depth look at the legendary murder case of the Clutter family in a small Kansas town in 1959, a crime seemingly without motive. The four-hour event uses firsthand accounts of relatives, family friends, townspeople and law enforcement -- some of whom are speaking publicly about the murder for the first time. There's also never-before-seen details such as original photographs, audio recordings, and documents from the case, as well as memoirs and letters from the murderers and their families. Acclaimed filmmaker Joe Berlinger directs and co-produces.

episodes.title: Farm Family Slain
episodes.description: As chronicled in Truman Capote's landmark book, "In Cold Blood," this docuseries takes a fresh, in-depth look at the legendary murder case of the Clutter family in a small Kansas town in 1959, a crime seemingly without motive. The four-hour event uses firsthand accounts of relatives, family friends, townspeople and law enforcement -- some of whom are speaking publicly about the murder for the first time. There's also never-before-seen details such as original photographs, audio recordings, and documents from the case, as well as memoirs and letters from the murderers and their families. Acclaimed filmmaker Joe Berlinger directs and co-produces.

titles.title: Comedy Bang! Bang!
titles.description: Upon first look, "Comedy Bang! Bang!" is like any late-night talk show... until the guests sit down and the interviews commence. Then it veers off in all sorts of directions, most of which include unfiltered and improvised dialogue. The show is based on host Scott Aukerman's popular podcast of the same name (and most certainly influenced by the Internet mock-talk show "Between Two Ferns With Zach Galifianakis," which Aukerman produced and directed). In each episode, Aukerman reinvents the traditional celebrity interview by engaging his guests in ad-libbed banter, all of which is punctuated by beats from "bandleader" Reggie Watts or, in later episodes, "Weird Al" Yankovic.

titles.title: Comic Book Men
titles.description: AMC dives into the comic book culture with this unscripted series that follows the antics of the "fanboys" in and around Jay and Silent Bob's Secret Stash, a New Jersey comic shop owned by writer-director Kevin Smith. Cameras capture the banter of the shop's employees and its customers as they collectively discover the treasures of the comic collecting world, and the staff -- de-facto leader Walt, shop whipping boy Ming and comic book virtuoso Mike among them -- shares all the details with Smith via a podcast that is woven throughout the series. Smith has been a comics fan since his youth and has written several comic books based on his movies, including "Clerks," as well as story arcs for the legendary "Green Arrow" and "Daredevil" comics.

titles.title: Conan O'Brien Can't Stop
titles.description: In 2009, Conan O'Brien took over for Jay Leno as host of NBC's "The Tonight Show," but, after only seven months on the job, he suddenly found himself unemployed. Embroiled in a legal battle with the network, Conan took his talents on the road for a 32-city comedy show aptly titled "The Legally Prohibited from Being Funny on Television Tour." Filmmaker Rodman Flender was there every step of the way to document the comic's personal struggles during the most tumultuous time of his career.

titles.title: Cook's Country
titles.description: Hosts Bridget Lancaster, Julia Collin Davison and Toni Tipton-Martin offer a practical, no-nonsense and scientific approach to making a wide range of American recipes, from barbecue chicken thighs to Mississippi mud pie to parmesan potatoes. The hosts are joined by test cooks Morgan Bolling, Lawman Johnson, Christie Morrison, Ashley Moore, Bryan Roof and Kelly Song. Episodes include equipment recommendations for the home cook, taste tests and regional recipes such as coastal Georgia paella and mesquite-grilled tacos rasurados.

titles.title: Cutting It: In the ATL
titles.description: The competition among hairstylists in Atlanta is cutthroat, enough so that WE tv deemed it worthy of a reality series. "Cutting It: In the ATL" follows four charismatic, headstrong salon owners as they battle to dominate the A-Town hair game. Maja runs Walk-In Weaves, a chain of quick-service, cost-friendly salons. Her ally, Congo native Mushiya, started The Damn Salon in her kitchen and now caters to high-fashion clients by using several natural styling techniques. Beautii, a veteran in the Atlanta market, is known for making up celebrities such as Grammy winner Regina Bell, Tamika Tiny Harris of "Family Hustle" and Kandi Burruss of "Real Housewives of Atlanta." Dedra combines artistic talents with savvy, aggressive business instincts, which creates a rift in this circle of businesswomen. Dedra's weave expert, LaKenya, befriends the other salon owners as she follows her dream to open her own shop.

titles.title: Dealin' With Idiots
titles.description: A comic looks for inspiration for his next movie among the absurdly competitive parents and coaches involved with his son's youth-baseball league.

titles.title: Dear Dictator
titles.description: When an outcast teen, Tatiana, gets a school assignment to write a letter to a person she admires, she jokingly writes to a foreign dictator named Hector because she likes his fashion sense. Hector takes to the admiration, and the two become unlikely pen pals, however, when Hector has to flee his country during a coup, he seeks refuge in the house of his only remaining friend.

titles.title: Dear Santa
titles.description: The U.S. Postal Service makes it possible for the public to safely adopt letters to Santa Claus during Christmastime.

titles.title: Death 4 Told
titles.description: Four stories are connected by space and time: "The Doll's House"; "Folklore"; "World's Most Haunted"; "The Psychic."

titles.title: Death Curse of Tartu
titles.description: Archaeology students flee from an Everglades witch doctor (Doug Hobart) who can turn into a shark, snake, alligator or zombie.

titles.title: Death From Above: Air Combat Vietnam War
titles.description: A greater tonnage of bombs was dropped in Vietnam than in World War II, the helicopter came into its own, and every type of U.S. aircraft was used during the Vietnam War.

titles.title: Death Machines
titles.description: A crime boss (Mari Honjo) uses a super drug to create three killers skilled in kung fu.

titles.title: Death of a Ninja
titles.description: A master ninja is sentenced to death and is forced to fight off numerous attackers.

titles.title: Death of the Dead
titles.description: An inept martial-arts student (Christina Rose) and her sensei (Jack Abele) must save the world from an army of karate-kicking zombies.

titles.title: Death of the Virgin
titles.description: A young woman with a dark past makes her vows to enter the nun hood and begins having premonitions of murders that seem to be related to the paintings of Caravaggio.

titles.title: Death She Wrote
titles.description: A famous author hires a personal assistant to work out of her home, not realizing that the woman is actually a deranged fan who plans on taking over her entire life.

titles.title: Deathcember
titles.description: A terrifying collection of 24 short horror films about the dark side of the holiday season.

titles.title: Deathdream
titles.description: Presumed dead in Vietnam, a young soldier reappears at his parents' home, but tensions grow within the family as his behavior becomes more odd.

titles.title: Decampitated
titles.description: Seven friends go camping in woods guarded by a psychopath killer who tries to kill them one by one.

titles.title: Decision
titles.description: Following the death of his dad (Billy Dean), a heartbroken teen (Mike Rosenbaum) develops a strong bond with his estranged grandfather (Rusty Whitener).

titles.title: Deep Red
titles.description: A psychic medium (Macha Méril) is brutally murdered, and musician Marcus Daly (David Hemmings) feels a need to solve the case, since he was the one who discovered the body. Working with him is reporter Gianna Brezzi (Daria Nicolodi), who hopes for a big scoop by solving the case. When one of Marcus's own friends ends up murdered at the hands of the same killer, the resourceful pair realize they must work fast to uncover the murderer's identity, or they might serve as the maniac's next victims.

titles.title: Def by Temptation
titles.description: Joel (James Bond III), a quiet divinity student from North Carolina, starts to question his faith. So he heads to New York to visit his friend K (Kadeem Hardison), a struggling actor, who takes him out bar-hopping. They meet a gorgeous seductress (Cynthia Bond) who turns out to be a succubus, a demon spirit luring black Lotharios to their deaths. When she sets her eyes on Joel, K turns to the help of Dougie (Bill Nunn), a drunken cop who specializes in supernatural investigations.

titles.title: Dementia 13
titles.description: After John Haloran dies, his wife, Louise, fears that she will be denied his inheritance. Fabricating a story about John traveling to the United States, she joins the rest of the Haloran family at their Irish estate as they hold a memorial for John's sister, who died in a lake eight years ago. Louise schemes to convince Lady Haloran that she can speak with the dead child. However, this plan is interrupted by an axe murderer loose on the estate.

titles.title: Detour
titles.description: Harper (Tye Sheridan), a seemingly naive law student, obsesses over the idea that his shifty stepfather (Stephen Moyer) was involved in the devastating car crash that left his mother hospitalized and comatose. While drowning his suspicions in whiskey, he suddenly finds himself engrossed in a conversation with a volatile grifter (Emory Cohen) and his stripper companion (Bel Powley). As daylight breaks, Harper soon realizes that he's in over his head with this violent duo.

titles.title: Detroit 9000
titles.description: Biracial detectives (Alex Rocco, Hari Rhodes) track loot from a fundraiser for the first black governor of Michigan.

titles.title: Deus Irae
titles.description: Father Javier lives a fractured existence where on one side, he assists families who claim to have witnessed miracles and on the other, he is part of a trio of excommunicated priests who hunt the possessed down to exorcize them under their own terms.

titles.title: Devil in the Flesh
titles.description: When her mother is killed in a mysterious house fire, rebellious teen Debbie Strand (Rose McGowan) is sent to live with her grandmother (Peg Shirley), where she becomes even more unhinged. She develops an intense crush on her hunky creative writing teacher, Peter Rinaldi (Alex McArthur), but her numerous attempts at seduction end in failure. Soon Peter's friends start turning up dead, and he fears that his fiancée, Marilyn (Sherrie Rose), may be Debbie's next victim.

titles.title: Devil in the Flesh 2
titles.description: After young serial killer Debbie Strand (Jodi Lyn O'Keefe) manages to escape from her mental institution, she is intent on picking up where she left off, this time heading to college, assuming the identity of a girl she has murdered. Debbie settles easily into her new life at school, where she develops an obsession with one of the professors there, Sam Deckner (Jsu Garcia). However, her violent ways result in more bloodshed and significantly threaten her romantic aspirations.

titles.title: Devil's Knot
titles.description: The Arkansas town of West Memphis makes national headlines when three teenagers are arrested for the brutal murders of three little boys.

titles.title: Devil's Men
titles.description: Wyoming ranch boy Sam Byrne is drafted into World War II and becomes a member of the First Special Service Force. Unwilling to kill, he quickly learns that he must to save himself and the men he serves with.

titles.title: Devil's Pass
titles.description: To determine what happened to some Russian hikers, five U.S. college students go back to where the hikers were found dead. The students don't return from the expedition, either, and the recovered footage is deemed too disturbing for public viewing.

titles.title: Devilreaux

titles.description: Based on Sarai Walker's best-selling novel of the same name, "Dietland" offers a darkly comedic look at the war of the sexes. The series explores a multitude of issues women face today -- including patriarchy, misogyny, rape culture and unrealistic beauty standards -- by following Plum Kettle's journey to self-awakening. A ghostwriter for the editor of one of New York's hottest fashion magazines, Plum has waged a lifelong battle with her image. Fed up, she turns to weight-loss surgery but ends up in the middle of two rival feminist factions -- one that may be responsible for the attacks on male harassers, and the other that preaches female empowerment. As she straddles the two groups, Plum must decide what part she plays in a wildly complicated, changing world.

titles.title: Dispatches From Elsewhere
titles.description: "Dispatches From Elsewhere" is an anthology series from creator and star Jason Segal. The story centers around four ordinary people - Peter, Simone, Janice, and Fredwynn -- who are brought together by chance after they all respond to a flyer. Feeling as though something is missing in their lives, the characters are drawn into a game that unfolds in a serpentine series of events, taking them from parades to shareholders' meetings. titles.title: Divided
titles.description: Veteran game show host and producer Mike Richards emcees this show that is described as "part game show, part social experiment." Four strangers must work as a team on each episode, coming to an agreement on the answer to each question Richards asks. They have to do it quickly, though, because as the clock ticks down so does the amount of money the contestants can win. So the longer they debate, the less a correct answer earns them. As the amount of money available increases in each round, the intensity ramps up as there is a point when the team must collectively decide on one member to eliminate. At the end of the game, whatever money has been won to that point is divided into three highly uneven amounts and the three remaining players have to decide who gets which portion of the cash. They find themselves on the clock again as they attempt to come to a consensus on that decision. If the time runs out before settling on a solution, they lose everything.

titles.title: Dr. Miami

He is such a prolific plastic surgeon around the city that he has earned the nickname Dr. Miami. The surgeon has even gained a worldwide following by sharing the uncensored, and sometimes unconventional, procedures that he performs on his patients, who he calls "beauty warriors." Whether it's a tummy tuck, a breast augmentation or a nose job, Dr. Miami isn't afraid to livestream it on social media, which is the job of social media coordinators Brittany and Ashley -- who are always vying for the doctor's attention. Dr. Miami's sister-in-law Rosy runs the practice as its COO, and her responsibilities include being the unofficial staff therapist.

titles.title: Driven to Love
titles.description: There's no shortage of dating shows on cable, so shows need a unique aspect to stand out from the crowd. "Driven to Love" has that in the form of a "tricked-out love taxi," to use the network's term for the vehicle. Host Ray J serves as the driver as he helps a single person find love through five potential dates while cruising along the streets of New York City. Ray J also serves as the dater's wingman, offering advice and choosing prospective mates for the romantic meetings that happen both inside and outside the vehicle. But it's ultimately up to the dater to decide which potential suitors to give a chance. When Ray J drives up to a potential date, the single decides whether to drive past, let the suitor into the vehicle, or even kick out the current mate to let in the new one. In the end, the contestant chooses one mate with whom to go on a romantic getaway.

The series follows the detectives, who put their friendship to the test, as they are pulled deeper into the intrigue and darkness that surrounds the case.

titles.title: Emogenius
titles.description: Emojis can be polarizing, with some people constantly using the little drawings and others not caring for them. Love 'em or hate 'em, emojis can be worth money on this comedic game show. Each half-hour episode pits two pairs of contestants against each other in a battle to see which team knows emojis better. The first challenge forces the contestants to decipher a series of pop culture-inspired emoji messages. In the second round, the contestants must send each other strings of emojis that their partners must correctly guess. The winning team then advances to the bonus round, in which the teammates trade off sending and guessing rapid-fire emoji messages. If they beat the bonus round, they take home $10,000. Social media star Hunter March hosts the show, and he has game show hosting in his blood -- grandfather Hal March served as emcee on "The $64,000 Question" in the 1950s.

titles.title: Fame Kills
titles.description: Being a celebrity isn't all it's cracked up to be. Sure, there's the money, big houses and star-studded parties, but there's also a seedier side to fame. Jealousy, greed and murder are among the negative aspects of being famous and are regular subjects of this docuseries that profiles some rising stars whose roads to fame took detours, encountering deadly situations. Each hourlong episode tells one star-to-be's story from its rise to the untimely end. Re-enactments, interviews with friends and loved ones, and testimony from witnesses and detectives help to tell each tale.

titles.description: Documentary filmmaker Robert Kenner examines how mammoth corporations have taken over all aspects of the food chain in the United States, from the farms where our food is grown to the chain restaurants and supermarkets where it's sold. Narrated by author and activist Eric Schlosser, the film features interviews with average Americans about their dietary habits, commentary from food experts like Michael Pollan and unsettling footage shot inside large-scale animal processing plants.

titles.title: For My Man
titles.description: When people get married, they often promise to do anything for their new spouses. When the women profiled in this docuseries say they'll do anything, they mean anything. "For My Man" tells stories of women who have been arrested -- part of the growing female population in the criminal justice system -- for crimes that they committed in the name of love. The crimes committed range from becoming an inside informant at the DEA for a drug-addicted partner to turning on one's own family members at a jealous boyfriend's request, and even as extreme as going on a killing spree across the Midwest.

episodes.title: Tiffani Jacobs; Jackie Wortham
episodes.description: After falling ill, Tiffani Jacobs looks for a man to help her feel normal; Jackie Wortham scorches a path of destruction with a lover who fuels her fire.

episodes.title: Risking It All
episodes.description: Brazen armed robberies strike local businesses in a tranquil community in Wisconsin, and detectives find themselves with few clues to help them identify the perpetrators.

episodes.title: By Any Means Necessary
episodes.description: A young woman finds solace in a new boyfriend after her father passes away; he ropes her into one of his criminal schemes; she finds herself in the midst of a brutal bloodbath.

episodes.title: Love and Lies
episodes.description: Sparks fly when a young mother reunites with her childhood crush, but her new man is guarding a deadly secret that will put her and her son's lives in danger; when she gets caught in the crosshairs, she must choose to save her man or herself.

episodes.title: Man, or Monster?
episodes.description: A heartbreak sends a vivacious mother of seven into the arms of a wealthy gentleman; after nearly a decade together, she discovers the monster under the mask, a notorious gang leader being hunted by the FBI and leaving a trail of bodies behind him.

episodes.title: Dancing with Danger
episodes.description: After a stint of living on the streets, a teenage girl finally finds security in the arms of her new boyfriend; in return, she'd do anything for him, but when a small favor takes a deadly turn, she loses her friend and her freedom, all for her man.

episodes.title: Rooted in Revenge
episodes.description: After a loving mother and spiritualist meets her soul mate, they quickly start a happy life together; when a curse is threatening to destroy their marriage, the devoted wife will do anything to keep her man.

episodes.title: Silent Lies
episodes.description: When a young mother starts a family with the man of her dreams, she believes nothing will tear them apart; when her man puts a child's life at risk, she has to choose between protecting the one she loves and listening to her maternal instincts.

episodes.title: The Sting of Betrayal
episodes.description: A single mother meets a suave and loving provider, and she looks the other way when she learns the source of his income.

episodes.title: Drive of Death
episodes.description: Sparks fly when a woman with a checkered past meets a man with a similar history, but old habits die hard; when her man falls back into a life of crime, she must decide to either follow her man into darkness or to finally do the right thing.

titles.title: Forbidden Trails
titles.description: Upon their release from prison, ex-convicts Fulton (Charles King) and Howard (Bud Osborne) seek revenge on Marshal Buck Roberts (Buck Jones), the man who put them away. Buck, now retired, is injured in an attack by the men, but he survives and is helped by friends Sandy Hopkins (Raymond Hatton) and Tim McCall (Tim McCoy). While Buck recovers, Sandy and Tim, hoping to get proof of Fulton and Howard's guilt, ingratiate themselves with the criminals but soon end up in over their heads.

titles.title: Forensic Factor
titles.description: Based on true crimes solved by an elite team of investigators, "Forensic Factor" details the trade secrets used by the world's best sleuths to nab the most elusive criminals, with re-enactments of crucial incidents and firsthand accounts from the experts providing depth and insight.

episodes.title: Colchester Rapist

episodes.title: Eclectic Murders
episodes.description: A small town encounters satanic rituals and a savage killer.

episodes.title: Smiley Face Killer
episodes.description: A serial killer in Spokane, Wash. murders prostitutes and leaves a bag with a smiley face on the victim's head.

episodes.title: Million Dollar Murder
episodes.description: A Texas playboy is murdered and police uncover X-rated photos, shocking videos and an object hidden inside the victim's body.

episodes.title: Jack
episodes.description: A killer who leaves messages signed "Jack" terrorizes East Point, Ga.

episodes.title: Love Bites
episodes.description: Police discover a murdered teenage girl was involved in a love triangle.

titles.title: Fortnite: Battle, Build, Survive!
titles.description: Exploring the game "Fortnite," which has more than 125 million active players around the globe.

titles.title: Four in a Bed
titles.description: Four pairs of Bed and Breakfast owners compete for the best establishment.

episodes.title: Robertsbrook Guesthouse
episodes.description: Four pairs of Bed and Breakfast owners compete for the best establishment.

episodes.title: Eden Lodge
episodes.description: Competitors James and Maria, the parents of Charlotte Church, object to the star rating of Ziggy's Eden Lodge in fabulous Falmouth.

episodes.title: Dexby Townhouse
episodes.description: Dexby Townhouse in Cardiff is run by Charlotte Church's parents, James and Maria, who lay on a day of white-water rafting in tight wetsuits and some magic tricks courtesy of Maria's young nephew Elliot.

episodes.title: Muddifords Court Country House
episodes.description: It is the last stay of the competition, and it is the turn of newlyweds Pip Easby and Nicky Lesser-Easby, who run Muddifords Court Country House in Devon.

episodes.title: Payment Day
episodes.description: The group meet one last time to find out exactly how much they have been paid by their fellow hoteliers, and to air their grievances face to face.

episodes.title: Gorse Meadow
episodes.description: The first to host is Mrs. Tee of Gorse Meadow, a four star B&B in the New Forest; her eccentric personality charms the guests on arrival but not everyone's room is up to scratch.

episodes.title: Castle Hill Guesthouse
episodes.description: Alistair and Emma Mundell's four-star Castle Hill Guesthouse in sleepy Lynton, Nroth Devon only opened three months ago, and the B&B newbies are desperate to impress with their recently renovated rooms.

episodes.title: Vidella
episodes.description: The competition heads to Blackpool and the three-star Vidella, run by best friends and business partners John and Neil, where to pay back Alistair for being a self-confessed Blackpool-hater, the Vidella boys have rigged his room with practical jokes.

episodes.title: Urban Beach
episodes.description: For the final visit the group checks into the boutique B&B Urban Beach in Bournemouth, run by local entrepreneur Mark Crib.

episodes.title: Payment Day
episodes.description: Another fearsome battle draws to a close as the proprietors reconvene to find out how much they have been paid, and Mrs Tee finds out who gave her one point for cleanliness.

episodes.title: Derwent House
episodes.description: The first to host are exuberant Jon Shorrock and his wife Julia, who run the four-star B&B Derwent House in West Sussex; whereas the guests take a quiet gander at their rooms, Andy and Julian have concerns over their carpeted bathroom.

episodes.title: Kirkby Park B&B
episodes.description: On arrival at Peter and Sharron Sorsky's Kirkby Park B&B in Liverpool, Annette is immediately on her guard after noting the CCTV on the outside of the house.

episodes.title: Plas Dinas Country House
episodes.description: Andy and Julian Banner-Price host the competition at their swanky Plas Dinas Country House in Snowdonia, where they've allocated their guests their priciest rooms.

episodes.title: Hazelwood Farm
episodes.description: The final B&B of the week, Hazelwood Farm in Crake, Yorkshire is run by Annette, a one-woman whirlwind as she cleans and cooks everything herself in her four-star silver B&B and also provides homemade biscuits in each room.

episodes.title: Payment Day
episodes.description: It's crunch time for the hoteliers as they return to Hazelwood Farm to find out who has cracked the nut and taken the top prize, and how much they have been paid.

episodes.title: The Pit Stop
episodes.description: Melvyn and Sindy kick-start the latest competition with their Morgan sports-car-themed B&B, The Pitstop, in Hertfordshire.

episodes.title: The Victory at Mersea
episodes.description: Melvyn has a reason to pick holes in Gill and Peter's bed-and-breakfast when he discovers a fissure in a bedsheet.

episodes.title: Butterfly Paragliding B&B
episodes.description: At Butterfly Paragliding B&B, on the Isle of Wight, tension builds from the outset as Wayne and Deborah discover that they will be spending the night in one of Dave's tepees in the garden.

episodes.title: Braddon Hall
episodes.description: Deborah Morrison and Wayne Bingham host at their B&B, Braddon Hall in Torquay; Melvyn and Sindy are curious to know if the B&B's chandelier is sturdy enough to do some swinging from and find their four-poster bed a little squeaky.

episodes.title: Payment Day
episodes.description: The B&B owners gather for one last time - to find out how much they've been paid and reveal the winner.

episodes.title: The Old Hall Country House
episodes.description: Simon White and friend and neighbor Shirley Boyle are first to host at The Old Hall Country House, a historic 16th century B&B, in the picturesque village of Madeley in Cheshire.

episodes.title: Thornley House
episodes.description: It's day two in the competition and the turn of cat-lover Eileen Finn to cater for her B&B competitors at the four-star Thornley House in Allendale, Northumbria.

episodes.title: Chy Conyn
episodes.description: Jessica and Adrian Rashleigh, third to host, hope that they will make up for the lack in size with stunning surroundings at their three-bedroom establishment Chy Conyn in St Ives, on the beautiful Cornish coast.

episodes.title: The Cavendish
episodes.description: The guests are initially impressed with the Cavendish in Bournemouth, the 16-bed 'pink palace' from final hosts Tim and Karen, but things go downhill when Simon and Shirley vigorously test their bed - and break it.

episodes.title: Payment Day
episodes.description: The rivals reconvene for one last time to find out how much they've been paid by their fellow B&B owners, and to sort out their differences; Simon White of Old Hall Country House is stunned by a generous overpayment.

episodes.title: Godshill Park Farm House
episodes.description: Mark and Kathy start the competition at their Godshill Park Farmhouse on the Isle of Wight, and their hosting skills immediately come into question as Kathy asks Kalpana and Joseph from The Address to remove their shoes because of the cream carpets.

episodes.title: Butterfly Guest House
episodes.description: Some guests at the Butterfly Guest House get worked up when they find two hairs in the bathroom, while others rejoice at finding matching spoons.

episodes.title: The Address
episodes.description: The hoteliers descend on Blackpool to check out Kalpana and Joseph's four-star townhouse; a bothersome security light blackens the experience for Ruth.

episodes.title: Crake Trees Manor
episodes.description: The group head to the Cumbrian hillsides to stay at Ruth and Mike's Crake Trees Manor; Teresa looks forward to relaxing, but she and her husband Clive are in the Shepherds Hut - outdoor accommodation without water, toilet or electricity.

episodes.title: Payment Day
episodes.description: Mark and Kathy suffer a blow in the form of an underpayment, and accusations of game-playing shatter group harmony.

episodes.title: Slimmeria
episodes.description: There's a fat chance of the weight-loss retreat Slimmeria impressing all the guests with its hefty price tag.

episodes.title: 38 St Giles
episodes.description: Jan and William Cheeseman have achieved a Five Star Gold rating at 38 St Giles in Norwich, but the pursuit of perfection has been known to take its toll on this volatile pair.

episodes.title: Bosvean House
episodes.description: In Bude, Cornwall, the owners of the four-star Bosvean House have the luxury label of their establishment challenged by guests.

episodes.title: Ombersley B&B
episodes.description: Gluten-free bread causes a ruckus between Galia and Ann at the Ombersley Bed & Breakfast; the conveniences are inconveniently located.

episodes.title: Payment Day
episodes.description: It's payment day, and Diane and Max feel that their rivals have stabbed them in the back; the winners are revealed.

episodes.title: Silverwood Lodge
episodes.description: Husband and wife Paul and Flora, the only couple in competition, host from the Silverwood Lodge in Cambridgeshire.

episodes.title: Seashells Guesthouse
episodes.description: In Sue's dog-themed Great Yarmouth guesthouse, Nancy brings up the issue of man's best friend sleeping in the beds.

episodes.title: The Old Court Guesthouse
episodes.description: In Bath, forthright American ex-banker Nancy Hampson isn't everybody's favorite person, so there's trouble for her from the beginning at The Old Court Guesthouse.

episodes.title: The Dean
episodes.description: Jolly Caroline treats guests to a jig, complete with bagpipe accompaniment, at The Dean on the Firth of Forth.

episodes.title: Payment Day
episodes.description: It's payment day for the latest batch of hoteliers where Nancy is free with her negative comments, and comes under fire from all sides.

episodes.title: Watersedge Guest House
episodes.description: Alan and Sylvie of Watersedge Guest House in Barton on Sea, Hampshire vie for the title of best value B&B.

episodes.title: Nearwater
episodes.description: Tim and Amelia host the rival B&B owners at their non-star-rated boutique accommodation at Nearwater in Cornwall.

episodes.title: Roundhouse Hotel
episodes.description: It's Austrian-born Eva Buschmann's turn to host in her cosmopolitan boutique B&B on the Weymouth seafront, the Roundhouse Hotel.

episodes.title: Homecliffe Hotel
episodes.description: Showmen Mike and Danny host their rival B&B owners on day four at their four-star rated guest house, Homecliffe Hotel, in Blackpool.

episodes.title: Payment Day
episodes.description: Tensions rise as the hoteliers reconvene to find out how much cash they can expect to see; Alan and Sylvie want to know why Tim and Amelia were complaining about their room.

episodes.title: Centery Farm
episodes.description: Steve and Beverly Green from Centery Farm in North Devon greet their guests with a warm welcome before making their way around the farmhouse to examine their rooms.

episodes.title: Little Gloster
episodes.description: The second visit of the competition is to the Little Gloster on the Isle of Wight, owned and run by 27-year-old professional chef Ben Cooke and assisted by his 81-year-old Danish grandmother Lilian, who has over 50 years' experience in the trade.

episodes.title: Old Hall House
episodes.description: It's the third day of the week's competition and Stephen's turn to host; Stephen hasn't opened up to the group yet, much to the chagrin of some of the other guests, who seem to have taken a dislike to him.

episodes.title: House of Agnes
episodes.description: The final visit of the competition is to the House of Agnes in Canterbury, run by ex-hotel inspector Sandie De Rougemont.

episodes.title: Payment Day
episodes.description: On the final day, all the B&B hosts gather for one last time to find out how much they've been paid.

episodes.title: The Pavilion
episodes.description: The Pavilion is a London fashion and rock 'n' roll hotel owned by former pop singer and Lamborghini lover Danny Karne; guests are wowed by the flashy sports car parked out front and impressed by the colorful decor in the themed rooms.

episodes.title: Fox and Duck
episodes.description: The Fox and Duck in Therfield, Hertfordshire, is a country inn owned by John Luce and partner Pat Sutton; guests take lessons at the local golf club.

episodes.title: The New Inn
episodes.description: The New Inn is in Newbridge-on-Wye and is run by Dave and Debbie Lang; as a keen pig breeder, Dave likes to get his guests in the mood for breakfast with pig ornaments.

episodes.title: Westleigh Farm
episodes.description: Upon inspecting the rooms at Robert Kerstin's establishment in Somerset, Danny finds dust, cobwebs and some wrong hangers.

episodes.title: Payment Day
episodes.description: As the group meets for the last time, the payments are revealed and the winning B&B is announced, but old tensions surface and there are heated exchanges around the table.

episodes.title: Guest and the City
episodes.description: Dan and Mardi Leonard welcome the others to their Brighton B&B, Guest and the City, where the guests have mixed reactions to the contemporary décor and stained-glass windows.

episodes.title: The Farmer's Boy Inn
episodes.description: Phil Kiernan, entrepreneur and proud owner of the Farmer's Boy Inn in Gloucestershire, welcomes his guests and quickly introduces them to his latest business venture: pies.

episodes.title: Geanna Hotel Boat
episodes.description: Alan and Jane welcome their first guests to their brand-new hotel boat, the Geanna; guests enjoy the novelty factor, but Dan and Mardi think that space is too tight.

episodes.title: Sentry Mead
episodes.description: Connoisseurs Sarah Langford and Jean-Pierre Kujawa have been running Sentry Mead, their 11-bedroom, five-star B&B for the past six years.

episodes.title: Payment Day
episodes.description: It's the final day and the B&B hosts gather for one last time to find out how much they've been paid; some of the hosts let their emotions get away from them.

titles.title: Four Lions
titles.description: A group of young Muslim men living in Sheffield decide to wage jihad, and they hatch an inept plan to become suicide bombers. Omar (Riz Ahmed) and Waj (Kayvan Novak) have a brief, disastrous run at a Pakistan training camp, while Faisal (Adeel Akhtar) works on an unlikely scheme to train birds to carry bombs. Their ill-conceived plan culminates at the London Marathon with their bumbling attempts to disrupt the event while dressed in outlandish costumes.

titles.title: Four of a Kind
titles.description: Calli, Kendra, Megan and Sarah Durst are identical quadruplets in their senior year of high school in Minnesota. The show chronicles the trials and tribulations the sisters experience while trying to juggle school with their personal lives. The girls deal with the possibility of splitting up as they decide which colleges to attend. Their mother, Naomi, faces potentially having an empty nest for the first time in many years as the quadruplets' older brother, Travis, is also heading to college.

episodes.title: Durst Girls Gone Wild

The show chronicles the trials and tribulations the sisters experience while trying to juggle school with their personal lives. The girls deal with the possibility of splitting up as they decide which colleges to attend. Their mother, Naomi, faces potentially having an empty nest for the first time in many years as the quadruplets' older brother, Travis, is also heading to college.

titles.title: FrackNation
titles.description: Proponents of the drilling process known as fracking claim that activists and the media have suppressed facts and that the process does not harm the environment.

titles.title: Frances Ferguson
titles.description: A substitute teacher's crushing discontent drives her to an ill-advised transgression.

titles.title: Frank
titles.description: An aspiring musician (Domhnall Gleeson) finds himself way out of his element after he joins a pop group led by an enigmatic figure (Michael Fassbender) who wears a giant fake head.

titles.title: Frank and Jesse James
titles.description: Author James P. Muehlberger talks about the 1869 killing of a bank cashier in Missouri; this has been considered the first in a long line of robberies by Jesse and Frank James.

titles.title: Frank Serpico
titles.description: The life of Frank Serpico, the former NYPD officer and whistleblower who exposed rampant corruption in the department in the '60s and '70s. The reclusive Serpico talks about his life, from childhood through retirement.

titles.title: Frankenstein '80
titles.description: Dr. Frankenstein creates a monster in a secret laboratory. The monster soon breaks loose and starts to kill beautiful women in gory ways.

titles.title: Frankenstein vs. The Mummy
titles.description: Dr. Victor Frankenstein reanimates a sadistic madman while his colleague uncovers the mummy of an evil pharaoh. When the two monsters come face to face, no one is safe from their rampage.

titles.title: Frantic
titles.description: An audience in a Japanese theater is taken hostage and forced to watch a stage play, but the show soon goes off-script as the creators find themselves entrapped by their own work.

titles.title: Freak Show
titles.description: Billy Bloom is one-of-a-kind: a fabulous, glitter-bedecked, gender-bending teenager whose razor-sharp wit is matched only by his outrageous, anything-goes fashion sense. When his glamorous mother is forced to send him to live with his straight-laced father, Billy discovers that he's like a diva-out-of-water at his new ultra-conservative high school. Undaunted by the bullies who don't understand him, the fearless Billy sets out to make a big statement in his own inimitable way.

titles.title: Freakonomics
titles.description: Vignettes explore concepts put forth in a best-selling book, including cheating, bribery, and the importance of names.

titles.title: Freakshow
titles.description: The people employed by Todd Ray don't mind being called "freaks." In fact, they might even take it as a compliment. That's because "freak," according to Ray, means the most special, the unique, the magical creatures of the universe. And Ray looks all over the world for such creatures to add to his business, the Venice Beach Freakshow, a carnie-style attraction with an attached museum of strange, wondrous oddities. This reality series follows Ray, his wife, Danielle, and their two kids, Asia and Phoenix, as they operate the Freakshow on the boardwalk of Venice Beach, Calif. The Rays also open their home to their employees, who include Brianna Belladonna ("The Indestructible Woman"); body-modification artist Marcus "The Creature"; Morgue, who specializes in "shock" performances; and Murrugun "The Mystic," a veteran sideshow star known for sword-swallowing and human pincushion acts.

titles.title: Ghost Hunters
titles.description: After terrifying and captivating fans for 11 seasons, the series that introduced the world to the field of authentic paranormal investigation returns with a familiar face and a brand-new spook squad. Grant Wilson, one of the original team leaders of "Ghost Hunters," joins a handpicked group of professionals who uses its decades of field experience to help everyday people across the country who are struggling with supernatural phenomena. The team utilizes forensic experts, historical records and the most innovative technology available to follow the evidence wherever it may lead and discover the truth behind the unexplained hauntings.

episodes.title: The Lady in the Window
episodes.description: The team travels to Albion, N.Y., to help a home renovator whose dream project has become a nightmare; a tale of warring wives and tragic death on the property has Grant and the team believing the home may be haunted by one of its former matriarchs.

episodes.title: Return to St. Augustine
episodes.description: The team comes to the aid of a woman in Hanover, Penn., who has been tortured for years by unexplained activity in her home; Grant returns to the St. Augustine Lighthouse to investigate a reported increase in paranormal activity around the landmark.

episodes.title: Beyond the Investigation
episodes.description: Grant Wilson gives viewers an exclusive inside look at how the squad goes above and beyond to search for paranormal activity while deliberately debunking claims with a logical explanation.

episodes.title: The Cursed Castle
episodes.description: Guests and staff of a stately hotel find themselves seeking escape from a variety of spirits; the team learns of a history of destructive fires on the property; a forensic sketch artist is enlisted to help identify a mysterious "woman in white."

episodes.title: There's Something in the Seminary
episodes.description: Grant and the team travel to the Madison Seminary in Madison, Ohio, to help an enterprising amateur ghost hunter who got more than he bargained for when he purchased the former women's psychiatric hospital.

episodes.title: Dancing With the Dead
episodes.description: The Ghost Hunters visit the Athenaeum, which is a cultural center that has stood in the heart of Indianapolis for over 100 years.

episodes.title: Suicide Hotel
episodes.description: The team journeys to the Original Springs Hotel in Okawville, Ill., after reports of specter sightings and unexplained activity, combined with the resort's remarkably morbid history, have the owner's son concerned for the safety of his mother.

episodes.title: Home for the Haunting
episodes.description: The team comes to the aid of a single mother and her young son who are afraid that spirits in their Victorian house in Willimantic, Conn., may be a threat to their safety; Kristen investigates claims of a child's voice in an upstairs bedroom.

episodes.title: You've Been Warned
episodes.description: The former owner of the Duff Green Mansion in Vicksburg, Miss., warns the new owner of the bed-and-breakfast about the strange paranormal activity he observed at the mansion for decades, but she simply does not believe in ghosts.

episodes.title: Blood on the Bayou
episodes.description: A Louisiana woman worries that her family plantation may be haunted by its troubled past; with countless deaths on the property over the plantation's 200-year history, the list of spirits that may be present at the large estate is seemingly endless.

episodes.title: Hospital Horror
episodes.description: Cousins Luke and Chelsea purchase a hospital that was abandoned for 44 years and want to turn it into a bed-and-breakfast; their plans come to a screeching halt as strange things begin to happen soon after starting renovations.

episodes.title: Terror Town Part 1
episodes.description: Since its founding in 1873, the remote mining town of Clifton, Ariz., has been trapped in a devastating cycle of violence, mayhem and natural disaster; along with the town's brutal past comes a long history of dark paranormal experiences.

episodes.title: Terror Town Part 2
episodes.description: On their second night in the remote mining town of Clifton, Ariz., the team revisits several hubs of paranormal activity as they try to get to the bottom of the aggressive phenomena; Grant, Brandon and Brian have a breakthrough in the Boarding House.

episodes.title: Proof of Afterlife
episodes.description: Fort Stanton in New Mexico is established in the 19th century as a military post, then converted into a tuberculosis hospital; reports of paranormal activity date back to the 1940s, but a recent uptick in claims causes concerns about staff safety.

episodes.title: Nightmare Camp
episodes.description: The Perry-Mansfield Performing Arts Camp deep in northern Colorado forestland is plagued by reports of unsettling paranormal encounters; in the first professional investigation of the site, Grant sends the team ahead to begin without him.

episodes.title: Alone in Alaska
episodes.description: The team treks to Haines, Alaska, where paranormal activity is reported at the Hotel Halsingland, a converted former military outpost in a region where many once lost their lives due to extreme weather conditions, starvation and bloody conflicts.

episodes.title: Haunted Hospital
episodes.description: Since the Galena Marine Hospital's recent purchase, distressing paranormal activity has been reported and the current owner calls upon the Ghost Hunters for help; the team hears claims of heavy footsteps, six-foot shadow figures and light anomalies.

episodes.title: The Last Mission
episodes.description: Paranormal activity at the Wendover Airfield in Utah causes the staff to fear for its safety; the team investigates reports from a full-bodied apparition of a World War II soldier to a mysterious blinding light.

episodes.title: The Glenn Family Curse
episodes.description: Disturbing paranormal activity at the Glenn House in the small town of Cape Girardeau, Mo., prompts the local historical association's president to reach out to Grant for help; as the investigation begins, the house quickly lives up to its claims.

episodes.title: Ghost Hunters Return to Waverly Hills

titles.title: Ghost Master

titles.title: Ghost Stories

His skepticism soon gets put to the test when he receives news of three chilling and inexplicable cases -- disturbing visions in an abandoned asylum, a car accident deep in the woods and the spirit of an unborn child. Even scarier -- each of the macabre stories seems to have a sinister connection to the professor's own life.

episodes.description: After four weeks on the road, Gino's airing his feet in the back seat as the guys cruise along a Texan highway. Texas is a meat lover's paradise, and Gordon is keen to show the Europhiles some of the best BBQ known to man.

episodes.title: Go Greek! Clash of the Titans

episodes.title: Desperately Seeking Santa

titles.title: Gordon's Great Escape
titles.description: Having a lifelong love of curry, chef Gordon Ramsay travels to India for the first time. While there he experiences the stunning diversity of its culinary traditions, immersing himself in all aspects of Indian culture, no matter how challenging, unfamiliar or extreme. In the show's second season, the famed chef expands his horizons to other areas of Southeast Asia -- exploring the regional cuisine in Cambodia, Vietnam, Malaysia and Thailand. But he's Gordon Ramsay, so he doesn't just taste the food -- he also prepares dishes using the delicacies that aren't found in many other parts of the world. The experience leads to Ramsay reviewing his own relationship with food and his opinion of what is -- and is not -- acceptable to eat.

She longs for pop stardom, but her father, a former music idol, warns her that fame often comes with a high price and that using her gift in the service of God is a loftier goal. When his former manager pays a visit, Grace decides to take his offer of a shot at the big time. But, the more successful she becomes, the more she feels pressure to compromise her religious values.

Malcolm Vanderpool (Charles Coleman) takes an interest in the run-down remnants of a small frontier town, fortune seekers from all over rush to gain a silver mine of their own. titles.title: Graveyard Carz
titles.description: "It's Mopar or No Car" for Mark Worman and his Graveyard Carz ghouls. They're game for any repair or restoration job, as long as it's in the Mopar mold -- a Chrysler muscle car from the late 1960s or early '70s. The series follows the progress to get the racing classics -- some left for dead in a scrap heap -- across the proverbial finish line, which to muscle car specialist Worman means nothing less than perfect restorations. After all, too much beauty exists in quality Detroit automobiles to let them go to rust.

titles.title: Growing Up Hip Hop
titles.description: Growing up with a famous parent isn't easy, as the children often have to work hard to emerge from their parents' shadows and gain independence -- especially if they want entertainment careers of their own. "Growing Up Hip Hop" documents the lives of a tight-knit group of friends, most of whom have at least one parent who is famous. Angela Simmons, the daughter of Run-D.M.C.'s Rev Run, is a model and fashion designer; Romeo Miller has followed in the footsteps of his father, Master P, in becoming a musician; entrepreneur Damon "Boogie" Dash is the son of former record executive Damon Dash; singer Kristinia DeBarge, the daughter of James DeBarge, struggles to choose between family and fame; TJ Mizell, a DJ whose father was Run-D.M.C. member Jam Master Jay, views Angela as family since both of their dads were in Run-D.M.C.; and aspiring singer Egypt Criss gets her talent from both mom and dad -- Pepa from Salt-N-Pepa and Treach from Naughty by Nature.
