titles.title: Leprechaun
titles.description: Dan O'Grady (Shay Duffin) steals 100 gold coins from a leprechaun (Warwick Davis) while on vacation in Ireland. The leprechaun follows him home, but Dan locks the murderous midget in a crate, held at bay by a four-leaf clover. Ten years later, J.D. Redding (John Sanderford) and his daughter, Tory (Jennifer Aniston), rent O'Grady's property for the summer. When their new neighbors accidentally release the leprechaun, he goes on a murderous rampage to reclaim his gold.

titles.title: Leprechaun 2
titles.description: A leprechaun (Warwick Davis) surfaces in Los Angeles to claim a bride, as his previous object of affection was denied to him a thousand years before in Ireland. He kidnaps teenager Bridget (Shevonne Durkin), grotesquely murdering anyone who gets in his way. It falls to Bridget's boyfriend, Cody (Charlie Heath), to rescue her. Cody enlists the aid of his perpetually tipsy uncle, Morty (Sandy Baron), who decides to go after the homicidal leprechaun's pot of gold.

titles.title: Leprechaun 3
titles.description: One night in Las Vegas, a pawn shop owner purchases a statue of a leprechaun from a mysterious stranger. He ignores the stranger's warning to never remove the statue's golden medallion and takes it for himself. Instantly the statue transforms into the murderous Leprechaun, who vows to kill anyone who takes his gold. Scott McCoy, who unwittingly took a gold coin from the pawn shop, and Tammy, Scott's new friend, are first on the list.

titles.title: Leprechaun 4 in Space
titles.description: Resurfacing on an alien planet, the Leprechaun (Warwick Davis) abducts a member of the world's royalty, Princess Zarina (Rebekah Carlton), in an attempt to wed her and become the supreme ruler. Unfortunately for the diminutive schemer, well-armed soldiers arrive to foil his plans. Not easily defeated, however, the feisty Leprechaun continues to battle the warriors while also contending with the warped scientist known as Dr. Mittenhand (Guy Siner).

titles.title: Leprechaun 5: In the Hood
titles.description: When aspiring hip-hop performers Butch (Red Grant), Postmaster P. (Anthony Montgomery) and Stray Bullet (Rashaan Nall) cross record producer Mack Daddy (Ice-T), their grudge against him leads to their own peril. After they break into Mack Daddy's home and swipe an ancient medallion from a grotesque statue, the evil Leprechaun (Warwick Davis) is freed from his magical prison. Soon the sinister little man is on the trail of Butch, Postmaster P. and Stray Bullet, along with Mack Daddy himself.

titles.title: Leprechaun: Back 2 tha Hood
titles.description: City hairdresser Emily Woodrow (Tangi Miller) finds the answer to her financial problems when she stumbles upon a chest brimming with gold. Although she and her friends quickly go from rags to riches, they discover that the gold belongs to someone else: an evil leprechaun (Warwick Davis) who has returned from hell to claim his treasure. Speaking in riddles and rhymes, the demon stalks his victims with ruthless determination -- and scores some excellent pot along the way.

titles.title: Leprechaun: Origins
titles.description: Not related to the previous Leprechaun films. Two young couples backpacking through Ireland discover that one of Ireland's most famous legends is a terrifying reality.

titles.title: Let the Right One In
titles.description: When Oskar (Kåre Hedebrant), a sensitive, bullied 12-year-old boy living with his mother in suburban Sweden, meets his new neighbor, the mysterious and moody Eli (Lina Leandersson), they strike up a friendship. Initially reserved with each other, Oskar and Eli slowly form a close bond, but it soon becomes apparent that she is no ordinary young girl. Eventually, Eli shares her dark, macabre secret with Oskar, revealing her connection to a string of bloody local murders.

titles.description: The line between cops and criminals is sometimes blurry. When human nature intercedes and a man is forced to take matters into his own hands, there's not a badge big enough that will stop him. Detroit homicide detective Frank Agnew is used to helping others, but he can't help himself when a loved one is abruptly taken from him by a corrupt element. Vengeance gets the better of Agnew, and now he finds himself and his career at the mercy of fellow detective Joe Geddes, a smart but slimy veteran cop whose misdeeds may involve covered-up murders. "Low Winter Sun" -- a gritty, dark drama played out amid Detroit's underworld -- is based on the 2006 award-winning British miniseries of the same name.

titles.title: Mama June: From Not to Hot
titles.description: June Shannon -- better known as "Mama June" -- gained fame as the mother of young beauty pageant contestant Honey Boo Boo on various reality shows. With that notoriety came jokes from comedians and people on social media about her weight. Coming off the end of her marriage to Sugar Bear and facing health issues, Mama June wants to do something about her weight and slim down so she can start a new life with a new body and, she hopes, a new love. In addition to undergoing a series of surgeries, Mama June undertakes an intense workout routine led by drill sergeant-style trainer Kenya Crooks to help shed the pounds.

titles.title: Million Dollar Matchmaker
titles.description: Patti Stanger has earned her "Millionaire Matchmaker" nickname (also the title of her previous show) through the years she has spent setting up wealthy people through her Millionaire's Club dating service, a practice she continues on this show. In each episode, two wealthy clients check into a luxury property in Southern California, where they unwittingly begin their "love lesson" through custom challenges designed by Stanger and her crew. Stanger then gives her feedback -- which can be brutally honest at times -- in one-on-one sessions with the daters, during which she gives an in-depth review of the surprise date. Each client is then introduced to the matches chosen by Patti, with the hope that one of them will be "the one." Stanger's team includes former beauty queen Candace, who has a psychology degree and is the top associate in Stanger's organization.

titles.title: Minute to Win It
titles.description: As a speed skater, Apolo Anton Ohno won a gold medal at the 2006 Winter Olympics for finishing a race within 42 seconds. The contestants on this game show hosted by Ohno have 18 seconds longer than that to complete each task in order to win a quarter of a million dollars as the grand prize. Contestants compete in as many as 10 challenges of increasing difficulty, each with a one-minute time limit, and which utilize everyday household items. Throughout the game contestants have the chance to walk away with any money earned to that point but risk losing the cash if they fail to complete a challenge within the time limit. A competitor who goes all the way and completes all 10 challenges in time, receives the $250,000.

"Mountain Men" profiles some of them. Eustace Conway, who has lived at the western edge of the Blue Ridge Mountains in North Carolina for more than 25 years, teaches interns about the old ways of living with nature. Tom Oar needs an entire year to prepare for the 7-month-long winter on Montana's Yaak River. In Alaska, Marty Meierotto must gather enough wood to survive -- in complete isolation -- winters that can have temperatures drop to 60 degrees below zero. titles.title: Mystery Millionaire
titles.description: In the early days of reality TV, there was a dating show on which a working-class bachelor pretended to be a millionaire while looking for a significant other from a group of female hopefuls. The premise of "Mystery Millionaire," which WE calls a social dating experiment, is the reverse of that. Each episode features a bachelor or bachelorette shedding expensive threads and fancy home for more modest clothing and living accommodations. Not to mention having to live on a much lower income than the person is used to. The featured dater goes on three blind dates, after which he or she must decide whom to pursue. The millionaire then goes on another date with the chosen person -- this time, a group date with friends -- and must decide whether or not to try to take it to the next level. But doing that means that he or she must reveal his/her identity. Then it's up to the chosen partner to decide whether or not to continue the relationship.

titles.title: Pamela's Garden of Eden
titles.description: "Pamela's Garden of Eden" follows actress Pamela Anderson as she leaves her Hollywood life behind, returns to her roots on the coast of Vancouver Island, and embarks on a massive restoration of her grandmother's legacy property. Joining Pamela's journey is a talented team of designers, architects and contractors who work with her through the stresses and struggles of this extraordinary renovation. A project of this scale will test both Pamela's patience and her personal life as she tries to remain focused on her dream for the property: to embrace her family's past and fulfill her vision for the future.

titles.title: Power
titles.description: It appears James "Ghost" St. Patrick has it all -- a drop-dead gorgeous wife, a stunning Manhattan penthouse, and the power and success that come with owning hot new nightclub Truth. But a closer look reveals a man living a double life. When Ghost isn't tending to his Fortune 500 business, he's catering to clients of another operation: a drug empire that serves only the rich and influential. While loyal sidekick Tommy protects the cash-cow narcotics venture at all costs, Ghost's new reality is using Truth as more than a front to launder money. It's a way out of the drug game and into a legitimate life with his family, even if everything he loves becomes unknowingly threatened. "Power" is co-executive produced by Curtis "50 Cent" Jackson (who also co-stars) and show creator Courtney Kemp Agboh ("The Good Wife").

episodes.title: Cheesy Stuffed Shells with Chicken

episodes.title: The Ultimate French Toast Breakfast Sandwich

episodes.title: One Skillet Chicken Dish
episodes.description: This week on "Pretty Delicious," Naomi Robinson whips up a One Skillet Chicken Dish that is creamy, delicious, and easy to make! Did we mention that this dish only requires one pan, AKA less dirty dishes to clean... now that's what we're talking about!

episodes.title: Mango Coconut Granola Bars
episodes.description: In this week's "Pretty Delicious", Naomi Robinson whips up healthy granola bars that are perfect to grab if you're on the go or craving a light snack. This nutty and fruity bar will blow your taste buds away!

episodes.title: Avocado Toast - 3 Ways
episodes.description: If you love avocados as much as we do, then you'll go crazy for these recipes! This week on "Pretty Delicious" Naomi Robinson whips up three different mouth-watering and flavorful avocado toasts, perfect for breakfast or a mid-day treat.

episodes.title: Naked Cake Topped with Flowers

episodes.title: Vanilla Chia Seed Pudding
episodes.description: Delicious vanilla chia seed pudding with a tasty fall twist! This no-fuss pudding is the perfect grab-and-go breakfast for when you're on the run.

episodes.title: Red Pear Tart Recipe
episodes.description: Red Anjou pears are in season! Show off the natural sweetness of this tasty fall fruit with this mouth-watering tart.

episodes.title: Cinnamon Rolls with a Brown Sugar Glaze
episodes.description: This week on Pretty Delicious, Julianna Strickland makes ooey-gooey sweet cinnamon rolls. These over the top rolls are generously topped with a warm brown sugar glaze and make the perfect addition to your morning coffee.

episodes.title: Candy Cane Cookies
episodes.description: Just when you thought cookies couldn't get better, Julianna Strickland proves you wrong... and you won't even be mad about it! This candy cane cookie is minty, chocolatey, and a must-bake for your holiday party.

episodes.title: Eton Mess Dessert with Berry Sauce
episodes.description: Have you ever heard of an eton mess? If not, you're missing out on arguably the worlds sweetest dessert! This week on Pretty Delicious, Julianna Strickland makes a classic eton mess with all of the works.

titles.title: Project MKHEXE
titles.description: A found-footage psychological thriller. After his brother Sean's suicide, Tim, an aspiring filmmaker, uncovers Sean's obsession with a deleted urban legend tied to a secret mind-control experiment. As Tim investigates, compiling Sean's notes and interviewing family and friends, he suspects Sean was murdered. With help from Sean's friend Nicole, Tim's search for truth spirals into obsession, unraveling his grief and revealing a chilling reality: "What We Fear, We Create."

episodes.description: Busy parents Kevin and Shirley desperately want to cut down their daily commute so they can spend more time with their daughters and one another. But they sold the house they loved more quickly than anticipated, and now they're stuck in rental limbo.

episodes.description: Along with their three small children, Debra and Dan are squeezed into a tiny urban condo. And though they'd prefer to stay in the heart of the city, it's time to find the sprawling suburban home of their dreams.

episodes.title: Property Brothers: Lizzy & Dave
episodes.description: With three kids and another one on the way, Dave and Lizzy are desperate to get out of their rental and into the home of their dreams. But they've been house hunting for years already, and their due date is fast approaching.

episodes.title: Property Brothers: Nathan & Jessica
episodes.description: Tennis pros Jessica and Nathan have been living a cramped condo lifestyle for way too long. And now they're desperate to find a sprawling home in the country where they can put down roots and entertain family in style.

episodes.title: Property Brothers: Mark & Eugenie
episodes.description: Juggling after-school activities with their careers, Mark and Eugenie haven't had time for house hunting. While the couple has a luxurious list of must-haves, the Property Brothers warn they'll need to compromise if they want to box up their rental.

episodes.title: Property Brothers: Sandi & Phil
episodes.description: Sandi and Phil have lived in their park-filled waterfront neighborhood for years. But with the arrival of their baby boy, they've suddenly outgrown their one-room loft-style apartment, and are searching for an allergy-free forever home.

episodes.title: Property Brothers: Leslie & Tim
episodes.description: Since they sold their downtown condo, Leslie and Tim have been living with her parents. And though they both agree it's time to move into a home of their own, she prefers the city while he wants to live in the burbs.

episodes.title: Property Brothers: Kyle & Jackie
episodes.description: Kyle and Jackie are living at her mom's until they find a home of their own. And though they've got a healthy budget, they've set their sights on one of the city's priciest neighborhoods.

episodes.title: Property Brothers: Emily & Ken
episodes.description: With a baby on the way, Emily and Ken are searching for the perfect suburban home close to family. And since their condo sold more quickly than expected, they're crashing in her sister's basement until they find 'the one'.

episodes.title: Property Brothers - Amanda & Tre
episodes.description: Tre and Amanda have been living in a rental for nearly three years, and as the kids get bigger their temporary home is getting smaller. They're ready to find a place of their own and are determined to stay in their exclusive lakefront community.

episodes.description: In order to cut down on his monster commute, George and Jenn want to move closer to family and friends. And while that's something they both agree on, they're miles apart when it comes to design.

As more people disappear throughout the city, the Internet becomes a breeding ground for malevolent spirits. Three seemingly disconnected stories follow Michi (Kumiko Asô), Ryosuke (Haruhiko Katô) and Harue (Koyuki) as they attempt to solve the mystery behind the ghostly visions that are seeping beyond their computer monitors.

titles.title: Puppet Master: The Littlest Reich

titles.title: Pusher
titles.description: As a heroin dealer in Copenhagen, Frank (Kim Bodnia) is far from the top but earns good money pushing with a friend (Mads Mikkelsen). When he decides to up the ante, Frank goes to Milo (Zlatko Buric), a drug lord -- except he doesn't have enough money for the heroin. Instead, Milo fronts him the goods upon the condition of immediate repayment. But when Frank goes to make the deal, and the police arrive, he has to ditch the drugs. Now Frank has to find a way to repay Milo if he wants to live.

titles.title: Pusher II: With Blood on My Hands

titles.title: Pusher III: I'm the Angel of Death
titles.description: Milo (Zlatko Buric) is a drug dealer and recovering addict who's slowly coming unraveled. While trying to prepare for his daughter Milena's (Marinela Dekic) birthday party, he discovers the shipment of heroin he was expecting is actually Ecstasy. Milo gives the pills to small-fry dealer Mohammed (Ilyas Agac) and, as the party begins, starts using narcotics again. Things go from bad to worse when Mohammad doesn't return, and Milo's Albanian connection demands payment for the Ecstasy.

titles.title: Putney Swope
titles.description: When its chairman dies, an advertising firm's executive board must elect someone to fill the position. Each member, unable to vote for himself, casts a secret ballot for Putney Swope (Arnold Johnson), the firm's only black executive, assuming he wouldn't receive any votes from the other members. But once in power, Swope makes radical changes to the firm -- like keeping only one white employee and refusing to advertise harmful products -- all under the firm's new moniker, "Truth and Soul, Inc."

titles.title: Rectify
titles.description: Sundance Channel's first wholly owned scripted series stars Aden Young as Daniel Holden, who spends nearly 20 years on death row for the rape and murder of a teenage girl, before new DNA evidence nullifies his conviction. He returns home, but he's far from welcomed. He's an outsider now in a town that remains divided by his alleged crime, and contributing to his uncertain future is the man who prosecuted him -- riding that notoriety to become a state senator -- is plotting to reopen the case. As he struggles to adapt, Daniel is comforted by support from his younger sister, Amantha, who has always believed in his innocence and has worked her entire adult life to secure his release. Not so for Ted Jr., Daniel's stepbrother with whom he has no relationship. Insecure and manipulative, Ted is skeptical of Daniel's motives and will do anything to protect his family.

titles.description: In ancient China, the emperor of the Han Dynasty allows General Cao Cao (Fengyi Zhang) to declare war against the rebellious southern provinces, with the intention of unifying the entire country. Cao's large army quickly advances, killing civilians and soldiers alike. To resist Cao, the southern warlords form an alliance led by Viceroy Zhou Yu (Tony Leung). Outnumbered, Zhou relies upon elaborate formations and unorthodox strategies to fight against Cao's overwhelming forces.

But this film is more than just a Christian testimonial; with insight provided by music legends like Smokey Robinson and Mavis Staples and copious doses of archival footage, it explores the history of gospel. Chronicling the genre from its early 20th-century beginnings up to the present day, the documentary also shows that the art form isn't strictly meant for the pious.

titles.title: Ride
titles.description: Struggling actor James pays his bills by driving people around Los Angeles for a ride-sharing service. James' shift starts out like any other, until he hits it off with a beautiful woman whom he picks up. His next fare, the fast-talking Bruno, convinces James to invite her along for a wild night out. But things take a shocking turn when Bruno, armed with a gun and a twisted idea of fun, initiates a terrifying, white-knuckle ride that quickly spirals out of control.

titles.title: Ride With Norman Reedus
titles.description: The soft spots that fans of "The Walking Dead" have for Norman Reedus, who portrays volatile survivalist Daryl Dixon on the mega-popular series, is sure to grow after Reedus opens up on the open road. In "Ride With Norman Reedus," the motorcycle enthusiast hops on his favorite two wheelers to explore local bike culture and celebrate the best collectors, mechanics and motorcycle craftsmen around the country. Each hourlong episode begins in a different city, where Reedus hooks up with a riding companion -- an actor, musician, friend or local motorcycle fan -- to visit places like custom bike shops, tattoo parlors, collectors' depots, and roadside smokehouses. There's ample time for impromptu detours and tire changes, too.

episodes.description: From his travels, Norman Reedus has discovered it's the people who make the journey; he looks back on those he's met and the lessons he's learned throughout the world with guests Jeffrey Dean Morgan, Melissa McBride, Ryan Hurst, and Milo Ventimiglia.

episodes.title: The Road Less Traveled: Behind the Scenes
episodes.description: Norman Reedus joins the crew as they revisit their most unusual and surprising experiences on the road throughout the years, telling behind-the-scenes stories and pulling the curtains back to reveal what it took to get there.

episodes.title: The Utah Desert With Keanu Reeves
episodes.description: The soft spots that fans of "The Walking Dead" have for Norman Reedus, who portrays volatile survivalist Daryl Dixon on the mega-popular series, is sure to grow after Reedus opens up on the open road. In "Ride With Norman Reedus," the motorcycle enthusiast hops on his favorite two wheelers to explore local bike culture and celebrate the best collectors, mechanics and motorcycle craftsmen around the country. Each hourlong episode begins in a different city, where Reedus hooks up with a riding companion -- an actor, musician, friend or local motorcycle fan -- to visit places like custom bike shops, tattoo parlors, collectors' depots, and roadside smokehouses. There's ample time for impromptu detours and tire changes, too.

episodes.title: Northern Italy With Josh Holloway
episodes.description: Actor Josh Holloway joins Norman Reedus for a ride through rustic Northern Italy; navigating through some of the most scenic roads in Europe, they quench their need for speed in Motor Valley before exploring Josh's old stomping grounds in Bologna.

episodes.title: The Eternal City With Johnny Knoxville
episodes.description: Accompanied by actor Johnny Knoxville, Norman Reedus navigates his way through ancient Rome, the eternal city; taking in the cuisine and culture of the birthplace of Western Civilization.

episodes.title: Portugal: A Journey From Lisbon to Porto
episodes.description: Norman Reedus and artist Adri Law explore one of Europe's hottest destinations: Portugal; on a scenic ride up the country's western shoreline, they discover the impact the recent tourist boom has had on this old world country.

titles.title: Riders of Death Valley
titles.description: Cowboys and a businessman compete to find lost treasure.

episodes.title: Blood and Gold
episodes.description: Cowboys and a businessman compete to find lost treasure.

episodes.title: Death Marks the Trail
episodes.description: Jim Benton leads a group of vigilantes called the "Riders of Death Valley" that protect the local miners from the evil plans of Joseph Kirby and Rance Davis.

episodes.title: Flaming Fury
episodes.description: Some Easterners intend to seize a tract of valuable timber land; Hoppy must try to stop them before they blow up a major dam.

episodes.title: Plunge of Peril
episodes.description: In the split moment before the overtaking of the herd reaches him, Benton vaults to his saddle and safety, leaving Reade's men scattered and believing him dead.

episodes.title: The Avalanche of Doom
episodes.description: When the showboat hits town, two men use the parade as a distraction to rob the bank; their accomplice is Pop, the clown from the showboat.

episodes.title: The Menacing Herd
episodes.description: When Lucky spots Steve Langdon, a dead ringer for Collins, he arrests him.

titles.title: Riders of the Whistling Pines
titles.description: The discovery of an invasive insect species threatens his logging business, so Bill Wright (Damian O'Flynn) murders a forest ranger to keep him from reporting his findings. Local hunter Gene Autry (Gene Autry), who had been nearby, shooting at a mountain lion, thinks he may have been responsible for the ranger's death and takes over his job out of a sense of duty to the man's daughter (Patricia White). Gene and his sidekick, Joe Lucas (Jimmy Lloyd), battle Wright and his men to save the forest.

titles.title: Ridin' On
titles.description: A cowboy (Tom Tyler) helps the daughter (Geraine Greer) of his father's (John Elliott) rival (Earl Dwire).

titles.title: Riding the Ocean Dragon
titles.description: China's first major expedition to the depths of the Indian Ocean in the world's deepest diving three-person research submarine.

titles.title: Ring of Fire
titles.description: June Carter (Jewel) rises to fame as a country singer, while falling in love with the legendary Johnny Cash (Matt Ross).

titles.title: Riotsville, U.S.A.
titles.description: Connecting the stagecraft of law and order to the real violence of state practice; recovering an obscured history whose effects have shaped the present in ways both insidious and explosive.

titles.title: Rites of Passage
titles.description: Anthropology students and their professor (Stephen Dorff) experience terror when they visit a sacred burial ground.

titles.title: River Runs Red
titles.description: A vengeful judge takes the law into his own hands when two cops kill his young son during a routine traffic stop.

titles.title: Road Games
titles.description: An Australian trucker (Stacy Keach) picks up a hitchhiking heiress (Jamie Lee Curtis) and the trail of a killer in a green van.

titles.title: Road to Utopia
titles.description: During the Alaskan gold rush, beautiful young Sal (Dorothy Lamour) travels to Alaska on the trail of the pair of thugs (Nestor Paiva, Robert Barrat) who murdered her father and stole the map to his gold mine. Meanwhile, genial con men Chester (Bob Hope) and Duke (Bing Crosby) unwittingly steal the wanted men's identities and get involved in an escalating series of mistaken identities and double-crosses involving Sal, the real thieves and avaricious bar owner Ace (Douglas Dumbrille).

titles.title: Road Wars
titles.description: Roadways can be a wild, dangerous and unpredictable place; with violent road rage incidents increasing 500% over the last decade, "road raging" is a human behavior that has become widely known and is one of the many threats to everyone on the road; "Road Wars" takes a deep dive into American roadways, examining extreme human behavior, wild weather and insane accidents causing trouble for drivers all over the country; the series is not all rage and fury, as welcome acts of kindness also tend to arise in these dire situations.

episodes.title: Runaway Cowboy
episodes.description: A cowboy takes his mule on a getaway ride from police in Kentucky; a family in Michigan takes on an erratic driver by diving into his window; a malfunctioning railroad gate in Poland traps a van on the tracks; a lane-splitting motorcyclist collides with a lane-changing driver on an overpass in Texas; a driver in Wisconsin fails to heed cross traffic at a stop sign.

episodes.title: Parking Space Invaders
episodes.description: A family's fierce defense of a parking space turns contentious with Florida officers; an SUV passes on the shoulder of a Virginia freeway with disastrous results; a motorist in China is run over by his own sedan; a car carrier's cargo bursts into flames in a New Jersey parking lot; a glitchy stop sign on a school bus causes a traffic jam in New York.

episodes.title: This Boot Was Made For Drivin'
episodes.description: A driver clashes with parking enforcement as they boot his car in Chicago; a stunting biker on a Missouri highway gets a furious response from a pickup; a woman suffers a medical emergency on a Michigan freeway with her child in the car; a California woman loses her phone while filming out her sunroof; a plane attempts an emergency landing on a car-filled Florida interstate.

titles.title: Roadie
titles.description: After losing his longtime job with Blue Oyster Cult, a stagehand (Ron Eldard) returns to his hometown, where a night of partying with old friends shows him that some things never change.

titles.title: Roads
titles.description: A young man from the Congo teams up with a British runaway in Morocco, and they take a road trip in a stolen vehicle to France, encountering poverty and refugees and having to make decisions that will influence the lives of others.

titles.title: Roarin' Lead
titles.description: The Three Mesquiteers (Robert Livingston, Ray Corrigan, Max Terhune) round up rustlers and save an orphanage.

titles.title: Robert Kennedy: In the Shadow of Success
titles.description: Born Robert Francis Kennedy, on November 20, 1925, and brother to the 36th President of the United States of America, Robert was a candidate in the 1968 presidential election; however, his winning streak came to an abrupt end.

titles.title: Robert Kirkman's Secret History of Comics
titles.description: Executive producer Robert Kirkman ("The Walking Dead") is, first and foremost, a comic creator. His love for the craft knows no bounds, he says, and he shares that passion in this documentary series. The six hourlong episodes deep-dive into the stories, people and events that have transformed the world of comic books. Among those featured in interviews are Stan Lee, Patty Jenkins, Lynda Carter, Kevin Smith, Famke Janssen, J.K. Simmons, Michelle Rodriguez, and Todd McFarlane, among many others.

episodes.description: Seven renegade artists shock the comic-book industry by starting their own company, Image Comics, to rival giants Marvel and DC.

titles.description: An in-depth look into the groundbreaking franchise and featuring new interviews with cast and crew, including Hollywood icons such as Peter Weller, Diane Robin, Ronny Cox, Nancy Allen, Ray Wise, director Paul Verhoeven & more.

episodes.description: With the production in full swing, director Paul Verhoeven is pushing the envelope and many people's buttons; the shoot is heating up, and with the unprecedented filming conditions, the cast and crew are pushed to their limits.

episodes.title: Blood, Sweat and Steel
episodes.description: Featuring first-hand accounts from the cast and crew, as they relive the golden era of hands-on, practical filmmaking in the 1980s.

episodes.title: Murphy and The Machine
episodes.description: "The Creation of RoboCop" shows the franchise's impact on the action and science fiction genres, blazing a trail alongside "The Terminator," into the technologically driven cinema scape we see today.

titles.title: Rock the Kasbah
titles.description: While visiting Kabul, Afghanistan, washed-up music manager Richie Lanz (Bill Murray) gets dumped by his last client. His luck changes when he meets Salima Khan (Leem Lubany), a Pashtun teenager with a beautiful voice who dreams of becoming the first female to compete on the television show "Afghan Star." With help from a savvy hooker (Kate Hudson), two war profiteers and a trigger-happy mercenary (Bruce Willis), Richie embarks on a mission to make sure his new protégée gets discovered.

titles.title: Romulus, My Father
titles.description: A woman's (Franka Potente) increasingly erratic behavior affects her husband (Eric Bana), her lover (Russell Dykstra) and her son (Kodi Smit-McPhee).

titles.title: Ronin Warriors
titles.description: Five champions in mystical armor strive to defeat a dark emperor and his four warlords to save the world from domination.

episodes.title: Splitting the Stone
episodes.description: Five champions in mystical armor strive to defeat a dark emperor and his four warlords to save the world from domination.

episodes.title: Friend or Foe
episodes.description: Before they can rendezvous with Sage, Kento and Mia, Ryo and Cye set out to rescue Rowen from Dais, who casts illusions that turn the warriors against each other.

episodes.title: Wildfire in the Sky
episodes.description: The team splits up to learn what Talpa has planned for Rowen, who is lost somewhere in space, hoping they can find a way to reach Rowen before Talpa's forces eliminate him.

episodes.title: In the Sea of the Sky
episodes.description: Ryo attempts to break free of the dark matrix before it crushes him while his allies on the ground battle Talpa's forces; Anubis shows signs of defiance toward Talpa.

episodes.title: Assault on the Dynasty
episodes.description: Dais plots to lure the heroes into a trap within the castle gates and separate them from their armor, leaving it up to Mia, Ully and White Blaze to come to the rescue.

episodes.title: Shallow Darkness
episodes.description: As the heroes approach Talpa's castle, the enemy attacks and succeeds in splitting up the team; Sage, Ully and Mia encounter Cale in the subway, but the lack of light underground prevents Sage from using his full power.

episodes.title: Fate of the Ronin Armor
episodes.description: Kento and Rowen meet up in the subway and search for the others while Talpa enacts a plan to turn the heroes to evil based on his knowledge of their armors' dark origins.

episodes.title: Armor of Life
episodes.description: Despite Anubis' previous failure to follow Talpa's orders, Talpa dispatches him to an amusement park where the heroes have gathered; Kento tries to fight without his armor, fearing that using it will turn him against his friends.

episodes.title: The Ancient's Battle
episodes.description: The Ancient One reveals the nature of the mystical armors and their relationship to good and evil; as Anubis rethinks his loyalty to Talpa, Talpa's other warlords launch an attack.

episodes.title: Raid on Talpa's Castle
episodes.description: The Ancient One helps the heroes reach Talpa's castle and the team faces the combined might of the dark forces in an attempt to break through and face Talpa himself.

episodes.title: The Legend of the Armor
episodes.description: Talpa easily defeats Ryo and integrates his warlords' armors into his own form, directly attacking the heroes to steal their armors for himself.

episodes.title: Talpa's Triumph
episodes.description: With the powers of all the other armors at his command, Talpa confronts Ryo, the only remaining warrior, who must find a way to defeat Talpa without destroying his captured friends.

episodes.title: Wildfire's Fight Against Fate
episodes.description: As Ryo fights to keep Talpa from absorbing him into his armor, the Ancient One tells Ryo about Talpa's origins and helps Ryo understand the armors can be used for good as long as the heroes stay determined to fight against evil.

episodes.title: Ronin vs. Saranbo
episodes.description: Despite vanquishing Talpa and restoring the city and its people, the heroes remain unsettled due to the lingering evil forces and the toll the Inferno Armor is taking on Ryo; a new threat named Saranbo arrives to claim the armor for himself.

episodes.title: Ryo's Mega Armor
episodes.description: Saranbo gathers forces to prepare to go after Ryo's armor; full of regret and not wanting his friends to get hurt in his defense, a weakened Ryo abandons the team over Mia's objections to face Saranbo alone.

episodes.title: Saber Stryke's Deadly Challenge
episodes.description: Mia finds evidence in her grandfather's notes of special swords Ryo can use with his new armor; Lord Saber Stryke and his tiger attack the heroes over possession of the swords.

episodes.title: White Blaze's Sacrifice
episodes.description: With the heroes determined to get the Soul Swords from Lord Saber Stryke, but unable to stand up to him in combat, White Blaze risks his life to steal the swords for Ryo.

episodes.title: Sun Devil: Ambassador of Evil
episodes.description: On the way to investigate a volcanic eruption that was mysteriously halted by ice, the heroes encounter a new villain who wants to test their strength.

episodes.title: Torrent's Evil Twin
episodes.description: As Ryo struggles with getting a grip on the intense power of his armor and swords, Sekhmet creates an evil duplicate of Cye to subdue the real one.

episodes.title: The Armor Must Be Destroyed
episodes.description: Sage fights a battle of wills when he returns to the place where his armor was forged and confronts Cale, who attempts to convince him he is capable of great evil.

episodes.title: Sand Blasted
episodes.description: Talpa dispatches Dais to capture Kento, the strongest of the heroes, who must learn to rely on more than his brute strength to win fights.

episodes.title: Lady Kayura and the Dark Realm
episodes.description: Rowen and Ryo encounter Lady Kayura and learn Talpa's forces have captured their friends, and must fight her to avoid the same fate.

episodes.title: Anubis Is Reborn
episodes.description: The Ancient One's reappearance troubles Lady Kayura; as Ryo and Rowen seek a way into the Nether Realm to rescue their friends, they encounter a familiar face who pledges to help them.

episodes.title: Talpa Turns the Tide
episodes.description: Anubis attempts to gain Mia and Ully's trust and explains his past; Ryo and Rowen enter the Nether World in search of the other heroes; Talpa uses the energy of the captive heroes to create a new weapon.

titles.title: Ryan's Mystery Playdate
titles.description: This live-action series stars 7-year-old internet sensation Ryan, whose YouTube channel has grown to become one of the world's largest with videos that feature him and his family playing with toys for kids. The Nickelodeon program sees the unboxing phenom tackle a series of imaginative, physical challenges and solve puzzles to reveal the identity of his play dates. Co-starring are Ryan's parents, and proprietary animated characters, including Gus the Gummy Gator and Combo Panda, also make appearances. The series encourages physical play, models positive family relationships and features a creative problem-solving curriculum.

titles.title: S.W.A.T. Exiles
titles.description: After a fatal shooting on the job leaves his career hanging by a thread, LAPD S.W.A.T. Sergeant Daniel "Hondo" Harrelson is forced into retirement, in retaliation for refusing to bury the truth. Two years later, he's back, tasked with building a new tactical unit from the department's most talented outcasts. The team, soon nicknamed the Exiles, includes a live-streaming hotshot, a socially awkward tech genius, a fiercely disciplined operator with something to prove, a wildcard with a troubled past, and a strategist with a hidden agenda. As the squad finds its footing under fire, Hondo uncovers something far more dangerous than any street threat: a mole in his ranks, and a conspiracy reaching into the LAPD's top brass and the Mayor's office; one built to tear S.W.A.T. apart from within.

The athletes met as students at the University of Texas and tied the knot in 2010. A docuseries follows the couple through their busy lives. Besides being a world-class athlete, Sanya is a partner in Austin, Texas, salon The Hair Clinic with her sister, Shari. Sanya's passion for the salon, her first big business investment, shines through in everything she does and failure isn't an option. Assisting her is "Team SRR," her name for her management team, which includes father and manager Archie; mother Sharon -- who also is Sanya's agent -- and cousin/publicist/stylist Yolande.

titles.title: Sex Box
titles.description: Rather than thinking outside the box, couples featured on this series are going inside a box in an attempt to save their troubled relationships. Each episode begins with the couple speaking candidly to a panel of experts -- psychotherapist Fran Walfish, certified sex therapist Chris Donaghue, and pastor/couples' counselor Yvonne Capehart -- about their intimacy issues. After getting the initial advice, the couple must decide whether to go into a camera-free, soundproof box located on the set, and in front of the studio audience, in which they have a private lovemaking session. That is followed by another, more revealing discussion with the panel -- because it is believed that people are more trusting and open after making love. In the end, each couple's goal is to solve their problems and save the relationship. Comic Danielle Stewart also joins the show to provide commentary and conduct on-the-street interviews.

titles.title: Showville
titles.description: Main Street, USA, is where "Showville" is playing, a celebration of everyday Americans' passion for performing. The series highlights local talent of all ages in small towns across the country -- singers, dancers, comedy acts, jugglers and other performers who compete to appear in their towns' talent shows. In each episode, actor Alec Mapa and choreographer Lisette Bustamante host open auditions in one town, select four finalists, and have two days to mentor them. The final competition takes place at a well-known town venue filled with locals, who are ultimately responsible for selecting the best act. The winner receives $10,000, a cup to signify the achievement, and a moment to cherish for a lifetime.

titles.title: Sisters In Law
titles.description: This Houston-based series profiles several black, female attorneys who tackle some of the toughest legal cases in Texas. The women, some of whom have known one another for decades, form a tight bond to help themselves succeed in a male-dominated profession. The featured women include Jolanda, who aims to provide justice for poor defendants; criminal lawyer Vivian, who went to law school at age 30 after leaving her banking career; civil attorney Rhonda, who specializes in class-action lawsuits and has won cases in front of the U.S. Supreme Court; public defender Juanita, who has handled over 2500 cases and was previously a partner in a firm with Rhonda; criminal attorney Monique, who has grown to enjoy being able to help people get out of tough situations; and civil lawyer Tiye, the wife of a well-known attorney.

titles.title: Small Town Security
titles.description: The unscripted "Small Town Security" follows the workplace drama of a small, family-run security and private investigation company in rural Georgia called JJK Security. While the day-to-day operations are depicted, the heartbeat of the series is found in the oddball behavior of JJK's colorful employees, led by the hilarious and inappropriate Joan Koplan, otherwise called "The Chief." There's also Joan's old-school, charming husband, Irwin; straight-laced detective and process server Brian Taylor; flighty office secretary Christa Stephens; and "The Lieutenant," Dennis Croft, who Joan reveals in the premiere episode used to be a woman. No wonder AMC describes the show as "a cross between Christopher Guest's brilliant films and the sublime absurdity of `The Office.' ".

titles.title: Soul to Soul

In 1971, several prominent African-Americans convinced the government of Ghana to hold a gala concert to commemorate that nation's 14th anniversary of independence. Some of the big American names participating in the resulting 14-hour event are Santana, Wilson Pickett and Roberta Flack, while African artists are represented by such acts as Kofi Ghanaba and the Kumasi Drummers.

titles.description: In the very near future, a test is developed that incontrovertibly lets a person know who their soulmate is. The new science is clear, and no matter a person's current relationship status, whether they are single, dating or even married, this test will unmistakably point a person in the direction of their actual, scientifically determined soulmate. People in long-term relationships should not be content in believing they've already made the right choice. Even if a person seems to be deep in love with their current partner, this test may just prove that they are mistaken. After all, science knows best.

Encouraged by Sparkle's boyfriend, Stix (Philip Michael Thomas), the three form a singing group and become a sensation at a local nightclub. However, tensions rise when Sister is appointed the group's lead singer and begins dating Satin (Tony King), an abusive, drug-addicted pimp.

titles.title: Spooks Run Wild
titles.description: The East Side Kids are sent to summer camp, and shortly after arriving they encounter a mysterious man named Nardo (Bela Lugosi). Naturally, the Kids assume Nardo is the "monster killer" they've been warned about. Their theory is strengthened when they see Peewee (David Gorcey), seemingly risen from the dead after getting shot, walking around Nardo's house in a zombie-like trance. The Kids take it upon themselves to capture Nardo before he can kill anyone else.

titles.title: Springtime in the Rockies
titles.description: Just out of animal husbandry school, Sandra Knight (Polly Rowles) boldly decides to make changes on the ranch she has just inherited, and to raise sheep instead of cattle. Experienced foreman Gene Autry (Gene Autry) tries to warn her against this hasty conversion, but Sandra stubbornly ignores his advice. Before long, her business is failing, and she may be forced to sell to the shifty Briggs (Al Bridge). However, Gene has a plan that he hopes can set things right just in time.

titles.title: Sprung
titles.description: Clyde (Joe Torry) and his photographer pal Montel (Rusty Cundieff) meet gold digger Adina (Paula Jai Parker) and her friend Brandy (Tisha Campbell), a law student, at a party. While Clyde convinces Adina that he's wealthy, Montel and Brandy pair off and get along well. Adina is furious when she learns Clyde has misled her, but when they learn their friends plan to marry -- which would force the two enemies to spend time together -- they put their differences aside to thwart the marriage.

titles.title: Spy Intervention
titles.description: The world's greatest spy decides to abandon his adventurous lifestyle for the woman of his dreams. But when a madman tries to secure a devastating weapon, he soon gives up his boring existence to save not only the world -- but his listless marriage.

titles.title: Square Grouper: The Godfathers of Ganja
titles.description: Filmmakers examine the 1970s and '80s pot-smuggling culture in South Florida, where the coastline and proximity to the Caribbean and Latin America made the location ideal for trafficking.

titles.title: Stage Fright
titles.description: A rehearsal for a play based on a real serial killer turns chaotic when the escaped felon comes for the curtain call.

titles.title: Stagecoach
titles.description: John Ford's landmark Western revolves around an assorted group of colorful passengers aboard the Overland stagecoach bound for Lordsburg, New Mexico, in the 1880s. An alcoholic philosophizer (Thomas Mitchell), a lady of ill repute (Claire Trevor) and a timid liquor salesman (Donald Meek) are among the motley crew of travelers who must contend with an escaped outlaw, the Ringo Kid (John Wayne), and the ever-present threat of an Apache attack as they make their way across the Wild West.

titles.title: Stake Land
titles.description: After a plague turns America into a realm of vampires, a hunter (Nick Damici) of the depraved creatures travels cross-country with an orphan (Connor Paolo) he rescued, searching for a safe haven.

titles.title: Stalked by a Reality Star
titles.description: Kendra is thrilled to meet Brad, a handsome TV star, at a party. When she discovers that Brad is not as charming as he seems, Kendra rejects him, only to realize that he has become obsessed with her and will stop at nothing to be near her.

titles.title: Stan Against Evil
titles.description: John C. McGinley ("Scrubs") stars in this comedy-horror series as sour, judgmental sheriff Stan Miller, who is forced to give up his job because of an angry outburst at a most inopportune moment -- his wife's funeral. Relinquishing authority doesn't come easily for Stan, especially after he finds out he must make way for Evie Barret, the strong-willed and beautiful new sheriff. However, when both soon realize something is not quite right in their sleepy New Hampshire town -- which just so happens to be built on the site of a massive 17th-century witch burning -- Stan and Evie form an unlikely alliance to bravely battle a plague of spine-chilling demons.

episodes.title: Know, Know, Know Your Goat
episodes.description: Stan's daughter, Denise, goes blueberry picking and comes home with a pet goat, which also just happens to be a demon.

episodes.title: Let Your Love Groan
episodes.description: Stan, Evie and Denise go speed dating and suddenly find themselves involved with their perfect match; they also find themselves growing weak and rapidly aging.

episodes.title: Life Orr Death
episodes.description: Evie attempts to rescue Stan's prized possession, his Bobby Orr hockey stick, from the church donation pile, only to find herself transported into the spirit world where she too, is on trial for witchcraft.

episodes.title: Ouija Bored
episodes.description: A strange crop of flowers starts growing in town, with each bloom bringing a new supernatural horror; Evie attempts to summon Stan's dead wife, Claire, to help her stop them.

episodes.title: I'm Gleaning My Coven
episodes.description: Denise gets mixed up with a group of goth kids who come to town hoping to contact a demon; the goth kids succeed in contacting a demon and Denise finds herself possessed by it, creating a tricky situation for Stan.

episodes.title: Spider Walk With Me
episodes.description: A mysterious stranger shows up at Stan's door with knowledge of the curse he and Evie are fighting; Willard's Mill residents start getting killed by a giant spider.

episodes.title: Level Boss
episodes.description: A mysterious girl runs out into the street, forcing Evie to swerve into a fatal car accident that she must relive over and over and over again.

episodes.title: Black Hat Society Part 1
episodes.description: Stan begins to solve the mystery of Evie's disappearance and along the way, he meets the descendants of a Wiccan coven known as the Black Hat Society; Stan and the coven discover a disturbing way to bring Evie home.

episodes.title: Black Hat Society Part 2
episodes.description: Stan travels back in time to save Evie, not a moment too soon, as she's in a high stakes situation; Evie's rescue hinges on whether Stan can sacrifice a trusted friend in the modern day.

episodes.title: Curse of the Werepony
episodes.description: Evie's ex-husband, Kenny, visits with a new pony and the same old tricks; Stan befriends Kenny until he discovers his unsightly qualities; a mysterious stranger visits Willard's Mill.

episodes.title: Girls' Night
episodes.description: Stan gets trapped in a life-or-death bar bet; Evie and Denise watch a dating show finale that may or may not be hypnotizing them into killing each other.

episodes.title: The Eyes of Evie Barret
episodes.description: Evie buys an antique ring and then starts dreaming of killing people, who turn up dead; Leon kills a dude who may or may not have already been dead.

episodes.title: Hex Marks the Tot
episodes.description: Denise takes a nanny job for a demon baby who feeds off her affection; Kevin gets beaten up by a baby, which is not a coincidence.

episodes.title: Mirror Mirror
episodes.description: Stan summons a spirit to help him travel back in time to save Claire, and in the process, an evil replica is created who thinks only of murder; real Stan must commit an unthinkable crime to complete his time travel mission.

episodes.title: A Hard Day's Night
episodes.description: Stan travels back in time to save Claire, and he succeeds, but dies in the process, forcing Evie to go back and save him; Leon loses his head over a new gal.

episodes.title: Hell Is What You Make It
episodes.description: Evie is arrested for murder and committed to a psychiatric hospital; Stan attempts to rescue her, but everyone thinks he's a demon; there may be a new way to free the souls cursed by Constable Eccles.

episodes.title: The Hex Files
episodes.description: Two eerily familiar paranormal investigators arrive to investigate the Black Hat Society; Stan searches for a bigger evil ally that could help defeat Constable Eccles.

episodes.title: Larva My Life
episodes.description: A disgraced birthday entertainer disrupts the peace in Willard's Mill; Evie's ex-husband, Kenny, comes to town; he transforms into a caterpillar monster and terrorizes Willard's Mill.

episodes.title: The Demon Who Came in From the Heat
episodes.description: A murderous hitchhiker terrorizes Willard's Mill; Stan befriends a laid back demon and attempts to find a spell that will free the souls captured by Constable Eccles; Denise and Kevin go on a date.

episodes.title: Nubbin but Trouble
episodes.description: An antique store owner is murdered by an evil puppet that begins summoning spirits from hell; Stan brews homemade beer with a debilitating side effect.

episodes.title: Vampire Creek
episodes.description: Denise believes she's won a contest, but instead gets trapped in the fictional world of Vampire Creek, a TV show about teenage vampires; Stan, Evie and Kevin must find and rescue her before she is turned into a vampire.

episodes.title: Intensive Scare Unit
episodes.description: Stan goes for a prostate exam but must escape when the hospital turns demonic.

episodes.title: Stan Against Evie
episodes.description: Haurus demands Stan kill Evie in return for killing Constable Eccles and ending the curse on Willard's Mill; another demon tells Stan how to defeat Haurus, but the cost could be high.

titles.title: Stan Helsing
titles.description: Stan (Steve Howey), a slacker video store clerk, his sexy girlfriend, best friend and an exotic dancer take a detour into a town cursed by the biggest monsters in movie history.

titles.title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
titles.description: As Adm. James T. Kirk (William Shatner) and Capt. Spock (Leonard Nimoy) monitor trainees at Starfleet Academy, another vessel from the United Federation of Planets is about to try out the planet-creating Genesis Device in a seemingly deserted portion of space. In the process, two of Kirk's officers are captured by Khan (Ricardo Montalban), an enemy Kirk thought he'd never see again. Once more, Kirk takes the Enterprise's helm, where he meets Khan's ship in an intergalactic showdown.

titles.title: Star Trek: The Motion Picture
titles.description: The Federation calls on Adm. James T. Kirk (William Shatner) and the crew of the Starship Enterprise to contain an immense nimbused object that's on a crash course with Earth. After investigating, the crew discovers that the alien cloud harbors artificial intelligence with an ominous primary directive. Crisis strikes when a probe dispatched by the energy cloud attacks the crew, abducting navigator Lt. Ilia (Persis Khambatta). An android look-alike containing her memories shows up soon after.

titles.title: Starry Eyes
titles.description: A woman's pursuit of Hollywood stardom puts her on a collision course with a satanic cult.

titles.title: Staten Island Cakes
titles.description: Vinny Buzzetta is a 20-something baking prodigy, having graduated first in his class from New York's prestigious French Culinary Institute at the age of 18 (at the time, the school's youngest graduate). The Brooklyn-born foodie has always had a passion for chocolate and a dream to own his own bakery. When he saw a vacant storefront while driving through Staten Island a few months after he graduated, he decided that was the perfect location for his dream bakery, which he opened thanks in part to financial support from his Grandpa Joe (affectionately known in the community as "Crazy Joe"). Since then, the bakery, The Cake Artist, has thrived and become the go-to bakery for weddings and other special occasions in the area. Even though he's a successful business owner, Vinny still lives at home with his parents, including meddling mom Cammy, and younger siblings. This series follows Vinny and his staff as they work at the bakery and he deals with his personal relationships.

titles.title: Static Shock
titles.description: Accidental exposure to an experimental mutagen leaves geeky high school student Virgil with super powers. Able to control electromagnetic forces, he channels his newfound powers to fight evil, aided by his pal Osgood, who builds gadgets to help Virgil fight crime.

episodes.title: Out of Africa

titles.title: Steel Monsters

episodes.title: Super Strength Kick Ass Tow Trucks
episodes.description: An introduction to some of the biggest, heaviest and deadliest machines ever developed and built for very specific "mega tasks."

episodes.title: Antonov AN-225
episodes.description: Thanks to six powerful turbines, the Antonov An-225 flies loads of up to 250 tons; the plane was originally destined to transport the Soviet space shuttle Buran back to Kazakhstan; when the space program ended, it was converted into a cargo plane.

titles.title: Step
titles.description: The senior year of a girls' high school step team in inner-city Baltimore is documented, as they try to become the first in their families to attend college. The girls strive to make their dancing a success against the backdrop of social unrest.

titles.title: Stepfather II
titles.description: After cheating death by surviving being both stabbed and shot, psychotic killer Jerry (Terry O'Quinn) is placed in a mental institution, but he soon murders his doctor and escapes. titles.title: Survivor's Remorse
titles.description: Cam Calloway is about to find out the price he'll pay for stardom, love and loyalty. A basketball star in his early 20s, Calloway's life changes after he signs a multimillion-dollar contract with a team in Atlanta. He arrives in Georgia bright-eyed and eager to begin his career, joined by cousin and confidant Reggie Vaughn, who tries to keep Cam focused and free from distractions caused by Cam's blunt-but-loyal sister M-Chuck and opportunistic mom Cassie. Feeling a responsibility to support needy family and friends, Cam wrestles with the rewards and pitfalls of sudden wealth and fame. "Survivor's Remorse" is a half-hour comedy series executive produced by Mike O'Malley ("Yes, Dear") and Tom Werner, among others.
