titles.description: Jill Baker (Merle Oberon) has an incurable case of the hiccups, for which she reluctantly agrees to see a psychologist, Dr. Vengard (Alan Mowbray). During her first visit she realizes her hiccups may be related to nerves about her husband, Larry (Melvyn Douglas). Upon her second visit to the psychologist, she runs into a famous pianist (Burgess Meredith), and her doubts about her marriage are intensified when he starts courting her. Larry carries out a plan to renew his wife's affections.

titles.title: The 12 Days of Christmas Eve
titles.description: Santa gives a successful businessman 12 chances to relive the same day so he can repair his damaged relationships with his loved ones.

titles.title: The 13th Summer
titles.description: During their annual vacation to the beach, Ben and Vee encounter a mysterious hiker who draws them into a twisted web of lies, deceit, revenge and ultimately, murder.

titles.title: The 19th Wife
titles.description: BeckyLyn (Patricia Wettig), a member of a fundamentalist cult, is accused of killing her husband. Queenie (Chyler Leigh), another wife in the sect, thinks she is innocent, and asks her excommunicated son to help solve the case.

titles.title: The 39 Steps
titles.description: While on vacation in London, Canadian Richard Hannay becomes embroiled in an international spy ring related to the mysterious "39 steps." Then he meets agent Annabella Smith, who is soon killed in his apartment. He must elude the police, who are hunting him for murder, while he tries to stop Professor Jordan from sending secrets out of the country. Hannay is assisted by Pamela, an unwilling accomplice who discovers the truth.

titles.title: The 50 Worst Movies Ever Made
titles.description: A look at some of the truly terrible moments in film history. This documentary consists of clips from what many believe to be some of the worst movies ever to make it - or not make it - into theaters.

titles.title: The 6000 Lb Diaries With Dr. Now
titles.description: Following ten morbidly obese individuals who collectively have a combined weight of 6,000 pounds and fight to transform their lives.

episodes.title: Chelsey
episodes.description: Following ten morbidly obese individuals who collectively have a combined weight of 6,000 pounds and fight to transform their lives.

episodes.title: Destinee & Dynastiee -- Part 1
episodes.description: As identical twins, Destinee and Dynastiee have always done everything together, including gaining weight; at over a collective 1200 lbs, they both are determined to get healthy and lose the weight with Now's help.

episodes.title: Destinee & Dynastiee -- Part 2
episodes.description: Destinee and Dynastiee continue their weight loss journey, but after only one of them qualifies for surgery, the thought of moving ahead without the other is too much; they decide to do it together or not at all, knowing if one fails they both fail.

episodes.title: Grace
episodes.description: Grace has always found comfort in food; at over 600 lbs, she decides to join Dr. Now's program; that leads to the hardest decision of her life: to change her relationship with her sisters or lose the closest people in her life to get healthy.

episodes.title: Trista
episodes.description: After losing her son and her marriage, Trista turned to food, reaching over 600 lbs.; ready to heal, she seeks Dr. Now's help.

episodes.title: Caleb
episodes.description: After the deaths in his family, Caleb's struggle with his weight has gotten even worse; at only 20, he's already hit the 800lb mark; Caleb knows his health is reaching a breaking point unless he can get Dr. Now's help before it's too late.

episodes.title: Crystal
episodes.description: After Crystal's weight spiraled out of control, she became bedridden; she has to depend on her father and best friend to take care of her and her teenage daughter; she hopes to get Dr. Now's help, but traveling to him may not be possible for her.

episodes.title: Sam
episodes.description: Sam's dream is to do more with his wife and son, with his weight fast approaching 700 lbs, his body keeps him from doing that; determined to change, he tries to join Dr Now's program to get weight loss surgery before he loses any more time with them.

episodes.title: Lauren
episodes.description: Confined to her apartment for three years, Lauren's near-death experience inspires her to lose weight; Dr. Now is her last hope, but she must overcome his program's challenges to reclaim her life and reconnect with the dreams she thought were lost.

episodes.title: Nefi
episodes.description: At 25 and 626 lbs, Nefi has been a momma's boy his whole life; when he goes to Dr. Now for help, addressing their dynamic becomes the focus; will both of them be able to change their relationship for Nefi to succeed or will old habits win in the end?

titles.title: The ABCs of Death
titles.description: An anthology of stories helmed by more than two dozen directors details 26 ways to die, each corresponding to a different letter of the alphabet.

titles.title: The Achievers: The Story of the Lebowski Fans
titles.description: Fans of the movie "The Big Lebowski" hold annual conventions to celebrate the film with trivia contests, costume competitions and bowling.

titles.title: The Advent Calendar
titles.description: An ex-dancer is given a mysterious advent calendar.

titles.title: The Adventurer
titles.description: The Tramp breaks out of prison, saves a girl and her mother from drowning, and wrecks a swank party.

titles.title: The Adventurer: The Curse of the Midas Box
titles.description: After his parents and brother are kidnapped, a Victorian-era British teen learns about an artifact that can turn anything into gold.

titles.title: The Adventures of Jim Bowie
titles.description: Wealthy planter Jim Bowie relies on the knife he invented after breaking his regular one fighting a bear.

episodes.title: The Birth of the Blade
episodes.description: Wealthy planter Jim Bowie relies on the knife he invented after breaking his regular one fighting a bear.

episodes.title: The Squatter
episodes.description: Jim persuades an imperious plantation owner to allow a squatter and his pregnant wife to remain on her land.

episodes.title: An Adventure With Audubon
episodes.description: Jim is amused when his friend is mistaken for the missing son of King Louis XVI and Marie Antoinette.

episodes.title: Deputy Sheriff
episodes.description: Jim takes a turn as a volunteer deputy to guard a prisoner, but he begins to doubt the prisoner's guilt.

episodes.title: The Trapline
episodes.description: Jim believes a fur company may be trying to drive him away by killing any Cajun trapper with whom he does business.

episodes.title: Broomstick Wedding
episodes.description: A case of mistaken identity leads an angry farmer to decide that Jim must marry his daughter in a shotgun wedding.

episodes.title: Natchez Trace
episodes.description: Jim is asked to protect a group of travelers from a bandit preying on people along the road to Natchez.

episodes.title: Jim Bowie Comes Home
episodes.description: Jim's family takes on the local saloon keeper, who has different visions of the town's future.

episodes.title: Ghost of Jean Battoo
episodes.description: Jim assists farmers who are being forced to pay protection money to an old woman who threatens to unleash the ghost of a Louisiana pirate on them.

episodes.title: Jackson's Assassination
episodes.description: Jim is unwittingly dragged into a plot to assassinate President Jackson.

episodes.title: Gone to Texas
episodes.description: Jim visits the Mexican state of Texas, hoping to buy land, but he's arrested as a spy and sentenced to death.

titles.title: The Adventures of Kit Carson
titles.description: Kit Carson and El Toro right wrongs in the Old West.

episodes.title: The Road to Monterey
episodes.description: Kit Carson and El Toro right wrongs in the Old West.

episodes.title: The Murango Story
episodes.description: Kit and El Toro discover the body of Tad Morton's father.

episodes.title: Law of the Frontier
episodes.description: Outlaw Haggard impersonates the new sheriff of Green Valley to gain access to gold.

episodes.title: Pledge to Danger
episodes.description: A woman summons Kit to search for her missing daughter.

episodes.title: Highway to Doom
episodes.description: Bandits use a cave to store loot from holdups.

episodes.title: Hide-Out
episodes.description: An outlaw plans to take over a ranch and use it as a hideout for his gang.

episodes.title: The Broken Spur
episodes.description: Kit and El Toro (Bill Williams, Don Diamond) are held up by the Slick Ears gang.

episodes.title: Ventura Feud
episodes.description: A woman wielding an odd pair of shears exposes herself as a murderess.

episodes.title: Claim Jumpers
episodes.description: A boss of a gang poses as an assayer in order to trick a man out of his money.

episodes.title: Mask of the Vigilantes
episodes.description: An ex-outlaw decides that crooked politics are more profitable than crime.

titles.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
titles.description: Robin Hood and Maid Marion work to stop the evil Sheriff's thievery and return the King to his rightful throne.

titles.title: The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes
titles.description: A television adaptation of some of Sir Arthur Conan Doyle's popular stories.

episodes.title: The Case of Lady Beryl
episodes.description: A television adaptation of some of Sir Arthur Conan Doyle's popular stories.

episodes.title: The Case of Blind Man's Bluff
episodes.description: A chicken claw tied with black ribbon is left behind at the scene of several murders.

episodes.title: The Case of Harry Crocker
episodes.description: Holmes sets out to prove that a famous escape artist is not a murderer.

episodes.title: The Case of the Split Ticket
episodes.description: Holmes and Watson find Brian O'Casey waiting for them at their flat.

episodes.title: The Case of the Greystone Inscription
episodes.description: Miss Channing seeks Holmes' help after her fiancé disappears at Greystone Castle.

episodes.title: The Case of the Laughing Mummy
episodes.description: Holmes and Watson investigate a mummy that makes strange noises.

episodes.title: The Case of the Deadly Prophecy
episodes.description: People begin dying after a schoolboy writes their names on the church steps.

episodes.title: The Case of the Christmas Pudding
episodes.description: A prisoner escapes shortly after he receives Christmas pudding.

episodes.title: The Case of the Night Train Riddle
episodes.description: Holmes investigates a kidnapping after a circus clown helps a boy escape from a moving train.

episodes.title: The Case of the Baker Street Nursemaids
episodes.description: A delivery boy leaves Holmes with a baby and a mysterious note.

episodes.title: The Case of the Impostor Mystery
episodes.description: Holmes tries to catch an impostor.

episodes.title: The Case of the Exhumed Client
episodes.description: Holmes believes Sir Charles is murdered by one of his heirs.

episodes.title: The Case of the Baker Street Bachelors
episodes.description: Holmes is jailed after visiting the Cupid's Bow Marriage Bureau.

episodes.title: The Case of the Neurotic Detective
episodes.description: Dr. Watson is suspicious of Holmes.

episodes.title: The Case of the Unlucky Gambler
episodes.description: A boy wants to find his missing father.

titles.title: The Adventures of the Wilderness Family
titles.description: Skip Robinson (Robert F. Logan) leads his wife, Pat (Susan Damante Shaw) ; son, Toby (Ham Larsen) ; and daughter, Jenny (Hollye Holmes) on an exodus from the concrete jungle of Los Angeles. At the site of their new home in the majestic Rocky Mountains, Skip builds a log cabin, and the children befriend wild animals. As the intrepid Robinsons make a simpler life for themselves off the grid, they discover that, in the wilderness, each day brings its own adventure.

titles.title: The Age of Hubble
titles.description: An army of high-tech telescopes, led by Hubble in space, has delivered an unprecedented chain of discoveries about how galaxies took shape, how stars live and die, and how life arose.

titles.title: The Alaskans
titles.description: A pair of adventurers are intent on swindling travelers bound for the Yukon Territories during the height of the Klondike Gold Rush.

episodes.title: Peril At Caribou Crossing
episodes.description: A pair of adventurers are intent on swindling travelers bound for the Yukon Territories during the height of the Klondike Gold Rush.

episodes.title: Behind The Moon
episodes.description: No sooner has a gold prospector made plans to marry an Indian girl than his backers plot to chase the Indians off the tribal land. It seems that gold has been discovered there.

episodes.title: Partners
episodes.description: When young Jimmy arrives after his father, a sad failure, has been declared dead, Rocky and Reno tell him his father was a respected success. But when Jimmy overhears Hap being accused of cheating his father and turning him into a bum, he runs away.

episodes.title: Disaster At Gold Hill
episodes.description: Silky takes a mining job to repay borrowed money and finds himself the center of a stormy triangle between Fay, her husband Paul and their partner Arthur. Fay goads her jealous husband to kill Silky so she and Arthur can have the mine and each other.

titles.title: The Amazing Adventure
titles.description: A bored millionaire (Cary Grant) steps into big business without his fortune or position just to prove he can survive on his own.

titles.title: The Ambassador's Daughter
titles.description: Senator Cartwright (Adolphe Menjou) and his wife (Myrna Loy) arrive in Paris as the guests of Ambassador Fiske (Edward Arnold). Cartwright has a plan to restrict the city from American soldiers on leave due to their boorish behavior. Fiske's daughter, Joan (Olivia de Havilland), tries to prove that Cartwright is wrong about the soldiers by going on a date with one named Danny (John Forsythe). Although Joan does not reveal her plan, Danny acts like a gentleman, and she starts to fall for him.

titles.title: The American Presidency With Bill Clinton
titles.description: Exploring the history of the American presidency with a comprehensive look at a wide variety of presidential action that moved our country forward.

episodes.title: Separate but Unequal
episodes.description: Exploring the history of the American presidency with a comprehensive look at a wide variety of presidential action that moved our country forward.

episodes.title: Presidential Vision
episodes.description: The presidents who have made the biggest impact imagined what America could be; through their rhetoric, their leadership, or their sheer force of personality, these presidents dared Americans to join them in their vision for a better future.

episodes.title: Building the Economy
episodes.description: This hour explores how some U.S. presidents have exerted power over the economy through various measures, including taxation, imports and exports and law making, and the effects those actions have had on the lives of American citizens.

episodes.title: Extremism
episodes.description: The United States was born in the flames of violence and rebellion, and extremism has always been a part of American identity; focusing on the ways in which American presidents have reacted to extinguish or fan the flames of extremism.

episodes.title: We the People
episodes.description: America's Constitution starts with the words "We the People"; every U.S. president has faced the question of who, exactly, is included in this soaring phrase; this hour examines presidential decision-making for many disenfranchised citizens.

episodes.title: Becoming a Superpower
episodes.description: This hour traces the rise of America's place on the world stage; becoming a superpower has altered not just America's fate but that of the world as well; with great power comes great responsibility.

titles.title: The American West
titles.description: AMC has proven its considerable skill in producing historical Western content ("Broken Trail," "Hell on Wheels"). The network dips into the same well again with the limited event series "The American West," a docudrama that shows how, in the aftermath of the Civil War, the United States transforms into the "land of opportunity," a violent world dominated by cowboys, Indians, outlaws and law men. Across eight episodes, little-known stories are told of Western legends such as Jesse James, Billy the Kid, Wyatt Earp, Crazy Horse and Sitting Bull. The series also features exclusive interviews with notable names from classic Western films, including James Caan, Tom Selleck, Kiefer Sutherland, Ed Harris and more.

episodes.title: America Divided
episodes.description: AMC has proven its considerable skill in producing historical Western content ("Broken Trail," "Hell on Wheels"). The network dips into the same well again with the limited event series "The American West," a docudrama that shows how, in the aftermath of the Civil War, the United States transforms into the "land of opportunity," a violent world dominated by cowboys, Indians, outlaws and law men. Across eight episodes, little-known stories are told of Western legends such as Jesse James, Billy the Kid, Wyatt Earp, Crazy Horse and Sitting Bull. The series also features exclusive interviews with notable names from classic Western films, including James Caan, Tom Selleck, Kiefer Sutherland, Ed Harris and more.

episodes.title: Two Front War
episodes.description: Jesse James targets the railroads; Custer goes on a secret mission in Sioux Territory; Grant contends with the growing unrest in the South and West.

episodes.title: Blood & Gold
episodes.description: Allan Pinkerton gets hired to bring Jesse James to justice; settlers descend upon Sioux land to mine gold; Grant tries to keep the peace.

episodes.title: Showdown
episodes.description: Custer rides to a showdown at Little Big Horn with the Sioux; Jesse James hopes to make a big statement when he targets a bank in the northern territory.

episodes.title: Outlaw Rising
episodes.description: Billy the Kid uses his talent with a gun to get what he wants; Sitting Bull and Crazy Horse make an important decision; Wyatt Earp fights for what's right.

episodes.title: The Big Killing
episodes.description: Jesse James resurfaces after years in hiding; Billy the Kid avenges the death of his friend; Wyatt Earp questions his future as a man of the law.

episodes.title: Frontier Justice
episodes.description: Wyatt Earp heads to Tombstone; Billy the Kid and Pat Garrett's cat-and-mouse game reaches a climax; Sitting Bill is back in America.

episodes.title: The Last Vendetta
episodes.description: Sitting Bull is accused of inciting a rebellion; Wyatt Earp turns his back on the law in his search for true justice; Jesse James is confronted by the Ford Brothers.

titles.title: The Amusement Park
titles.description: A seemingly ordinary day at an amusement park turns into a living nightmare for an elderly man.

titles.title: The Animal Breakdown
titles.description: Are pig pens cleaner than your kitchen? Can you see better than a cow? We're down on the farm finding out.

episodes.title: Pollinators and Predators
episodes.description: Are pig pens cleaner than your kitchen? Can you see better than a cow? We're down on the farm finding out.

episodes.title: Campsite Neighbors
episodes.description: Do deer see in slo-mo? Can coyotes speak crow? Are you camping next to cougars? Tune in to find out!

titles.title: The Animal Kingdom
titles.description: Successful and passionate publisher Tom Collier (Leslie Howard) marries socialite Cee Henry (Myrna Loy) despite loving his open-minded mistress, Daisy Sage (Ann Harding). As Tom becomes an established member of the upper class, his deceitful wife convinces him to publish books solely for profit and sacrifice his intellectual pursuits. When Daisy sees what Tom has become, she criticizes his transformation, forcing him to choose between staying with Cee and following his heart.

titles.title: The Ape Man
titles.description: A doctor (Bela Lugosi) injects himself with ape fluid and turns hairy; he needs human fluid to turn back.

titles.title: The Apology
titles.description: Twenty years after the disappearance of her daughter, recovering alcoholic Darlene Hagen is preparing to host her family's Christmas celebration with her best friend. On Christmas Eve, Darlene's ex-brother-in-law arrives unannounced, bearing nostalgic gifts and a heavy secret. Trapped together by a dangerous storm, she soon finds herself caught between reason and ruthless instinct as a battle of wits escalates into a violent game of revenge.

titles.title: The Ark
titles.description: "The Ark" takes place 100 years in the future when planetary colonization missions begin as a necessity to help secure the survival of the human race; after the brave crew of Ark One reaches their destination and finds it uninhabitable, they must survive long enough to locate a new home for themselves and all the ships that follow; the spacecraft's crew must become the best versions of themselves to stay on course after experiencing a catastrophic event that caused massive destruction and loss of life.

episodes.title: Everyone Wanted to Be on This Ship
episodes.description: "The Ark" takes place 100 years in the future when planetary colonization missions begin as a necessity to help secure the survival of the human race; after the brave crew of Ark One reaches their destination and finds it uninhabitable, they must survive long enough to locate a new home for themselves and all the ships that follow; the spacecraft's crew must become the best versions of themselves to stay on course after experiencing a catastrophic event that caused massive destruction and loss of life.

episodes.title: Like It Touched the Sun
episodes.description: The crew struggles to establish order; investigations uncover more questions than answers.

episodes.title: Get Out and Push
episodes.description: All hope seems lost when the crew learns an asteroid is hours away from impact.

episodes.title: We Weren't Supposed to Be Awake
episodes.description: When their psyches are put to the test by hallucinations, the crew must race to find the cause.

episodes.title: It Can't Be True
episodes.description: After an attempted murder, the crew works together to find who's responsible before it's too late.

episodes.title: We Don't Kill Our Own
episodes.description: The ship is taken under siege and the crew must outsmart the mutineers to save themselves.

episodes.title: Cycle of Violence
episodes.description: Garnet has her work cut out for her when she attempts diplomacy with a longstanding enemy.

episodes.title: It Should Have Been You
episodes.description: Garnet and Ian are trapped in the empty ship where they may remain for the rest of their lives.

episodes.title: It Will Be Over Soon
episodes.description: Strickland is presented with a hard choice.

episodes.title: Fortunate
episodes.description: The crew arrives somewhere that seems too good to be true, and it just might be.

titles.title: The Arrival
titles.description: After astronomer Zane Zaminsky discovers a radio transmission that originated from space, he tells his boss, Phil, who ignores him. Zane is promptly fired, and decides to investigate the signal himself. When he discovers a return radio transmission from Mexico, he goes to explore. There he meets climate scientist Ilana Green, who is studying anomalies in gases in the area. Zane soon makes a finding that puts him in great danger.

titles.title: The Artist
titles.description: In the 1920s, actor George Valentin (Jean Dujardin) is a bona fide matinée idol with many adoring fans. While working on his latest film, George finds himself falling in love with an ingénue named Peppy Miller (Bérénice Bejo) and, what's more, it seems Peppy feels the same way. But George is reluctant to cheat on his wife with the beautiful young actress. The growing popularity of sound in movies further separates the potential lovers, as George's career begins to fade while Peppy's star rises.

titles.title: The Assessment
titles.description: In a not-so-distant future where parenthood is strictly controlled, a couple's seven-day assessment for the right to have a child unravels into a nightmare, forcing them to question the very foundations of society.

titles.title: The Assignment
titles.description: After being double-crossed, a hit man becomes a hit woman with help from a rogue surgeon. She sets out for revenge along with a nurse named Johnnie.

titles.title: The Autobiography of Miss Jane Pittman
titles.description: Beginning during the racial turmoil of 1960s Louisiana, 110-year-old ex-slave Jane Pittman (Cicely Tyson) grants an interview to a persistent journalist and relates the remarkable story of her life. Orphaned early, she toils on a plantation until a chance meeting with a white Union soldier named Brown changes her outlook. Jane's emancipation marks only the beginning of an arduous and heartbreaking odyssey, framed by the horrors of slavery and the justice of the civil rights movement.

titles.title: The Awakening
titles.description: In post-World War I England a writer and sometime-ghost hunter (Rebecca Hall) investigates a reported haunting at a boys boarding school.

titles.title: The Babadook
titles.description: A troubled widow (Essie Davis) discovers that her son is telling the truth about a monster that entered their home through the pages of a children's book.

titles.title: The Baby
titles.description: A social worker (Anjanette Comer) tries to save a teen from his mother (Ruth Roman), who keeps him in diapers and a crib.

titles.title: The Bad Bunch
titles.description: A Vietnam veteran (Greydon Clark) encounters racial hostility when he attempts to deliver a medal to a dead soldier's family.

titles.title: The Badge
titles.description: A sheriff (Billy Bob Thornton) investigates a woman's death and an apparent political cover-up.

titles.title: The Bang Bang Club
titles.description: Photojournalists put themselves in harm's way as they shoot evidence of atrocities committed in the final days of South African apartheid.

titles.title: The Bank
titles.description: Charlie dreams of being a hero during a bank robbery.

titles.title: The Barge People
titles.description: Flesh-eating mutants terrorize two couples during a weekend getaway in the English countryside.

titles.title: The Barn
titles.description: On Devil's Night, several friends find an abandoned barn and awaken something evil inside it.

titles.title: The Barn Part II
titles.description: With the ban on Halloween lifted in her hometown, Michelle and her best friend Heather in charge of the annual haunted house. Unfortunately for Michelle, some uninvited trick-or-treaters from her past come knocking.

titles.title: The Barrens
titles.description: A man takes his family on a camping trip in the New Jersey Pine Barrens and becomes convinced they are being stalked by the Jersey Devil.

titles.title: The Bat
titles.description: A killer called the Bat has claimed many lives in the small town inhabited by novelist Cornelia van Gorder (Agnes Moorehead) and her maid, Lizzie (Lenita Lane). As Cornelia implores Dr. Malcolm Wells (Vincent Price) to help her ailing maid, $1 million in the town's bank goes missing. With greed and fear reaching new heights, police Lt. Andy Anderson (Gavin Gordon) goes to Cornelia's house to investigate additional murders committed by the Bat.

titles.title: The Battle Above: True Stories from WWII Pilots
titles.description: The incredible real accounts from military officers on both sides of the war as they recount harrowing true stories from their time in aerial combat.

titles.title: The Beast Must Die
titles.description: When big-game hunter Tom Newcliffe (Calvin Lockhart) invites a group of people to stay at his estate, they expect a relaxing weekend. Instead, they arrive to learn he thinks one of them is a werewolf and that no one can leave until that person is exposed. Among the suspects are a piano player (Michael Gambon) and his girlfriend (Ciaran Madden), an archaeologist (Peter Cushing), a diplomat (Charles Gray) and an artist (Tom Chadbon), all of whom are subjected to a series of werewolf tests.

titles.title: The Beaver
titles.description: Walter Black (Mel Gibson), the head of a failing toy company, is deeply depressed. His marriage to Meredith (Jodie Foster) is broken and his oldest son, Porter (Anton Yelchin), hates him. When Meredith finally throws him out of the house, Walter begins his final tailspin. Drunk and alone, Walter is about to commit suicide -- but is saved by the voice of the beaver puppet he found in a dumpster. Wearing the puppet on his hand, Walter speaks only through it and tries to get his life on track.

titles.title: The Best of Worlds: Life at Its Alpine Limits
titles.description: The Alps are home to plants and animals that owe their success to an amazing capacity to live in conditions that for other species, would be barely tolerable. For them however, this is everyday life.

titles.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
titles.description: This series follows the Clampett family from the Ozarks to posh Beverly Hills after they strike oil and become millionaires. Banker Mr. Drysdale tries to keep them from foolishly spending their newfound wealth, and he also tries to "civilize" them -- usually succeeding in making a fool of himself in the process.

episodes.title: The Clampetts Strike Oil
episodes.description: This series follows the Clampett family from the Ozarks to posh Beverly Hills after they strike oil and become millionaires. Banker Mr. Drysdale tries to keep them from foolishly spending their newfound wealth, and he also tries to "civilize" them -- usually succeeding in making a fool of himself in the process.

episodes.title: Getting Settled
episodes.description: Jed and his family are mistaken for a staff of crazy servants when they move into their new mansion.

episodes.title: Meanwhile, Back at the Cabin
episodes.description: The Clampett family miss being back at their old home in the mountains; Pearl tries to win over the oil man at the cabin as he takes her to a nearby phone.

episodes.title: The Clampetts Meet Mrs. Drysdale
episodes.description: When Mr. Drysdale describes Mrs. Drysdale as being a hypochondriac, the Clampetts assume she is a drunk.

episodes.title: Jed Buys Stock
episodes.description: Jed takes Drysdale's suggestion about buying good stock to heart and quickly purchases cows, pigs and chickens.

episodes.title: Trick or Treat
episodes.description: The homesick Clampetts, unaware that it's Halloween, decide to go calling on their Beverly Hills neighbors.

episodes.title: The Servants
episodes.description: Drysdale attempts another step in the social renovation of the Clampetts by lending them his servants.

episodes.title: Jethro Goes to School
episodes.description: A private school teacher is shocked to learn that her new fifth-grade student is Jethro.

episodes.title: Elly's First Date
episodes.description: Elly May's first date in Beverly Hills ends in a riot of confusion before it even starts.

episodes.title: Pygmalion and Elly
episodes.description: Sonny tries to court Elly May, as he determines that she needs to change from a hillbilly into an upper-class lady; Granny offers the use of her love charms to spice up their affair.

episodes.title: Elly Races Jethrine
episodes.description: The Clampetts try to get Sonny to propose to Elly before Cousin Pearl can get her daughter Jethrine married to him.

episodes.title: The Great Feud
episodes.description: The Clampetts load their shootin' irons for a match with the Drysdales when Sonny jilts and infuriates Elly May.

episodes.title: Home for Christmas
episodes.description: When Granny, Uncle Jed, Elly May and Jethro decide to return to the country for the holidays, they discover airline travel.

episodes.title: No Place Like Home
episodes.description: The Clampetts, home for Christmas, help Cousin Pearl woo Mr. Brewster, the big oil company executive.

episodes.title: Jed Rescues Pearl
episodes.description: Pearl's attempts to snag Mr. Brewster seem hopeless until he suddenly makes an outrageous public proposal.

episodes.title: Back to Californy
episodes.description: Jed is confronted with too many cooks and not enough vittles when he invites Pearl and Jethrine to Beverly Hills.

episodes.title: Jed's Dilemma
episodes.description: Trying to cool a feud between Granny and Pearl, Jed takes his family on a sightseeing tour of Beverly Hills.

episodes.title: Jed Saves Drysdale's Marriage
episodes.description: Drysdale's marriage is threatened when he looks to the Clampetts for a housekeeper while his wife is away.

episodes.title: Elly's Animals
episodes.description: Police and Elly's animals converge on the Clampett estate when Pearl starts giving yodeling lessons.

episodes.title: Jed Throws a Wingding
episodes.description: Two of Cousin Pearl's most ardent former suitors come to visit her in Beverly Hills; Jed doesn't know what to suggest.

episodes.title: Jed Plays Solomon
episodes.description: Granny's plan to stop Pearl's yodeling backfires when the police she called find her illegal still.

episodes.title: Duke Steals a Wife
episodes.description: Jed's bloodhound Duke takes on the role of matchmaker for his master and a glamorous woman from France.

episodes.title: Jed Buys the Freeway
episodes.description: A confidence man tries to sell Jed the Hollywood Bowl, Griffith Park and the Hollywood Freeway.

episodes.title: Jed Becomes a Banker
episodes.description: Jed is promoted to the position of bank vice president in order for him to participate in an interbank skeet shoot.

episodes.title: The Family Tree
episodes.description: An authority on American history finds evidence that Jed's ancestors preceded the Mayflower to America.

episodes.title: Jed Cuts the Family Tree
episodes.description: Cousin Pearl gets a glamour treatment and tries to groom the Clampetts for high society.

episodes.title: Granny's Spring Tonic
episodes.description: Jed takes a dose of Granny's tonic and ends up on Lovers Lane with a gold-digging secretary.

episodes.title: Jed Pays His Income Tax
episodes.description: Grannie manages to chase away an IRS agent with a shotgun, prompting a story from Mr. Drysdale about how the family came to live in Beverly Hills in the first place.

episodes.title: The Clampetts and the Dodgers
episodes.description: Los Angeles Dodgers coach Leo Durocher finds a new pitcher in Jethro.

episodes.title: Duke Becomes a Father
episodes.description: Love blooms again for Jed when Mlle. Denise returns from Paris to herald the arrival of a litter of poodles.

episodes.title: The Clampetts Entertain
episodes.description: The board chairman of Drysdale's bank is determined to meet Jed Clampett, the bank's financial wizard.

episodes.title: The Clampetts in Court
episodes.description: Jed acts as his own attorney when he's sued by a couple seeking $100,000 in damages for a fictitious auto accident.

episodes.title: The Clampetts Get Psychoanalyzed
episodes.description: The Clampetts take Jethro to Mrs. Drysdale's psychiatrist for an assessment so that he can pass the fifth grade; when Pearl accompanies him, she is worried about being asked to lie on the couch.

episodes.title: The Psychiatrist Gets Clampetted
episodes.description: Jethro is finally told that he can finish the fifth grade by Doctor Twombly, but the doctor still wants to see Grannie; her love potion for Pearl misfires, leaving Twombly confused.

episodes.title: Elly Becomes a Secretary
episodes.description: Jed takes over Drysdale's job for one afternoon and wins him the Banker of the Year title; Drysdale accidentally uses the wrong speech for his conference, and a new teller makes an impact.

episodes.title: Jethro's Friend
episodes.description: One of Jethro's school friends spends a day at the Clampett mansion, and the hillbillies show the over-protected boy how to have fun.

episodes.title: Jed Gets the Misery
episodes.description: To humor Granny, Jed fakes illness so that she can resume the doctoring that brought her fame in the hills.

episodes.title: Hair Raising Holiday
episodes.description: Granny defies medical opposition to her own brand of mountain medicine.

episodes.title: Granny's Garden
episodes.description: Granny's neighbors try to stop her when she attempts to create a vegetable garden in the front yard of the mansion grounds.

episodes.title: Elly Starts to School
episodes.description: Elly sparks a new trend in understated fashion when she enrolls in a finishing school.

episodes.title: The Clampett Look
episodes.description: The Clampetts are taken for the new avant-garde social leaders.

episodes.title: Jethro's First Love
episodes.description: Jethro shares a heart-to-heart conversation with Jed, and goes on to find himself a girlfriend in record time.

episodes.title: Chickadee Returns
episodes.description: Love-struck Jethro decides he wants to marry Chickadee Laverne, a brassy burlesque dancer he brings home.

episodes.title: The Clampetts Are Overdrawn
episodes.description: Jed is shocked when he receives news that his multimillion-dollar bank account has been overdrawn by $34 million.

episodes.title: The Clampetts Go Hollywood
episodes.description: The Clampetts, under the noxious influence of J.D. Clampett, impostor and unemployed actor, go to Hollywood.

episodes.title: Turkey Day
episodes.description: Plans for a holiday feast at the Clampett mansion go awry when Elly makes a pet of the Thanksgiving turkey.

episodes.title: The Garden Party
episodes.description: Mrs. Drysdale, giving a lavish garden party, finds to her horror that she is losing her guests to the Clampetts.

episodes.title: Elly Needs a Maw
episodes.description: Jed decides that his tomboy daughter Elly, who has taken up motorcycle riding, needs a mother to make her a lady.

episodes.title: The Clampetts Get Culture
episodes.description: The Clampetts try to participate in some of the more civilized pleasures of Beverly Hills.

episodes.title: Christmas at the Clampetts'
episodes.description: The Clampett family is somewhat befuddled when they receive lavish Christmas presents that all seem to come from Mr Drysdale.

episodes.title: A Man for Elly
episodes.description: Quirt Manly, celebrated star of television Westerns, is invited to the Clampett mansion to try to tame Elly May.

episodes.title: The Giant Jackrabbit
episodes.description: An Australian banker sends Drysdale a kangaroo as a joke, and Granny thinks she has discovered a giant jackrabbit.

episodes.title: The Girl From Home
episodes.description: A beauty-contest winner from the hills and her father come to visit Jethro with marriage on their minds.

episodes.title: Lafe Lingers On
episodes.description: Backwoods freeloader Lafe Crick lingers on at the Clampett mansion as an unwanted guest in search of an easy fortune.

episodes.title: The Race for Queen
episodes.description: Elly May decides to enter a beauty competition to become the queen of Beverly Hills, with some help from Miss Jane and the Drysdales; when Granny hears about the race, she wants to enter as well.

titles.title: The Beyond
titles.description: Gruesome deaths occur when a woman (Katherine MacColl) inherits a hotel that is one of seven gateways to hell.

titles.title: The Big Body Hotel
titles.description: Plus-sized people embark on a trip of a lifetime. They check into a hotel designed with larger guests in mind and learn to embrace their bodies in a place where size is no obstacle to enjoying a carefree holiday.

episodes.title: The Big Body Hotel
episodes.description: 66-year-old Kathy tries to gain the confidence to swim in a public pool; Ginny needs to overcome her anxiety when she is challenged to make a big speech.

titles.title: The Big Lie: American Addict 2
titles.description: Matthew Perry, Jonathan Davis, Ron Paul and Dennis Kucinich contribute to this eye-opening examination of America's deadly dependency on prescription medication.

titles.title: The Big Trees
titles.description: Corrupt Wisconsin lumberman Jim Fallon travels to Northern California at the dawn of the 20th century in order to gain control of a tract of redwood forest. Fallon's underhanded tactics stir resentment from everyone, including settler Elder Bixby; his beautiful daughter, Alicia; Fallon's fair-minded employee, Yukon Burn; and his right-hand man, Frenchy LeCroix -- and his cheating ways create unlikely bedfellows.

titles.title: The Birthday Boys
titles.description: Executive produced by Bob Odenkirk ("Breaking Bad") and Ben Stiller, "The Birthday Boys" is a scripted original sketch show starring the Los Angeles comedy group of the same name. The Birthday Boys are Jefferson Dutton, Dave Ferguson, Mike Hanford, Tim Kalpakis, Matt Kowalick, Mike Mitchell and Chris VanArtsdalen, whose collective credits include "Parks and Recreation," "The Office," "Portlandia," "Funny or Die," "Comedy Bang! Bang!" and "Conan." Episodes combine a mix of stand-alone and multiact sketches that twist real-life situations and cultural touchstones, taking a page from absurd yet intelligent classic sketch shows "Monty Python," "Kids in the Hall" and Odenkirk's "Mr. Show With Bob and David."

episodes.description: The ups and downs of a group of residential roofers whose antics got them an American sitcom; a moronic rap-rocker who sings about America's problems-only to discover he can't find any; Laraine Newman; French Stewart.

episodes.description: Tim gets confused trying to keep up with the complicated story lines of TV shows including a variety show; teens dare each other to inspect an old hermit's cabin, but are horrified when they look at the old man's website.

episodes.title: Rock and Roll
episodes.description: Interviews with the modern giants of Rock, Rap, and Dubstep about the foundation of all modern popular music; one of the wildest bachelor parties of all time; Ben Stiller.

episodes.title: Cool Machine
episodes.description: The development of a scientific contraption that promises to turn the guys into cool versions of themselves; a sneak peek into the underground world of Amish juicing.

episodes.title: Helpful Tips
episodes.description: The seven Pinkus brothers, owners and founders of The 7 Brothers' Brewery. Their love of beer-making includes backstroking through their vats of beer; the shady world of pool hustlers.

episodes.title: Skewered!
episodes.description: A man who discovered flight before the Wright Brothers-only to be mocked because his flying machine looked funny and got lost in the mix of goofier inventions; The Birthday Boys review today's hot-button topics.

episodes.title: All Your Favorites Are Back
episodes.description: The Birthday Boys are booked on a comedy event proclaiming that All Your Favorites Are Back! The line-up goes on and on and on; a restaurant owner who puts more care into advertising the price of the food than the meal itself.

episodes.title: Going All the Way
episodes.description: The Birthday Boys revisit their high school days with a pact to each lose their virginity before they graduate that they made on graduation day; a student brings his Dad to the prom; a pseudo-intellectual evaluates the Contemporary Family.

episodes.title: Dumb Public
episodes.description: A visit with Glanard Frugner, the worst animator of all time, including an introduction to some of his less-than-legendary creations; an evaluation of how smart the public is.

episodes.title: Snobs and Slobs
episodes.description: A fashion designer, a man raised in nature and a struggling indie rock band may seem like they have nothing in common, but they're all trying to find where they belong in the world.

episodes.title: Wet Dreams May Come
episodes.description: A Polish immigrant father does what he can to care for his seven DJ sons; in their attempt to kill Adolf Hitler, two time-travelers hit a speed bump.

episodes.title: Women Are Funny
episodes.description: The debate is over with definitive proof that women are funny; the cost of such proof may or may not have been worth it.

episodes.title: Freshy's
episodes.description: Jack Black is the jaded star of a movie franchise reboot; the guys fall for a fast food chain's social marketing campaign.

episodes.title: Love Date Hump
episodes.description: Romance seen through a group of swinging guys; a married couple that hasn't been out in a long time.

episodes.title: Getting Preachy
episodes.description: A rowdy seminary school; a man possessed by El Diablo; a preacher's crusade against preaching.

episodes.title: Plight of the Working Class
episodes.description: Unemployment and the economy; a doomed lumber mill.

episodes.title: The U.S. Healthcare System
episodes.description: Taking on the U.S. healthcare system; the importance of rectal and colon health.

episodes.title: Cerf's Folly
episodes.description: A declaration that the World Wide Web is a failure; losing sleep over online opinions; soldiers capitalize on their viral potential; how people got attention before the Internet.

titles.title: The Black Water Vampire
titles.description: A documentary film crew investigates a series of killings where women were mutilated and left in the woods with their bodies drained of blood. They journey into the forest and come face to face with a form of evil they never could have imagined.

titles.title: The Blacksmith
titles.description: Buster tries to shoe horses and fix cars, with mixed results.

titles.title: The BMF Documentary: Blowing Money Fast
titles.description: "BMF: Blowing Money Fast" tracks the rise and fall of the most notorious drug syndicate in American history, Black Mafia Family, as chronicled through firsthand accounts of BMF members, insiders, associates, and celebrity figures close to the Flenory family. The series focuses on Meech's time in Atlanta, where he set up East Coast BMF headquarters and launched an entertainment company to promote rap artists in the early 2000s. He and his crew spent gobs of money on strippers and champagne at dance clubs and lounges while rubbing shoulders with P. Diddy and Lil Jon.

episodes.title: Fede Alvarez
episodes.description: Discussions and interviews about all things horror.

titles.title: The Book of Love
titles.description: Henry (Jason Sudeikis) is a widowed architect who strikes up a friendship with Millie (Maisie Williams), an independent but troubled teen. Hoping to find her long-lost father, Millie asks Henry to build her a raft that can sail across the ocean. After agreeing to do so, the unlikely duo embark on an incredible adventure that deepens their bond and lifts their spirits.

titles.title: The Boy, the Dog and the Clown
titles.description: A young boy grieving the loss of his father meets a sad, down-on-his-luck clown who can perform incredible feats of magic.

titles.title: The Bra
titles.description: A train driver, Nurlan, finds a blue-laced bra on the front of the train. He goes out to search for the owner of a blue bra.

titles.title: The Brain
titles.description: A teen (Tom Breznahan) and his girlfriend (Cyndy Preston) find a monster brain at a TV psychologist's (David Gale) thought-control institute.

titles.title: The Bride
titles.description: When a new bride travels with her husband to his ancestral home, she is subjected to a mysterious wedding ceremony.

titles.title: The Bride With White Hair
titles.description: Zhuo (Leslie Cheung), a master swordsman, is in charge of an army chosen to protect China from an evil cult. During a battle with the enemy, Zhuo falls in love with Lian (Brigitte Lin), a young woman who was raised by wolves and then adopted by the Siamese twins who lead the cult. The two seek a life of peace and quiet, but when Zhuo's colleagues are mysteriously slaughtered, survivors believe Lian is the culprit. Zhuo finds himself forced to turn against his beloved.

titles.title: The Bride With White Hair II
titles.description: Ten years after her lover, Cho Yi-Hang (Leslie Cheung), turned against her in battle, martial arts master Lien Ni-Chang (Brigitte Lin) is a bitter witch whose disciples have also been jilted or oppressed by men. The Wu-Tang Clan, many of whose members were killed by Lien, are trying to rebuild by marrying their next leader, Fung Chun-Kit (Sunny Chan), to beautiful Yu Qin (Joey Maan). On their wedding night, Lien kidnaps Yu, brainwashing and turning her against Fung.

episodes.title: The Business of Booze
episodes.description: Maker's Mark celebrates Kentucky's Bourbon Trail, Mr Black's Espresso Martini Fest, Wander; Ivy uncorks a single-serve and Richtech Robotics AI bartender.

titles.title: The Call
titles.description: Terror strikes when a recently deceased woman rises from the grave to seek revenge against a group of friends who tormented her.

titles.title: The Canyon
titles.description: A honeymooning couple has to survive in the Grand Canyon after getting lost.

titles.title: The Cape Town Affair
titles.description: Candy (Jacqueline Bisset) is a courier for a group of Communist spies working in South Africa in the 1960s. Transporting a container of secret microfilm in her purse, Candy boards a bus to her destination. Soon, she realizes her purse has been stolen, along with the precious film inside. Skip McCoy (James Brolin) is the expert pickpocket who grabbed her bag without realizing what he has stolen. Candy attempts to retrieve her package from Skip while police close in on her.

titles.title: The Carpenter's Son
titles.description: A remote village in Egypt explodes into spiritual warfare when a carpenter, his wife and their son Jesus are targeted by supernatural forces.

titles.title: The Cat and the Canary
titles.description: Ten years after the death of millionaire Cyrus Norman, his will is to be read out to his six relatives, including Joyce Norman (Paulette Goddard) and Wally Campbell (Bob Hope). Organized by Norman's lawyer, Crosby (George Zucco), the six meet at Norman's eerie New Orleans Gothic mansion. During the reading, the superstitious housekeeper declares that someone will be dead by midnight. Wally fears for Joyce when she is declared the sole inheritor, but all are alarmed when Crosby turns up dead.

titles.title: The Cat o' Nine Tails
titles.description: A newsman (James Franciscus) works with a blind puzzle-solver (Karl Malden) to catch a killer with mixed-up chromosomes.

titles.title: The Cellar
titles.description: A woman must confront an ancient and powerful entity after her daughter mysteriously vanishes in the cellar of their new home.

episodes.description: On this episode of The CEO Series, featuring a deep-dive interview with Twitch CEO Dan Clancy as he discusses the streaming platform's mission, innovation roadmap, and how Twitch is empowering creators in a rapidly changing content economy.

titles.title: The China Hustle
titles.description: Investors seeking new alternatives for high returns find a gold mine in China -- until the discovery of a massive web of fraud calls everything else into question.

titles.title: The Chrisleys: Back to Reality
titles.description: "The Chrisleys: Back to Reality" begins during the wake of the family's controversy and upheaval with Todd and Julie in federal prison and follows the family as their parents are eventually pardoned, released from prison and return home. The series shows a side of the Chrisleys that has never been seen before with exclusive access to the family--Julie and Todd from prison and upon their release, Savannah, Chase, Grayson, Chloe, Nanny Faye, and for the first time, Julie's parents Harvey and Pam.

The series shows a side of the Chrisleys that has never been seen before with exclusive access to the family--Julie and Todd from prison and upon their release, Savannah, Chase, Grayson, Chloe, Nanny Faye, and for the first time, Julie's parents Harvey and Pam.

episodes.description: Grayson's attempt to talk some sense into Chase backfires horribly, while Nanny Faye struggles to accept Chase's girlfriend Jodi; the family recounts the rise of Chrisley Knows Best.

episodes.title: A Tale of Two Daughters
episodes.description: Savannah grieves a difficult breakup without the help of her parents, while the Chrisleys reveal shocking betrayals that helped put Todd and Julie behind bars.

episodes.title: Praying for Pardon
episodes.description: Chase decides to take a big step that leads to an argument with Julie, while the family implodes when Harvey crosses Savannah just as she gets news of a possible pardon for Todd and Julie.

episodes.title: Chasing Chase
episodes.description: Savannah and Grayson reel from the news that the pardon will not be going through this time, triggering painful memories; Chase finally decides to let his guard down and seek therapy; Faye attempts to get Savannah and Grayson to see the light.

episodes.title: Freedom Frenzy
episodes.description: Todd and Julie are suddenly pardoned overnight, sending the Chrisleys into a frenzy to bring them home; Chase, Faye, Pam, and Harvey are excluded from plans to bring them home, leading to increasing tensions.

episodes.title: Life After Lockup
episodes.description: Julie struggles to readjust to life back home as Pam and Harvey find themselves out in the cold; Chase is enraged when he is excluded from a family interview.

episodes.title: The Chrisley Comeback
episodes.description: Todd and Julie look at the complicated road ahead; Chase does his best to brush off hurt by his family and stand on his own two feet.

titles.description: An architect (John Denver) and his daughter (Gennie James) visit a Colorado town where everyone believes in Santa Claus.

episodes.title: Evil Intent

episodes.title: The Coffee Shop Murders
episodes.description: A man kills three coffee-shop employees.

episodes.title: Without Remorse
episodes.description: A parole officer's shooting death sends police on a manhunt full of murders, robberies and carjackings.

episodes.title: Global Pursuit
episodes.description: Pakistan native fires an assault rifle at cars entering CIA headquarters in Virginia.

episodes.title: A Family Torn
episodes.description: When the body of a missing 11-year-old girl washes up on a sandbar, the police take a closer look at her uncle's conflicting stories.

titles.title: The Female Brain
titles.description: When a female scientist studies the differences between the male and female brain, her findings dictate how she lives her life.

titles.title: The Final Comedown
titles.description: Out of racism rises a young militant leader (Billy Dee Williams) who thinks the only answer is armed revolution.

titles.title: The Finale
titles.description: An elite theater camp is all fun and games until the killing begins.

titles.title: The Flying Kestrel
titles.description: The owner of Kestrel Beer buys an original 1930s Riley Kestrel with the intention of restoring it and breaking the land-speed record. Following the events from restoration to record day.

episodes.title: Stripped
episodes.description: The owner of Kestrel Beer buys an original 1930s Riley Kestrel with the intention of restoring it and breaking the land-speed record. Following the events from restoration to record day.

episodes.title: Dyno Test
episodes.description: The record attempt is only one week away and everything seems to be on track, until the results of a dyno test put a spanner in the works.

episodes.title: Meet the Press
episodes.description: The official launch of The Flying Kestrel at legendary racetrack, Santa Pod; the Kestrel team is joined by Victor Riley of Riley Cars and celebrity Rachel Riley.

episodes.title: Return of the Riley
episodes.description: Can the team behind Kestrel Beer and one of the world's best drag racing engineers break multiple land speed records in a 1930s Kestrel Riley classic car?

titles.title: The Fourth Victim
titles.description: A wealthy Englishman finds his third wife dead. An investigation is launched after the police discover that his first two wives had also died suddenly.

titles.title: The Frankenstein Theory
titles.description: A professor leads a film crew to the Arctic Circle to prove that author Mary Shelley's tale of "Frankenstein" is true.

titles.title: The Free World
titles.description: Released from prison for a crime he didn't commit, a man (Boyd Holbrook) goes on the run with a woman (Elisabeth Moss) who's suspected of killing her abusive husband.

titles.title: The Funeral
titles.description: Cemal drives a hearse for a living. He's entrusted with secretly carrying the body of a young girl at the request of her family. One night, he hears strange groans from the back of the truck, even though the girl hasn't got a pulse.

titles.title: The Game of Crowns: The Tudors
titles.description: A look at the real life stories that inspired "Game of Thrones" by tracing the Tudor bloodline from Henry VII to Elizabeth I; the Tudor dynasty spans little over a century, but it is filled with big personalities and battles for power and influence.

titles.title: The Game of Crowns: The Victorians
titles.description: A world of dynasties, blood feuds and civil war.

titles.title: The Gangster
titles.description: A man is released from prison and wants to live an honest life, but knowing nothing else, he returns to his old gang.

titles.title: The Gate
titles.description: When Al and Glen's parents leave town for the weekend, Al uses the opportunity to throw a party while little brother Glen and his friend Terry decide to explore a hole left by a tree-removal service in the backyard. When unexplainable phenomena begin occurring, Terry, with the help of his extensive heavy-metal music collection, comes to the conclusion that he and Glen have accidentally opened a gateway to hell.

titles.title: The General
titles.description: One of the most revered comedies of the silent era, this film finds hapless Southern railroad engineer Johnny Gray (Buster Keaton) facing off against Union soldiers during the American Civil War. When Johnny's fiancée, Annabelle Lee (Marion Mack), is accidentally taken away while on a train stolen by Northern forces, Gray pursues the soldiers, using various modes of transportation in comic action scenes that highlight Keaton's boundless wit and dexterity.

titles.title: The Girl Can't Help It
titles.description: Hefty hoodlum Marty Fats Murdock (Edmond O'Brien) employs has-been agent Tom Miller (Tom Ewell) to transform his girlfriend, Jerri Jordan (Jayne Mansfield), into a singing star because he trusts Tom not to make a pass at her. However, the more time Tom spends with the stunning blonde, the more smitten he becomes. His troubles multiply when he realizes that Jerri can't sing a note, is not in love with Murdock and wants to settle down with a nice man like himself.

titles.title: The Girl From Monaco
titles.description: Bertrand (Fabrice Luchini), a middle-aged lawyer, is sent to Monaco to defend an old woman (Stéphane Audran) who murdered a man with ties to the mob. Against his will, Bertrand is assigned a bodyguard named Christophe (Roschdy Zem). Their relationship becomes especially strained when Bertrand meets Audrey (Louise Bourgoin), a beautiful local weather girl and Christophe's ex-girlfriend. Audrey seduces Bertrand, occupying all his time and, according to Christophe, distracting him from the trial.

titles.title: The Girl Hunters
titles.description: Private eye Mike Hammer (Mickey Spillane) asks a bikinied blonde (Shirley Eaton) and others about his long-lost secretary, Velda.

titles.title: The Girl Who Got Away
titles.description: A female serial killer who killed four young girls is sent away to prison, but a fifth victim escaped with her life. Twenty years later, the killer escapes and begins hunting for the one who got away.

titles.title: The Good Doctor
titles.description: A young physician (Orlando Bloom) becomes dangerously obsessed with a teenage patient (Riley Keough) and falls into an illicit romance. Things quickly spin out of control when an orderly finds out and blackmails the doctor.

titles.title: The Good Heart
titles.description: Homeless and saved from almost certain death by a hospital staff, Lucas (Paul Dano) has nowhere to turn. The hospital staffers, though, are so taken with his kindness and generosity that they take up a collection to give him a fresh start. But when he's discharged, Lucas meets some fellow homeless people and gives away all the money he's just received. His roommate at the hospital, Jacques (Brian Cox), is also affected by the young man, and offers him a job at his bar.

titles.title: The Grand Duel
titles.description: A mysterious gunfighter (Lee Van Cleef) protects a man accused of killing an Arizona big shot.

titles.title: The Grand Party Hotel
titles.description: The secret life of one of the most popular hotels in Britain; the hotel is situated in the heart of Liverpool and people flock there from all over the UK to celebrate important moments.

episodes.title: The Grand Party Hotel
episodes.description: The secret life of one of the most popular hotels in Britain; the hotel is situated in the heart of Liverpool and people flock there from all over the UK to celebrate important moments.

episodes.title: The Grand Party Hotel
episodes.description: The hotel braces itself for another busy weekend of almost 700 guests; but it's just another day for owners Lawrence and Katie and their three-year-old twins, who live on-site in an apartment on the 4th floor.

episodes.title: The Grand Party Hotel
episodes.description: A late booking has come in for a wedding, but the hotel's wedding suite is already booked so Director Kris and his team set about converting a luxury room into the bridal suite of dreams.

episodes.title: The Grand Party Hotel
episodes.description: Giving each guest an unforgettable experience takes an army of staff to achieve, the hotel owners Lawrence and Katie explain that they expect all 250 staff to go the extra mile for their guests.

titles.title: The Grasshopper
titles.description: A British Columbia teenager (Jacqueline Bisset) dreams of show business but winds up as a call-girl in Las Vegas.

titles.title: The Grave
titles.description: The quest for buried treasure leads two escaped convicts (Craig Sheffer, Josh Charles) to old friends, an ex-flame (Gabrielle Anwar) and one's shooting.

titles.title: The Gravedigger
titles.description: When a lonely gravedigger discovers Frankenstein's monster hiding in the cemetery, he must decide whether to help the creature or turn him over to the murderous Dr. Victor Frankenstein.

titles.title: The Great Buck Howard
titles.description: Defying his father and dropping out of law school, aspiring writer Troy Gable looks for a way to gain some meaningful life experience. Troy gets that and more when he takes a job with Buck Howard, a vainglorious mentalist who hopes to reinvigorate his fading career by staging a big comeback.

titles.title: The Great Wall of Japan
titles.description: After the disaster of March 2011, the Japanese authorities decided to build an anti-tsunami wall.

titles.title: The Grill Next Door
titles.description: Morgan Bolling is on a smoky mission: to empower everyone, everywhere with the tips, techniques, and recipes that make "fear of the grill" a thing of the past.

episodes.title: Battle of the Burgers
episodes.description: Morgan Bolling is on a smoky mission: to empower everyone, everywhere with the tips, techniques, and recipes that make "fear of the grill" a thing of the past.

episodes.title: Nacho Average Barbecue
episodes.description: A six-foot nacho table loaded with North Carolina pulled pork, green chile queso and candied bacon s'mores.

episodes.title: Backyard Tailgate
episodes.description: Morgan's serving smoked chicken wings, charred guacamole, and pizza dip.

episodes.title: Greek-Inspired Girls Night
episodes.description: It's a Greek-inspired girls' night with chicken souvlaki, grilled carrots, and smoky eggplant dip.

episodes.title: I Do Barbecue
episodes.description: Morgan throws a steakhouse-themed engagement party with a smoky, grilled twist on the classics.

episodes.title: The Crown Jewel of Texas Barbecue
episodes.description: Morgan tackles the holy grail of Texas barbecue: brisket; pimento mac and cheese and pineapple margaritas.

episodes.title: A Tribute to the Tarheel State
episodes.description: Morgan treats her mom to a North Carolina-inspired feast featuring fish stew cooked over a live fire.

episodes.title: Friendsgiving Anytime
episodes.description: Morgan throws a Friendsgiving dinner with irreverent, grilled twists on the classic holiday menu.

titles.title: The Grim Sleeper
titles.description: Journalist Christine Pelisek helps law enforcement investigate the alleged serial killer known as the Grim Sleeper.

titles.title: The Gunman From Bodie
titles.description: The Rough Riders, led by Marshal Buck Roberts (Buck Jones), are on the trail of cattle rustlers when they discover a family of ranchers that has been murdered. A note Roberts finds identifies rustler Bill Cook (John Merton) as one of those responsible. To investigate, Roberts travels undercover, posing as wanted outlaw Bob "Brodie" Bronson. Marshal McCall (Tim McCoy) pretends he is chasing him, but they are actually in cahoots. The two lawmen hope the strategy will expose the real outlaws.

titles.title: The Guy From Harlem
titles.description: A streetwise private investigator relies on his instincts to succeed when the CIA hires him to guard a visiting African princess.

titles.title: The Hallow
titles.description: A family is forced to fight demonic creatures for survival after they move into a remote mill house in Ireland.

titles.title: The Hand
titles.description: Scotland Yard sets out to capture a mysterious killer who amputates the hands of his victims.

titles.title: The Hands of Orlac
titles.description: A pianist (Mel Ferrer) thinks surgery his fiancée (Lucile Saint-Simon) arranged has left him with the hands of an executed strangler.

titles.title: The Haunting of Alice D
titles.description: In the late 1890s, a prostitute kills herself in a brothel, and her spirit haunts it. The building is abandoned until it is restored as a mansion, but the new owners have no idea the ghost is still there as they plan a party.

titles.title: The Haunting of Molly Hartley
titles.description: After surviving a brutal attack by her insane mother, teenage Molly (Haley Bennett) is eager to get a fresh start at a new school. Attracting the attention of one of the school's most-popular students (Chace Crawford), she thinks she is finally fitting in and getting her life on track but, on the eve of her 18th birthday, Molly learns the horrifying truth about her devilish legacy.

titles.title: The Haunting of Sharon Tate
titles.description: Married to filmmaker Roman Polanski, actress Sharon Tate is a rising star who's about to have her first baby. Plagued by terrifying premonitions, Tate sees her worst nightmares come true when she encounters members of the Manson Family cult.

titles.title: The Heart of Christmas
titles.description: Megan (Candace Cameron Bure) re-examines her priorities after she sees people decorating for Christmas in October to help a family celebrate Christmas with their dying son.

titles.title: The Heart Stays
titles.description: A Native American teen must choose between her own personal goals or the traditional responsibilities of the old ways.

titles.title: The Hellbenders
titles.description: The Civil War is over, and the South has fallen, but Col. Jonas (Joseph Cotten) has a plan to revive the Confederacy. He raids a Union Army detail and walks away with valuable treasure that he intends to put to use raising another rebel army. Jonas needs to keep the treasure safe during shipment, so he places it in a coffin and forces saloon girl Claire (Norma Bengell) to play widow. Claire is unwilling to do her part, however, and puts herself in danger by opposing the dangerous Jonas.

titles.title: The Hero of Color City
titles.description: Crayons team up to save the day when an unfinished drawing tries to steal all the world's color.

titles.title: The Hideous Sun Demon
titles.description: Sunlight transforms a contaminated scientist into a man-eating lizard in this campy sci-fi classic from the '50s.

titles.title: The Highest of Stakes
titles.description: The real story of the most controversial figure in crypto and the fastest appreciating asset: Richard Heart and the Hex Token.

titles.title: The Hive
titles.description: A couple returns home from a night out to find two sadistic strangers waiting to terrorize them.

titles.title: The Homesman
titles.description: A frontier farm woman (Hilary Swank) saves the life of a claim-jumper (Tommy Lee Jones) and persuades him to help her escort three insane women to a safe haven in Iowa.

titles.title: The Hook of Woodland Heights
titles.description: An escaped mental patient replaces his missing hand with a barbecue fork.

titles.title: The House by the Cemetery
titles.description: Soon after moving his family into a New England house with a dark history, a doctor begins receiving warnings from a mysterious girl to get out.

titles.title: The House Of The Serpent
titles.description: An actress penning a play inspired by the story of a woman vanishing into thin air becomes disturbed by unexplained phenomena at her rental villa.

titles.title: The House on Cuckoo Lane
titles.description: A film geek is driven by horrific nightmares to seek out a copy of a notorious, supposedly real snuff film. When his obsession leads him to an abandoned house in the woods where the video was actually shot, he is haunted by masked demons.

titles.title: The Houses October Built
titles.description: Friends (Brandy Schaefer, Mikey Roe, Jeff Larson) encounter genuine horror during a road trip to visit haunted houses.

titles.title: The Houses October Built 2
titles.description: Still recovering from the trauma of being kidnapped on the previous Halloween by the Blue Skeleton - a group that takes extreme haunt to another level - five friends decide they must face their fears to move on. Heading back out on the road to visit more haunted house attractions, new terror begins when signs of the Blue Skeleton start appearing again.

titles.title: The Howling: New Moon Rising
titles.description: The peace of a desert town is shattered by gruesome murders that appear to be the work of a werewolf.

titles.title: The Hunt
titles.description: While making an instructional video, hunters become the prey after they trespass on government land.

titles.title: The Hunter
titles.description: A shadowy corporation sends a mercenary (Willem Dafoe) to Tasmania to track down a nearly extinct tiger whose genetic code holds the secret to a dangerous weapon.

titles.title: The Hurricane Express
titles.description: A young pilot pursues the mysterious saboteur responsible for the train crash which killed his father.

titles.title: The Identical
titles.description: During the Great Depression, identical twins are separated at birth. One, Drexel Hemsley (Blake Rayne) becomes a wildly successful '50s rock star, while the other, Ryan Wade (also Rayne), struggles to balance his passion for music and pleasing his parents, who want him to become a preacher. Finally, Ryan rebels against his parents' wishes and launches his own music career -- performing the hits of Drexel Hemsley. Ryan later learns the truth about Drexel when their fates tragically collide.

titles.title: The Innkeepers
titles.description: During the final days at the Yankee Pedlar Inn, two employees determined to reveal the hotel's haunted past begin to experience disturbing events as old guests check in for a stay.

titles.title: The Institute
titles.description: A group of psychic children unites to take on the shadowy organization that has kidnapped them and claims to be using their power to "save the world."

episodes.title: The Boy
episodes.description: A group of psychic children unites to take on the shadowy organization that has kidnapped them and claims to be using their power to "save the world."

episodes.title: Shots for Dots
episodes.description: Luke bonds with the other Front Half residents and begins plotting his escape; Ms. Sigsby manages the fallout from a security breach; in town, Tim begins to look into The Institute, only to find himself caught up in a high-stakes standoff.

episodes.title: Graduation
episodes.description: Luke begins to plan his escape while Sigsby is distracted trying to expose Stackhouse's disloyalty; Tim loses a friend.

episodes.title: The Box
episodes.description: As Luke's tests intensify, a new arrival causes problems for Sigsby; Tim isn't buying the official story about what happened to Annie.

episodes.title: Back Half
episodes.description: Sigsby tricks Luke into confirming he's TP, forcing him to move up his escape attempt; Tim's suspicions put him on the Institute's radar.

episodes.title: Run
episodes.description: As Tim's investigation pays off in ways he never imagined and Sigsby scrambles to avert disaster, Luke must finally decide who he can trust.

episodes.title: Hide
episodes.description: Luke and Tim go on a desperate search for help as Sigsby uses all of her formidable assets in a last-ditch attempt to keep the Institute's secrets.

episodes.title: Fight
episodes.description: The characters come together for a final confrontation with unimaginable consequences.

titles.title: The Interdimensional Connection
titles.description: With more military data and whistleblower accounts being released, it's becoming harder to discount the UFO phenomena. For many ufologists posing the question of origination, the answer lies outside the limits of our senses.

titles.title: The Invisible Ghost
titles.description: Dr. Charles Kessler (Bela Lugosi), a well-to-do physician who shares his mansion with his daughter, Virginia (Polly Ann Young), has been depressed ever since his wife (Betty Compson) left him for another man, only to later die in a car accident. That's not all Kessler has to worry about, however. Unexplained murders have begun to occur around town, eventually claiming members of his house staff. Making matters worse, the authorities suspect Kessler may somehow be involved.

titles.title: The Island
titles.description: A deadly virus infects a small community living on the island of Sløborn, between Denmark and Germany, in the North Sea.

episodes.title: All Different

episodes.title: Yellow Man

episodes.title: Out There
episodes.description: The situation on the deserted island slowly escalates; the mystery of the yellow man is solved, but a new threat comes to those who stayed behind.

episodes.title: Slow Burn
episodes.description: Social worker Freja is having increasing trouble keeping her group of juvenile delinquents under control; the argument with Devid intensifies.

episodes.title: No Dreams
episodes.description: Evelin and her small purpose group want to leave the island as soon as possible, and they plan to capture the ship of pirates who come to pillage once a week.

episodes.title: Leaving Here
episodes.description: The escape plan of Evelin and her group is in jeopardy, as new challenges arise that threaten their plan to reach the mainland.

titles.title: The Jade Pendant
titles.description: A young Chinese woman, Ying-Ying, finds herself on a boat to America after escaping the clutches of a bad arranged marriage.

titles.title: The Janky Promoters

titles.title: The Jeffrey Dahmer Files
titles.description: Filmmaker Chris James Thompson uses archival footage and fictionalized scenarios to tell the story of serial killer Jeffrey Dahmer as seen by a detective, the lead pathologist and Dahmer's neighbor.

titles.title: The Joe Louis Story
titles.description: As a teenager, African-American Joe Louis (Coley Wallace) gives up on the violin to try his hand at boxing. A few years later, he's the 1934 Golden Gloves champion. He goes pro, trains with Chappie Blackburn (James Edwards), and enjoys an unprecedented string of victories. But Louis faces more than just tough opponents in the ring. Prejudice follows him throughout his career, and his bouts with Germany's Max Schmeling are fraught with racial tension on an international level.
