titles.title: The Joy of Toys
titles.description: Bring joy to the children in your life in the holiday season with the gift found during "The Joy of Toys"; from electronic gadgets to classics such as dolls, plush toys, building sets, scooters and more, one can find something for every child.

titles.title: The Jupiter Enigma
titles.description: Drawing on new findings from NASA's Juno mission, scientists are peering into Jupiter's stormy heart to reveal the very origins of the solar system.

titles.title: The Kardashians: Reality Royalty
titles.description: Profile of the Kardashian family of reality TV fame.

titles.title: The Kid
titles.description: In 1879 Rio and his teenage sister go on the run across the American Southwest to escape from their violent uncle. Along the way, Rio encounters the infamous outlaw Billy the Kid and the legendary lawman Pat Garrett. He soon finds himself caught in the crossfire as Billy and Garrett square off in a deadly game of cat and mouse.

titles.title: The Korean War: No Longer Forgotten Part II
titles.description: A journey through the Korean War's timeline, hardships, victories and conclusion.

titles.title: The Kung Fu Getaway
titles.description: A time-traveling kung fu warrior chases two deadly aliens.

titles.title: The Lair
titles.description: When Royal Air Force pilot Lt. Kate Sinclair is shot down over Afghanistan, she finds refuge in an abandoned underground bunker where deadly man-made biological weapons -- half human, half alien -- are awakened.

titles.title: The Land
titles.description: Four inner-city teens face the wrath of a Cleveland crime boss after stealing a car that's stashed with drugs.

titles.title: The Last 24 Hours
titles.description: A look at the final hours of some of the world's most famous people.

episodes.title: Jimi Hendrix
episodes.description: A look at the final hours of some of the world's most famous people.

titles.title: The Last 24 Hours: Amy Winehouse
titles.description: Amy Winehouse was a singer-songwriter with a unique style and voice; an investigation into what really happened during the final 24 hours of the singer's life.

titles.title: The Last 24 Hours: Michael Jackson
titles.description: Michael Jackson, the "King of Pop," spends his last hours battling insomnia and pleading with his personal physician.

titles.title: The Last Beyond
titles.description: A man embarks on a spiritual journey when the bank forecloses on his family's ranch in Depression-era Montana.

titles.title: The Last Circus
titles.description: A twisted love triangle develops among a Spanish clown (Carlos Areces), his cruel rival (Antonio de la Torre) and the rival's abused -- but lustful -- wife (Carolina Bang).

titles.title: The Last Days on Mars
titles.description: Astronauts (Liev Schreiber, Elias Koteas, Romola Garai) on Mars contend with a microbe that turns those it infects into zombielike killers.

titles.title: The Last King
titles.description: Two warriors (Jakob Oftebro, Kristofer Hivju) must protect the last remaining heir to the throne as civil war ravages 13th-century Norway.

titles.title: The Last Lion of Liuwa
titles.description: The last remaining lioness on the plain is the sole survivor of a massacre that took the rest of the pride.

titles.title: The Last Race
titles.description: A small-town stock car track and the drivers that call it home struggle to hold on to an American racing tradition.

titles.title: The Last Thanksgiving
titles.description: A family of cannibalistic Pilgrims attacks the staff and patrons at a restaurant that stays open for Thanksgiving rather than close in celebration of the holiday.

titles.title: The Last Unicorn
titles.description: In this animated musical, the villainous King Haggard (Christopher Lee) plots to destroy all the world's unicorns. When a young unicorn (Mia Farrow) learns that she's in danger and that she may soon be the last of her kind, she leaves the safety of her protected forest and enlists the help of Schmendrick (Alan Arkin), a gentle, albeit clumsy, sorcerer. Together, they embark on a long and dangerous journey with one goal: to defeat Haggard and save the unicorns from extinction.

titles.title: The Last Will and Testament of Rosalind Leigh
titles.description: An antiques collector inherits his mother's house and discovers that her involvement with a mysterious cult of angel-worshipers may have led to her death.

titles.title: The Lawless Frontier
titles.description: The parents of John Tobin (John Wayne) have been murdered, and he wants justice. He sets out to find the killer, the evil gang leader Pandro Zanti (Earl Dwire), who hides from the law with disguises and almost kills old prospector Dusty (George Hayes) and his granddaughter. John rescues them and catches Zanti, only to face criminal charges from lawman Sheriff Williams (Jack Rockwell). Zanti is let go, and John must clear his name and establish who the real criminal is.

titles.description: The dynamic journey of Negro League baseball's triumphs and challenges is told through previously unearthed archival footage and interviews with legendary players.

titles.title: The Legendary Barry White
titles.description: Backed by The Love Unlimited Orchestra, Barry White performs his soul hits in a concert recorded in Belgium.

titles.title: The Librarian: Return to King Solomon's Mines
titles.description: An adventurer (Noah Wyle) and a brilliant archaeologist (Gabrielle Anwar) use a map to search for the fabled mines of King Solomon.

titles.title: The Librarians
titles.description: Cued by the popular "The Librarian" trilogy, this series introduces new members of an ancient group protecting mystical artifacts. Hidden below the Metropolitan Public Library, the secret society's longtime leader is Flynn Carsen, whose job has become very complicated. To help, the Library recruits Eve, a counterterrorism agent responsible for organizational security; Jacob, who has encyclopedic knowledge of art, architecture and history; Cassandra, who links auditory/sensory hallucinations to memory; and Ezekiel, a skilled thief and master technician. Overseeing them is Jenkins, the reclusive caretaker of the Library's sleepy little annex in Oregon. Noah Wyle executive produces and recurs as Flynn, the role he played in the movie series.

episodes.title: And the Apple of Discord
episodes.description: When the dragons sleeping beneath the earth threaten to awaken and wreak havoc around the world, Flynn returns to help find their hidden treasure.

episodes.title: And the Fables of Doom
episodes.description: The Librarians travel to a town where fairy tales are coming to life and attacking!

episodes.title: And the Rule of Three
episodes.description: The librarians are forced to intercede when a group of competitive high school students start undercutting each other with witchcraft.

episodes.title: The Librarians and the Heart of Darkness
episodes.description: The librarians encounter the house behind the legend of all haunted houses and set out to destroy it.

episodes.title: And the City of Light
episodes.description: An investigation into a missing person uncovers what appears to be an alien invasion in a small town.

episodes.title: And the Loom of Fate
episodes.description: When Dulaque changes the course of fate, Baird begins moving through alternate timelines that reveal the changing destinies of the librarians.

episodes.title: And the Drowned Book
episodes.description: Cued by the popular "The Librarian" trilogy, this series introduces new members of an ancient group protecting mystical artifacts. Hidden below the Metropolitan Public Library, the secret society's longtime leader is Flynn Carsen, whose job has become very complicated. To help, the Library recruits Eve, a counterterrorism agent responsible for organizational security; Jacob, who has encyclopedic knowledge of art, architecture and history; Cassandra, who links auditory/sensory hallucinations to memory; and Ezekiel, a skilled thief and master technician. Overseeing them is Jenkins, the reclusive caretaker of the Library's sleepy little annex in Oregon. Noah Wyle executive produces and recurs as Flynn, the role he played in the movie series.

episodes.title: And the Broken Staff
episodes.description: Prospero summons other fictionals in order to retrieve parts of his staff; the librarians find themselves pitted against Frankenstein's monster and Sherlock Holmes' nemesis Moriarty; Flynn and Baird have a disagreement.

episodes.title: And What Lies Beneath the Stones
episodes.description: Stone, Cassandra and Ezekiel team up to investigate a cave-in at an oil rig site which has unleashed a shape-shifting god who grows in strength when lies are told.

episodes.title: And the Cost of Education
episodes.description: When students begin disappearing at Wexler College, the librarians head out to investigate; Cassandra gets an offer that is difficult to turn down.

episodes.title: And the Hollow Men
episodes.description: Flynn is kidnapped by a mysterious stranger with both amnesia and a collection of the library's missing artifacts; the group pursues the Staff of Zarathustra.

episodes.title: And the Infernal Contract
episodes.description: Baird's old friend finds himself embroiled in a scandal in the form of a missing intern and a contract with the devil; Baird must battle for the souls of all the librarians.

episodes.title: And the Image of Image
episodes.description: When people begin suffering the effects of accidents and sins in which they have not been involved, the team tracks the connection to Dorian Gray.

This ultimately gets Jake shot and wounded, lands Jerry in jail unjustly and leaves the pair plotting to get revenge on the criminals.

titles.title: The Lylas
titles.description: Grammy winner Bruno Mars has taken the music industry by storm in recent years, and now his sisters -- Jaime, Tiara, Tahiti and Presley -- are looking to do the same. The ladies, collectively known as the Lylas, move from the sandy beaches of their native Hawaii to chase their dream of music stardom in the midst of the glitz and glamour of Los Angeles. But the road to the top is full of personal and professional obstacles, including the stresses of living and working together for the first time in years. The sisters' strong personalities mixed with the pressure of wanting to succeed test their ability to work together. Also complicating matters is the Lylas' early realization that they don't see eye to eye with their management team.

titles.title: The Making of the Mob: New York
titles.description: Emmy-winning actor Ray Liotta -- who starred as real-life gangster Henry Hill in Martin Scorsese's "GoodFellas" -- narrates an eight-part docudrama that traces the rise of organized crime in America. The series blends dramatic scenes, archival footage and visual effects to show how notorious wiseguys like Charles "Lucky" Luciano and Benjamin "Bugsy" Siegel transformed from neighborhood gang members in the early 1900s to murderous entrepreneurs and bootleggers. Included are exclusive interviews with former New York City Mayor Rudolph Giuliani, Meyer Lansky II, Chazz Palminteri, Drea de Matteo, Joe Mantegna, Frankie Valli, Mob attorney and former Las Vegas mayor Oscar Goodman, noted author and historian David Pietrusza, and many others.

titles.description: "The Osbournes" follows the day-to-day lives of Black Sabbath rocker Ozzy Osbourne, manager-wife Sharon and two of their children - volatile Jack and pink-tressed Kelly. During the show's run, the family "adopted" Rob, a friend of Jack and Kelly's. Needless to say, the Osbournes aren't your average family.

titles.title: The Osiris Child: Science Fiction Volume One
titles.description: A group of strangers must work together in a race against time to save a young girl -- and humanity itself.

titles.title: The Other Woman
titles.description: A woman (Natalie Portman) tries to mend her relationship with her stepson and deal with her husband's jealous ex-wife (Lisa Kudrow) while trying to come to terms with the loss of her newborn.

titles.title: The Outpost
titles.description: Talon is a survivor. The last of the Blackblood race, she also endured the destruction of her entire village by a gang of brutal missionaries. Years after that life-defining attack, she travels to a lawless fortress along the edge of the civilized world, tracking the individuals who killed her family. As she makes the journey, she discovers that she possesses a mysterious supernatural power that she must now learn to control, not only to save herself but to defend the world against the tyranny of a fanatical religious dictator.

titles.title: The Outsider
titles.description: A military contractor (Craig Fairbrass) arrives in Los Angeles to identify his daughter's body. When he discovers that it's not her, he begins an investigation to track her down.

titles.title: The Outsider
titles.description: A railroad worker unwittingly finds himself on the wrong side of a group of corrupt lawmen in the Old West. When tragedy forces him to seek justice, he soon sets out on a bloody quest for revenge to wipe out his ruthless enemies.

titles.title: The Over-the-Hill Gang
titles.description: Looking to reform the corrupt government of his Old West town, newspaperman Jeff Rose is running for mayor against officeholder Nard Lundy (Edward Andrews). Jeff's campaign lacks the incumbent's muscle and money, and his quest looks hopeless until the arrival of his father-in-law, Capt. Oren Hayes (Pat O'Brien). Joined by three fellow former Texas lawmen (Walter Brennan, Edgar Buchanan, Chill Wills), Oren and his daughter, Hannah, help Jeff fight back against his antagonist's dirty tactics.

titles.title: The Over-the-Hill Gang Rides Again
titles.description: Four retired Texas Rangers -- Nash Crawford (Walter Brennan), Jason Fitch (Edgar Buchanan), Amos Polk (Andy Devine), and Gentleman George Agnew (Chill Wills) -- leap to the aid of their old chum the Baltimore Kid (Fred Astaire). The Kid has become a hopeless drunk, and they aim to clean him up and install him as marshal of Waco, Texas. But in order to complete the job, the geriatric quartet will have to help the Kid defeat the outlaw gang that wants him dead.

titles.title: The Pack
titles.description: A farmer and his family have to fight for survival when a pack of wild dogs break into their home.

titles.title: The Painted Desert
titles.description: A tungsten miner (Bill Boyd) loves his father's rival's daughter (Helen Twelvetrees) and fights off her other suitor (Clark Gable).

titles.title: The Painted Hills
titles.description: A determined prospector, Jonathan Harvey (Paul Kelly) finds gold after years of searching. When he returns to town to tell his partner, Jonathan finds that his friend has died, leaving his son, Tommy (Gary Gray), on his own. While Jonathan's loyal collie, Lassie, stays with the boy, he goes to find help to assist him with his lucrative discovery. However, the new recruit (Bruce Cowling) proves to be a shady character, and before long the ruthless schemer has incurred the wrath of Lassie.

titles.title: The Pearl
titles.description: Closeted transgender women attend a conference that allows them to express their true identities.

titles.title: The Pentagon UFO Files
titles.description: After years of silence and secrecy, the U.S. government reveals possible evidence of extraterrestrial life, with analysis from scientific and military experts.

titles.title: The People's Court
titles.description: A judge hears small-claims cases in this series that served as a template for several similar courtroom series. The litigants in the case agree to drop their lawsuits and have the case heard on the show. Since the show is not a real courtroom, the decision is simply binding arbitration the litigants agree to abide by.

This masked presence is Erik, also known as the Phantom, a horribly disfigured recluse who lives underneath the Paris Opera House. When the Phantom takes Christine prisoner and demands her devotion and affection, her suitor, Vicomte Raoul de Chagny, sets out to rescue her.

titles.title: The Pitch
titles.description: From the same production company that helmed "Undercover Boss" and "Project Runway," and on the same network that houses the ultrapopular 1960s Madison Avenue ad drama "Mad Men," "The Pitch" documents what modern advertising firms go through in their attempts to secure new clients. Each episode follows two agencies as they manage high-level stakes and killer deadlines while preparing campaigns for actual brands, and then the agencies go head-to-head with presentations known in the advertising industry as "the pitch."

titles.title: The Possession
titles.description: When their youngest daughter, Em (Natasha Calis), becomes strangely obsessed with an antique wooden box bought from a yard sale, parents Clyde (Jeffrey Dean Morgan) and Stephanie (Kyra Sedgwick) see little cause for alarm. However, Em becomes increasingly unstable, leading the couple to fear the presence of a malevolent force. To their horror, Clyde and Stephanie learn that the box contains a dybbuk, a dislocated spirit that inhabits -- and ultimately devours -- a human host.

titles.title: The Postman Always Rings Twice
titles.description: Nick Smith (Cecil Kellaway), a middle-aged roadside diner owner, hires a drifter, Frank Chambers (John Garfield), to work at his restaurant. Frank quickly begins an affair with Nick's beautiful young wife, Cora (Lana Turner), and the two conspire to kill Nick and seize his assets. When they succeed, local prosecutor Kyle Sackett (Leon Ames) becomes suspicious, but is unable to build a solid case. However, the couple soon realizes that no misdeed ever goes truly unpunished.

titles.title: The Preppie Connection

titles.title: The Puppet Monster Massacre

titles.title: The Queen of Ireland

titles.title: The Raven
titles.description: A haunting-gothic noir adaptation of Edgar Allan Poe's famed poems "The Raven" and "Annabel Lee." In a 1940s dark and eerie setting, the story delves into Guy's descent into madness mere hours after the burial of his loved one, as he is tormented by supernatural encounters and memories of his lost love.

titles.title: The Ravine
titles.description: Inspired by a true story. An unthinkable tragedy rocks a tight-knit community, leaving survivors to navigate the darkness in search of understanding and solace.

titles.title: The Re-Inventors
titles.description: Over more than 500 years, tens of millions of patents for products have been issued, but some are lost to history, and most don't achieve the success of, say, the telephone. Hosts Matt Hunter and Jeremy MacPherson dig up some of those of yore to see how the ideas would fare in the modern world. The guys work with a team to examine original blueprints, build prototypes and test the inventions to see how well they work. Some that the hosts want to tackle are a submarine from the late 1500s, a 14th-century machine using wind power to propel a wagon, and a 1950s design combining a Ford Thunderbird with airplane parts to make a flying car.

titles.title: The Real Angelina
titles.description: Angelina Jolie is an Oscar-winning actress turned director and humanitarian. The actress has come a long way, from a bullied and troubled teenager to a movie star and one of the most influential women in Hollywood.

titles.title: The Real MVP: The Wanda Durant Story
titles.description: Wanda Pratt works tirelessly to raise three children, including future NBA basketball player Kevin Durant.

titles.title: The Red House
titles.description: Meg (Allene Roberts) lives with her adoptive parents, Pete (Edward G. Robinson) and Ellen Morgan (Judith Anderson). When Nath (Lon McCallister), a classmate of Meg's, comes to help on their farm, Pete repeatedly tells Meg and Nath to stay out of the surrounding woods. Out of curiosity, they disobey, and Pete is irate, subsequently hiring Teller (Rory Calhoun) to guard the woods. As Pete's rage devolves into madness, the kids start to discover the dark secrets that are buried in the nearby land.

titles.title: The Red Road
titles.description: The disappearance of a college student from a small town in New Jersey begins a series of events that forever changes the life of town Sheriff Harold Jensen. The investigation takes the officer into the neighboring mountains, where a federally unrecognized Native American tribe makes its home. Jensen eventually comes into contact with dangerous ex-con and tribe member Phillip Kopus, whose return to the college town raises suspicions and threatens to disrupt the peace. After a tragedy and cover-up further divides the town and the tribe, Kopus takes advantage, forcing Jensen to compromise his principles or risk destroying his family.

He plays an astronaut at a local fairground, but his father (Arthur O'Connell) wants him to be a real astronaut and lands him a place at NASA. On arrival, Roy discovers he's just a janitor, but he keeps up the charade, which eventually gets him fired. When NASA wants to send someone unqualified into orbit to one-up the Russians, however, they send Roy into space, where things invariably go wrong.

titles.title: The River Niger

Already struggling to make ends meet, Williams -- who rests his hopes on his son Jeff (Glynn Turman), an Air Force lieutenant -- grows more despondent when he learns his wife, Mattie (Cicely Tyson), has terminal cancer. Now, Williams must summon the depths of his spirit to overcome his family's plight.

titles.title: The Secret of Skinwalker Ranch
titles.description: Skinwalker Ranch and the surrounding area have been referred to as "UFO alley" since the 1950s when numerous anomalous events and strange activity began occurring. A team of scientists and experts conducts a thorough and daring search of the infamous 512-acre property in Utah's Uinta Basin in an attempt to find out the answers behind more than 200 years of UFO sightings, strange animal mutations, and paranormal related mysteries. Scientists use the latest in cutting-edge technology, like ground-penetrating radar and drones, to seek shocking discoveries.

episodes.description: The team runs a new test in the Mesa that produces loud and clear evidence of buried metallic objects; a new aerial experiment yields solid clues about a giant force field in the middle of Skinwalker Ranch.

episodes.title: Setting Boundaries
episodes.description: As the team begins a large-scale drilling operation to uncover a possible metal object in the Mesa, they launch a swarm of one hundred drones that reveals a major answer about the mystery of the Bubble.

episodes.title: Smoking Guns
episodes.description: After a new test deepens the mystery of the ceramics that were found in the Mesa, the team smokes out stunning new clues at the Triangle and along the boundary of the Bubble.

episodes.title: Home Sweet Homestead
episodes.description: The team encounters a series of mind-bending phenomena when a Navajo Shaman performs a sacred ritual at Homestead Two.

episodes.title: All Mesa'd Up
episodes.description: As the mystery deepens in the Mesa, the team makes a bewildering new discovery at the center of the Bubble.

episodes.title: High Voltage

episodes.title: Rocket Men
episodes.description: While investigating a region high above the Triangle with specialized rockets, the team makes a discovery that may explain the mysterious phenomena on Skinwalker Ranch.

episodes.title: Up in Smoke
episodes.description: As the team works to smoke out answers at Homestead Two, strange things appear at an unexpected area of the ranch.

episodes.title: The Twilight Zones
episodes.description: When the team looks for possible connections between two old decaying homesteads, they are surprised by what they discover.

episodes.title: On the Radar
episodes.description: The team uses Doppler radar to study the Bubble only to discover new, unexplained phenomena hiding in plain sight.

titles.title: The Serpent Queen
titles.description: "The Serpent Queen" is a cunning account of one of the most influential women ever to wear a crown: Catherine de' Medici; considered an immigrant, common and plain, de' Medici marries into the 16th century French court as an orphanedteenager, expected to bring a fortune in dowry and produce many heirs; she quickly discovers that her husband is in love with an older woman, her dowry is unpaid, and she is unable to conceive; yet, with only her intelligence and determination, she manages to keep her marriage alive and masters the bloodsport that is the monarchy better than anyone else, ruling France for 50 years.

titles.title: The Seven
titles.description: A group of students sets out to solve the mystery of how devil worshipers died in an unexplained fire that razed their mansion to the ground.

titles.title: The Shining
titles.description: Jack Torrance (Jack Nicholson) becomes winter caretaker at the isolated Overlook Hotel in Colorado, hoping to cure his writer's block. He settles in along with his wife, Wendy (Shelley Duvall), and his son, Danny (Danny Lloyd), who is plagued by psychic premonitions. As Jack's writing goes nowhere and Danny's visions become more disturbing, Jack discovers the hotel's dark secrets and begins to unravel into a homicidal maniac hell-bent on terrorizing his family.

titles.title: The Signal
titles.description: Mya (Anessa Ramsey) and Ben (Justin Welborn) are very much in love, but she cannot quite find the courage to leave her awful husband, Lewis (A.J. Bowen). However, when a mysterious transmission starts turning people, including Lewis, into murderous maniacs, the lovers must go on the run.

titles.title: The Silencers
titles.description: Veteran secret agent Matt Helm (Dean Martin) is living a life of luxury when his former lover, Tina Batori (Daliah Lavi), pulls him back into action. A sinister group known as the Big O has developed a plot to start a global nuclear conflict, so the carefree, womanizing Helm must stop the scheme of mastermind Tung-Tze (Victor Buono). Joining the suave Helm on his mission is the beautiful but inept operative Gail Hendricks (Stella Stevens), along with other gorgeous ladies.

titles.title: The Silver Star
titles.description: The old sheriff (Edgar Buchanan) handles three gunmen when the skittish new sheriff hides.

titles.title: The Sisters Brothers
titles.description: It's 1851, and Charlie and Eli Sisters are both brothers and assassins, boys grown to men in a savage and hostile world. The Sisters brothers find themselves on a journey through the Northwest, bringing them to the mountains of Oregon, a dangerous brothel in the small town of Mayfield, and eventually, the gold rush land of California -- an adventure that tests the deadly family ties that bind.

titles.title: The Sixth Secret
titles.description: At a late-night seance attended by 12 people, a medium announces that three secrets will be revealed before midnight. As bodies pile up, so do the secrets, leading to the darkest of them all.

titles.title: The Sleepwalker
titles.description: Tensions rise when a woman (Gitte Witt) receives an unexpected visit from her pregnant sister (Stephanie Ellis) and her fiancé (Brady Corbet).

titles.title: The Slumber Party Massacre
titles.description: Someone with a power drill shows up uninvited to Trish's (Michele Michaels) high-school pajama party.

titles.title: The Sorcerer and the White Snake
titles.description: A sorcerer (Jet Li) battles against a barrage of demon temptresses to save a man's soul from an ancient serpent that was brought to life and disguised as a woman.

titles.title: The Sound of Music
titles.description: A tuneful, heartwarming story, it is based on the real life story of the Von Trapp Family singers, one of the world's best-known concert groups in the era immediately preceding World War II. Julie Andrews plays the role of Maria, the tomboyish postulant at an Austrian abbey who becomes a governess in the home of a widowed naval captain with seven children, and brings a new love of life and music into the home.

titles.title: The Soviet Sleep Experiment
titles.description: In the late 1940s, Russian researchers keep four test patients awake for 30 days using an experimental gas-based stimulant. What starts as a purely scientific study quickly spirals out of control.

titles.title: The Spirit of Christmas
titles.description: With breathtaking scenery and images accompanied by some of your favorite Christmas songs, the joy of the season is brought to life.

titles.title: The Stairs
titles.description: Hikers in the woods stumble upon a mysterious staircase that leads them into a subterranean nightmare.

titles.title: The Standoff at Sparrow Creek
titles.description: After a mass shooting at a police funeral, reclusive ex-cop Gannon finds himself unwittingly forced out of retirement when he realizes that the killer belongs to the same militia he joined after quitting the force. Understanding that the shooting could set off a chain reaction of copycat violence across the country, Gannon quarantines his fellow militiamen in the remote lumber mill they call their headquarters. There, he sets about a series of interrogations, intent on ferreting out the killer.

titles.title: The Stanford Prison Experiment
titles.description: In 1971, Stanford's Professor Philip Zimbardo (Billy Crudup) conducts a controversial psychology experiment in which college students pretend to be either prisoners or guards, but the proceedings soon get out of hand.

titles.title: The Star Packer
titles.description: Loner U.S. Marshal John Travers (John Wayne) foils the hold-up of a stagecoach, rescuing young woman Anita Matlock (Verna Hillie) from the clutches of the crooks and helping her back to town. But there, the sheriff is gunned down by bandits, so Travers starts investigating and connects the murder to a gang, led by an unidentified bandit known as the Shadow, who's been running the town ragged for some time. Travers then makes it his mission to restore order to the town and bring down the Shadow.

titles.title: The Stendhal Syndrome
titles.description: A police detective falls under hallucinatory spells while trying to capture the sadistic man who raped her.

titles.title: The Stepfather
titles.description: Jerry Blake (Terry O'Quinn) is a family man, but he happens to have a series of families, with each one on the receiving end of his murderous ways. When Jerry sets his sights on a lovely widow named Susan (Shelley Hack) and her headstrong daughter, Stephanie (Jill Schoelen), it appears that his brutal pattern of killings will continue. However, Stephanie begins to suspect that there's something wrong with the seemingly well-adjusted Jerry, and a violent confrontation is inevitable.

titles.title: The Steve Wilkos Show
titles.description: The former Chicago cop and security guard of "The Jerry Springer Show" gets his own talk show that is adapted from the popular "Steve to the Rescue" shows he did while filling in for Springer. Wilkos says he hopes his show will provide him with a platform to stand up for everyday people and help viewers in need. Common topics include trying to confirm -- often using results of lie-detector tests -- whether guests abused or molested children. Steve also helps guests determine paternity and if guests are cheating on their partners. If Steve doesn't like the guests they might not last long on the show.

How do million-dollar birds procreate? What's the story behind a dog that ignited an international conflict? These are the strangest origin tales you've never heard-and won't believe!

episodes.title: Astonishing Beings
episodes.description: The world is full of creatures who make you look twice; from a baboon who becomes a reliable employee at a 19th-century train station, to a Moulin Rouge performer who builds a career on controlled flatulence, to a military combat unit of undeniably adorable pooches; these are the stories of beings so strange, so spectacular, they're unbelievable.

With the remnants of Langdon's squadron fleeing to Mexico, Thomas and his adopted Native American son, Blue Boy (Roman Gabriel), gather a herd of horses and head for the border with their company, to sell them. After Langdon's caravan is captured by a Mexican general (Tony Aguilar), Thomas nobly sacrifices the horses to free them.

episodes.title: Blue prints
episodes.description: 1978 Oklahoma: Fairbanks, Elsa and Theodosia confront Braxton Chamberland, the architect of the Darkland Amusement Park; Braxton shines a light on the cult's rise, Dexter's abusive behavior toward Theodosia and what led to the park's shuttering.

episodes.title: The Family Birchwood

Oklahoma, 1978: Obsessed with Dexter Venito, Tammy convinces her friends to break into the abandoned Darkland park; during a wild night, she dares them to perform a ritual in Dexter's name, unaware she holds the key to his return.

titles.title: The Unknown Girl

The next morning, she learns that the caller was a girl who has been found dead, and the police have no way of identifying her. Shocked and guilt-stricken by the news, Jenny resolves to discover the name of the girl so she will not be buried anonymously and to ensure she doesn't disappear as if she had never lived.

Fingers point at the village idiot, Herman Gleib (Dwight Frye), but after local vigilantes get him out of the picture, the killings continue. But that plan comes crashing down when Edward falls in love with Lancastrian commoner Elizabeth Woodville. A violent struggle for the crown ensues between Woodville, adversary Margaret Beaufort and Anne Neville, a pawn in her father's power game.

Together, Roy and Betty set out to prove her father was wrongly accused and track down the real criminal.

It revolves around Abe Woodhull, a young farmer torn between loyalty to his Tory background and respect for those who fight for the Patriot cause. Under the direction of Gen. Washington, Abe and his fellow agents help turn the war to the Continentals' favor, and their daring efforts ultimately serve as the foundation for modern espionage.

titles.title: Very Superstitious With George Lopez
titles.description: Stevie Wonder wrote a hit song about it, proclaiming that when you believe in things that you don't understand, "superstition ain't the way." But a reverence for trusting that such beliefs lead to certain consequences, however unfounded, has been practiced for centuries and endures to this day, whether it involves a fear of Friday the 13th, a rabbit's foot fending off evil, or crossing one's fingers for luck. Comic George Lopez is fascinated by the subject, having been raised in a very superstitious home in Mexico. After years of bad luck, Lopez hopes to tap what he learned as a boy by exploring the beliefs and rituals of others. On this series, he travels around the U.S. to meet various people who hold unusual beliefs and discover the role these superstitions play in their lives.

titles.description: The shocking allegations of assault and manipulation plaguing Harvey Weinstein for decades.

titles.title: Weirdsville
titles.description: Two stoners try to dump the body of a girlfriend who overdosed in an abandoned drive-in theater, and they run into a cult of Satanists performing a ritual sacrifice.

titles.title: Werewolf Rising
titles.description: Emma travels to her family's cabin in the Arkansas hills to get away from the city. After she settles in, she has to fight for her life when a werewolf begins slaughtering everything in its path.

titles.title: Werewolf Shadow
titles.description: While searching the countryside for the grave of supposed vampire Countess Wandesa Dárvula de Nadasdy (Barbara Capell), students Genevieve (Andres Resino) and Elvira (Gaby Fuchs) meet an amiable local named Daninsky (Paul Naschy) who offers to help them look. Not knowing he's a werewolf, they accept, and Daninsky leads them to the tomb where they accidentally revive the sleeping vampire. She attacks, and Daninsky and Elvira cooperate in trying to stop her -- falling in love in the process.

titles.title: Werewolves Within
titles.description: A snowstorm traps town residents together inside the local inn, where newly arrived forest ranger Finn and postal worker Cecily must try to keep the peace and uncover the truth behind a mysterious creature that has begun terrorizing the community.

titles.title: West of the Divide
titles.description: Cowpoke Ted Hayden (John Wayne) infiltrates a band of outlaws in order to get close to their ringleader, Mr. Gentry (Lloyd Whitlock) -- the man who murdered his father. Joining Hayden on his mission is his dim but devoted companion, Dusty (George "Gabby" Hayes). But their plan gets complicated when Hayden meets Fay (Virginia Brown Faire), the lovely daughter of rancher Fred Winters (Lafe McKee). Gentry is after the man's land, and he wants Hayden to kill him to get it.

titles.description: Henry Seed, a mysterious stranger, visits a town in South Dakota in 1899, where atrocities are committed against the Lakota people. Little Thunder, the tribe's spiritual leader, considers whether to seek revenge or to remain true to Lakota values.

titles.description: Whale researcher, Nan Hauserat, is in the Cook Islands to research humpback whales.

titles.title: Whale with Steve Backshall
titles.description: Naturalist Steve Backshall free dives into the world of whales, orcas, and dolphins as he explores their habitats, relationships, behaviors, and the threats faced by these mammals.

titles.title: What Breaks the Ice
titles.description: Two teenage girls from different worlds form an unlikely friendship in the sweltering summer heat of 1998, but their fun and carefree days turn cold when they find themselves at the center of a mysterious murder.

titles.title: What Just Happened?
titles.description: During the course of an ordinary week in Hollywood, movie producer Ben must navigate his way through shark-infested waters as he struggles to complete his latest projects. A demanding studio boss demands extensive changes to a movie starring Sean Penn, while another chief won't greenlight a project unless star Bruce Willis shaves his beard. Meanwhile, Ben tries to reconcile with his wife and maintain a relationship with his young daughter.

titles.title: What's Eating Dan?
titles.description: Dan Souza explores the science behind our favorite foods and shares tips and tricks that you can use in your own kitchen.

episodes.title: Eat Your Greens
episodes.description: Dan Souza explores the science behind our favorite foods and shares tips and tricks that you can use in your own kitchen.

episodes.title: Morning Routine
episodes.description: Dan reveals the science of cooking bacon, then makes homemade yogurt and the perfect chewy bagels.

episodes.title: More Sides, Please
episodes.description: Dan shares his go-to side dishes: roasted broccoli, Brussels sprouts, baked potatoes and dinner rolls.

titles.title: What's Love Got to Do With It
titles.description: Based on the life of the legendary soul singer, Tina Turner (Angela Bassett) -- born Anna Mae Bullock -- discovers her love of singing in her Tennessee church choir. She moves to St. Louis to pursue a career, and there she meets the charismatic Ike Turner (Laurence Fishburne), who rechristens her Tina and offers to help her succeed. As a musical team, Ike and Tina take the charts by storm. But as his physical abuse worsens, Tina has to make the tough decision to leave Ike and set out on her own.

titles.title: When a Stranger Calls
titles.description: A retired police detective hunts a deranged British seaman out to re-create a babysitter's horror.

titles.title: When Darkness Falls
titles.description: While trekking across the Highlands, Jess and Andrea separate and Andrea goes missing. Jess searches for her friend but stumbles into a far darker situation than she could possibly have imagined.

episodes.title: Hunters
episodes.description: Six kids work for a week at the head office of Hunters Estate agents in York; their responsibilities include running the Harrogate branch for an afternoon, marketing two new properties, running an open house and negotiating a property deal.

titles.title: When the Screaming Starts
titles.description: When Norman Graysmith is invited to the home of aspiring serial killer Aidan Mendle, he thinks he's found the subject of a documentary that will save his failing career.

titles.title: When You Finish Saving the World
titles.description: Evelyn and her oblivious son, Ziggy, seek out replacements for each other as Evelyn tries to parent an unassuming teenager at her shelter, while Ziggy fumbles through his pursuit of a brilliant young woman at school.

titles.title: Where God Left His Shoes
titles.description: Frank Diaz (John Leguizamo), an unemployed boxer, and his family live in a homeless shelter for months when, on Christmas Eve, word comes that an apartment may be available. The catch is that Frank must have a job before the end of the day. So he hits the cold streets of New York, his resentful stepson (David Castro) in tow, to find a job so that his family can have a real home for Christmas morning.

titles.title: Whistling Hills
titles.description: A gunman is hired by stage line owner Chet Norman to stop a series of stagecoach holdups that always take place when the driver, Pete, sees a mystery rider and hears the weird notes of a silver whistle.

titles.title: White Bird in a Blizzard
titles.description: A teenager (Shailene Woodley) relishes her newfound freedom after her disturbed mother (Eva Green) vanishes, but the strange facts of the disappearance soon begin to haunt her.

titles.title: White Comanche
titles.description: Half-white, half-Comanche twin brothers Johnny Moon (William Shatner) and Notah (also Shatner) have long been estranged, but things are even worse now that Notah is a bloodthirsty outlaw, and people mistake Johnny for him. Addicted to peyote, Notah believes himself destined to lead the Comanche to victory over the whites. Despite Johnny's pleas, his brother plans to destroy Rio Hondo, which is protected by Sheriff Logan (Joseph Cotten). Will Johnny side with the town or his brother?

titles.title: White God
titles.description: Failing in his efforts to find his beloved owner (Zsófia Psotta), an abandoned dog eventually joins a canine revolt against their human abusers.

titles.title: Whitey: United States of America v. James J. Bulger
titles.description: Filmmaker Joe Berlinger examines the story of South Boston crime boss Whitey Bulger, including his sensational trial. Key players on every side reveal Bulger's influence on crime and law enforcement.

titles.title: Whitney Cummings: Money Shot
titles.description: One of the funniest comics on television.

titles.description: We talk to those who knew Whitney as "Nippy", retrace her steps to stardom and revisit some of her most stunning performances.

titles.title: Whitney Houston: We will always love you
titles.description: Celebrating the singer's life and career; performances by Celine Dion, Jennifer Hudson, Usher, Yolanda Adams and CeCe Winans.

titles.title: Who Done It: The Clue Documentary
titles.description: Telling behind-the-scenes stories of 1985's "Clue," a cult classic loved by multiple generations. Includes an animated re-creation of the fourth ending, which is somewhere in the vaults of Paramount Pictures.

titles.title: Who Is Clark Rockefeller?
titles.description: German con artist Christian Karl Gerhartsreiter (Eric McCormack) poses as a member of the Rockefeller family.

titles.description: The filmmaker discusses the life and crimes of Takahiro Shiraishi, a Japanese serial killer who murdered nine people after luring them into his apartment.

titles.description: An examination of the conspiracy theories behind who assassinated John F. Kennedy.

titles.title: Whoopi Goldberg: The Winning Act
titles.description: A look at the life and career of Whoopi Goldberg, an award-winning comedian, actress and human rights advocate; she is one of the few 'EGOT' winners, having won the Emmy, Grammy, Oscar and Tony awards.

titles.description: The stories of hope, struggle and survival, and the incredible lengths animals will go to preserve themselves and the next generation.

titles.title: Wild West Chronicles
titles.description: Fearless lawmen and ruthless outlaws ride once more in this new docudrama series that chronicles the tall tales, little-known stories, and front-page headlines of the Wild West. Wild West Chronicles sets the record straight with personal accounts of the West's most notorious events directly from the mouths of the characters who lived through them. Viewers see what it was like to thrive and survive in the American West.

episodes.title: The Gold Rush Lawman
episodes.description: When failed prospector John Hicks Adams is elected sheriff of Santa Clara County, he must prove that he won't be a bust as a lawman too; just weeks into the job, his courage is tested when a band of stagecoach robbers begins terrorizing the area.

episodes.title: Last Shot at the OK Corral
episodes.description: Photographers C.S. and Mollie Fly open a studio next to a dusty corral in Tombstone, Ariz., and they end up taking the last shot of the Old West's most infamous gun battle, the shootout at the O.K. Corral.

episodes.title: Jim Roberts Cleans Up Jerome
episodes.description: In his first week on the job as the new constable of Jerome, Ariz., Jim Roberts gets to work arresting the town's troublemakers and teaching his timid deputy how to be a courageous lawman as they track down a stone-cold killer and his gang.

titles.title: Wild Wild Bunch
titles.description: Examine the razor-sharp claws, teeth and senses of these wild killing machines.

episodes.title: Armed and Deadly

titles.title: Wildlife
titles.description: Fourteen-year-old Joe is the only child of Jeanette and Jerry -- a housewife and a golf pro -- in a small town in the 1960s Montana. Nearby, an uncontrolled forest fire rages close to the Canadian border, and when Jerry loses his job -- and his sense of purpose -- he decides to join the cause of fighting the fire, leaving his wife and son to fend for themselves. Suddenly forced into the role of an adult, Joe witnesses his mother's struggle as she tries to keep her head above water.

titles.title: Wildlife Heroes
titles.description: Profiles of those who work tirelessly for nature and animals, thus saving lives and protecting natural areas.

titles.title: Wildling
titles.description: After a childhood in captivity under the care of a man who taught her to fear the outside world, a young woman sees her new freedom shattered by a series of unsettling events.

William & Kate: Raising a Royal Family

titles.title: William Lee Martin: Standing in the Middle
titles.description: The Texas comic talks about life, marriage, raising five children and living in a country that's in a constant state of flux.

titles.title: Willow Creek
titles.description: A man (Bryce Johnson) and his girlfriend (Alexie Gilmore) camp in the woods to capture firsthand evidence of Bigfoot.

titles.title: Willy Wonka and the Chocolate Factory
titles.description: The last of five coveted "golden tickets" falls into the hands of a sweet but very poor boy. He and his grandpa then get a tour of the strangest chocolate factory in the world. The owner leads five young winners on a thrilling and often dangerous tour of his factory.

titles.title: Winds of the Wasteland
titles.description: When the emergence of the telegraph makes their jobs as Pony Express riders obsolete, cowboys John Blair (John Wayne) and Larry Adams (Lane Chandler) hastily purchase a stagecoach line operating out of Crescent City, Calif., unaware that the place is essentially a ghost town. The congenial mayor, Rocky (Lew Kelly), convinces John to compete in a horse race against Drake (Douglas Cosgrove), the man who sold them the bum deal, for a coveted government contract in postal delivery.

titles.title: Winning of the West
titles.description: Muckraking newspaperman John Randolph (William Forrest), using information gleaned from his faithful printer, Smiley (Smiley Burnette), can expose powerful local businessmen Art Selby (Robert Livingston) and Clint Raybold (Gregg Barton) as the brains behind a series of thefts blamed on local Native Americans. Fiercely devoted ranger Gene Autry (Gene Autry) is assigned to protect Randolph, but his foes include his own outlaw brother, Jack (Richard Crane), who is working for Selby and Raybold.

titles.title: Wishmaster
titles.description: A gemologist (Tammy Lauren) unwittingly frees an evil genie (Andrew Divoff) that plays deadly tricks on her friends and acquaintances.

titles.title: Wishmaster 2: Evil Never Dies
titles.description: A thief, Morgana (Holly Fields), accidentally frees an ancient supernatural creature known as the Djinn (Andrew Divoff) from his bottle when she botches an art heist. The Djinn lets Morgana get away and takes responsibility for the crime. Now disguised as a human, the Djinn is arrested and sent to jail, which he relishes since he can now claim the souls of the prison population. On the outside, Morgana and a priest unite to re-bottle the Djinn for good.

titles.title: Wishmaster 3: Sword of Justice
titles.description: A college student (A.J. Cook) tries to stop an evil genie (John Novak) from granting deadly wishes to unsuspecting victims.

titles.title: Wishmaster 4: The Prophecy Fulfilled
titles.description: A genie must grant three wishes to a troubled woman (Tara Spencer-Nairn) in order to awaken his evil cohorts.

titles.title: Witchboard
titles.description: When Jim (Todd Allen) and Linda (Tawny Kitaen) decide to throw a party, Linda's ex-boyfriend -- and Jim's ex-friend -- Brandon (Stephen Nichols) brings out a Ouija board to contact a pleasant, childish spirit named David with whom he communicates often. Apparently, the lines get crossed, because they instead reach across the supernatural divide to the decidedly less pleasant Malfeitor, who uses his connection to the world of the living to wreak havoc and terrify his new acquaintances.

titles.title: Witchery
titles.description: A photographer and others are stranded at a Massachusetts island hotel which is haunted by a woman in black.

titles.title: Wolf
titles.description: An ex-con's (Marwan Kenzari) violent tendencies serve him well as he muscles his way up the ladders of the kickboxing and organized-crime underworlds.

titles.title: WolfCop
titles.description: An alcoholic cop blacks out and wakes up in unfamiliar surroundings, and crime scenes seem oddly familiar when the full moon is out.

titles.title: Wolves
titles.description: Anthony is a standout player on his Manhattan high school's basketball team with seemingly everything going for him: a killer three-point shot, a loving girlfriend, and a chance at a scholarship to Cornell. But Anthony's dreams of playing college ball are jeopardized by his volatile father, a hard-drinking writer whose compulsive gambling threatens to derail the lives of both his wife and son.

titles.title: Woman at War
titles.description: Halla is a 50-year-old environmental activist who crusades against the local aluminum industry in Iceland. As her actions grow bolder, her life changes in the blink of an eye when she's finally granted permission to adopt a girl from Ukraine.

titles.title: Woman Thou Art Loosed
titles.description: When Michelle is only 12 years old, she is raped by Reggie, the boyfriend of her mother. When her mother does not believe her accusations, Michelle runs away and begins a downward spiral that includes drugs and prostitution, eventually landing in prison. There she hears of Bishop T.D. Jakes (playing himself), a preacher who works with women like her. Jakes takes an interest in Michelle's case and visits her.

episodes.title: Ecuador's Hidden Treasure
episodes.description: Three female scientists investigate Ecuador's endangered spider monkeys and empower indigenous women in a scientific area usually dominated by men.

episodes.title: From The Lab To The Field
episodes.description: Dr Sheila Ochugboju takes her scientific knowledge to Kenya to turn parasitic problems into scientific solutions.

episodes.title: Kyrgyzstan's Space School
episodes.description: A defiant all-girls space-tech school aims to build Kyrgyzstan's first satellite, a country where girls are often kidnapped and forced to marry.

episodes.title: Problems
episodes.description: "The Monty Hall Problem" poses a counter-instinctive dilemma of picking a choice with a higher probability of winning; "The Birthday Problem" presents a situation that addresses brains' unintuitive response to exponents.

titles.title: Woodward Throwbacks
titles.description: Step into the world of reclaimed design, where every material carries a past. Bo and Kyle of Woodward Throwbacks source, restore and transform salvaged materials into one-of-a-kind furniture and spaces, uncovering the history embedded in each piece.

episodes.description: On the first floor, Bo and Kyle create a spectacular custom freestanding bar with a dramatic feature wall; combining Japanese craftsmanship with Detroit history, this one-of-a-kind bar transforms the past into a modern entertainment space.

episodes.title: Rust, Relics and Relaxation
episodes.description: Bo reveals the transformation of the Mystery on Mack's living room, where industrial history meets modern design; the team turns salvaged metal panels into a stunning feature wall framed by an elevator door from a historic Detroit building.

episodes.title: The Reclaimed Kitchen
episodes.description: Bo and Kyle transform their kitchen into an entertainment hub; centered around a custom 12-foot prep island built from salvaged Lincoln factory timbers and topped with soapstone, the room balances rich textures with local history.

episodes.title: Designed to Dine
episodes.description: Bo and Kyle build a 12-foot banquette clad in salvaged white oak parquet flooring, paired with an elm table and vintage restaurant chairs to create a dining nook; they start their largest project to date: designing a massive backyard oasis.

episodes.title: The Backyard Blueprint
episodes.description: Bo and Kyle take a trip to Michigan Tile & Marble, to source salvaged stone, pavers and granite remnants for their outdoor space; Bo maps out curved gravel pathways while Kyle pours the concrete pad for the future outdoor kitchen.

titles.title: Xploration DIY Sci
titles.description: The "don't try this at home" warning seen on some TV shows doesn't apply to this series, which encourages the discovery of scientific concepts through experiments that viewers can reproduce in their own homes. Science teacher Steve Spangler hosts the show, providing step-by-step demonstrations of the DIY experiments that help explain scientific principles. Among the experiments presented is one that gained Spangler fame, in which he showed what happens when a mint candy is dropped into a bottle of diet soda. On the show, he explains the "why" and "how" behind the experiment and what cause the soda to react with the candy.

titles.title: Xploration Earth 2050
titles.description: 2050 is still decades away, but what might the world be like in that year? What new technology will be available? Will robots be commonplace? Will space tourism thrive? "Xploration Earth 2050" investigates some of the questions. The host speaks with entrepreneurs whose businesses focus on futuristic ideas and products in automotive technology, consumer electronics and health care. Scientists, doctors and science-fiction writers also explore the questions posed. The show also looks at older sci-fi movies to see how many proposed ideas have come to fruition.

titles.title: Xploration Outer Space
titles.description: Americans have been fascinated by the cosmos for decades and rely on NASA to explore celestial bodies seen in the night sky to get a better idea of what is out there. In this series, former NASA employee Emily Calandrelli visits some of the agency's facilities, private companies and universities to speak with people knowledgeable about the topic to help "show off the coolest aspects of the space industry," to use her words. Technology, a potential manned mission to Mars and planetary tourism are some themes.

episodes.title: What Makes a Planet?
episodes.description: Americans have been fascinated by the cosmos for decades and rely on NASA to explore celestial bodies seen in the night sky to get a better idea of what is out there. In this series, former NASA employee Emily Calandrelli visits some of the agency's facilities, private companies and universities to speak with people knowledgeable about the topic to help "show off the coolest aspects of the space industry," to use her words. Technology, a potential manned mission to Mars and planetary tourism are some themes.

episodes.title: A Space Station for All
episodes.description: Experiments conducted on the International Space Station will benefit humans on Earth; the history of the I.S.S.; students communicate directly with astronauts.

episodes.title: Mars vs. the Moon
episodes.description: Whether NASA should explore Mars or the moon next.

episodes.title: Landing on Mars
episodes.description: NASA has been remarkably successful sending robots to Mars' surface; host Emily Calandrelli looks at the varied and ingenious methods used to land spacecraft on the red planet, starting with Pathfinder in 1997.

episodes.title: 2011: A Year of Space Odyssey
episodes.description: The year 2011 was remarkable, as NASA visited several planets, asteroids and comets; host Emily Calandrelli explores the amazing journeys of spacecraft that gathered spectacular images of Mercury, Jupiter and Mars.

episodes.title: Surviving in Deep Space
episodes.description: Host Emily Calandrelli looks at how surviving in deep space can become a reality; Lockheed Martin is designing a spacecraft, similar to a smaller International Space Station, in which astronauts can make a three-year trip to Mars and back.

episodes.title: Spectacular Space Views
episodes.description: The Hubble Space Telescope provides amazing insights into our universe, capturing stars forming and distant galaxies; host Emily Calandrelli looks at the incredible phenomena of our universe and our own planet's turbulent atmosphere.

episodes.title: Legends of Apollo
episodes.description: The accomplishments of astronauts Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin.

episodes.title: Space Myths
episodes.description: Emily debunks popular myths about our solar system and outer space.

episodes.title: Lost in Space
episodes.description: Emily explores spacecraft that have been lost in space.

episodes.title: Canadian Space Agency
episodes.description: Emily visits the Canadian Space Center in Quebec and examines their exceptional expertise in robotics.

episodes.title: Fun With the Sun
episodes.description: NASA's mission to send a spacecraft to the sun; a total solar eclipse; a man races homing pigeons.

episodes.title: Space Firsts
episodes.description: The first African-American woman in space; the first spacecraft to reach interstellar space.

episodes.title: Teaming up With NASA
episodes.description: Emily visits a company building a spacecraft that can deliver cargo to and from the International Space Station.

episodes.title: Students of Space
episodes.description: A Boy Scout troop sends an experiment to the International Space Station; a young girl wants to be the first astronaut on Mars.

titles.title: Xterminator and the AI Apocalypse
titles.description: The universe's most dangerous outlaw war machine, Xterminator, is finally apprehended while pulling an intergalactic bank heist.

titles.title: Yakuza Princess
titles.description: An orphan discovers she is the heiress to half of the Yakuza crime syndicate. Forging an uneasy alliance with an amnesiac stranger, the orphan must wage war against the other half of the syndicate who wants her dead.

titles.title: Yellow Dragon's Village
titles.description: A flat tire leads a group of campers to a secluded village where they encounter a homicidal cult looking for their next sacrifice.

titles.title: Yodelin' Kid From Pine Ridge
titles.description: Ranchers and turpentiners fight over a forest in Georgia. The ranchers want to clear the land so their cattle can have more room to graze, while the turpentiners want to save the trees for their sap. Meanwhile, rancher Gene leaves the area and joins a traveling Wild West show, and violence erupts between the two sides soon after. Gene returns two years later to find things in disarray and cattle rustler Len Parker fueling tensions and plotting his own land grab.

titles.title: Yoga Is: A Transformational Journey
titles.description: After losing her mother to cancer, a woman travels to India and back, meeting with and interviewing sought-after yoga teachers on their own path of transformation.

titles.title: Yonkers Joe
titles.description: Master cardsharp Yonkers Joe (Chazz Palminteri) has a silver tongue and a miraculous ability to take even the most seasoned of gamblers for a ride. As Joe and his new wife, Janice (Christine Lahti), plot to take a heavily monitored casino for millions, Joe's mentally disabled son, Junior (Thomas Guiry), is released from a state hospital. When father and son reconnect after years of painful separation, Joe finds himself in a disarming situation in which none of his signature tricks apply.

titles.title: You're All Gonna Die
titles.description: A group of social justice warriors, in a quest to free an innocent man, search an abandoned campground for a serial killer. All of them is picked off one by one until it comes down to last person against the killer.

titles.title: You're Invited
titles.description: Quick and Easy entertaining ideas for throwing a stylish get-together.

episodes.title: Brunch
episodes.description: Quick and Easy entertaining ideas for throwing a stylish get-together.

titles.title: Young Bill Hickok
titles.description: The frontier hero (Roy Rogers) sings and saves Civil War gold with his sidekick (George "Gabby" Hayes).

titles.title: Young Buffalo Bill
titles.description: Buffalo Bill (Roy Rogers) and the cavalry protect mining surveyors from Indians in New Mexico.

titles.title: Young Mr. Lincoln
titles.description: In this dramatized account of his early law career in Illinois, Abraham Lincoln (Henry Fonda) is born into a modest log cabin, where he is encouraged by his first love, Ann Rutledge (Pauline Moore), to pursue law. Following her tragic death, Lincoln establishes a law practice in Springfield, where he meets a young Mary Todd (Marjorie Weaver). Lincoln's law skills are put to the test when he takes on the difficult task of defending two brothers who have been accused of murder.

titles.title: Your Sister's Sister
titles.description: A man (Mark Duplass) falls into bed with his best friend's (Emily Blunt) sister (Rosemarie DeWitt), leading to an unexpected love triangle when his friend arrives the next day.

titles.title: Zappa
titles.description: An in-depth exploration of Frank Zappa's private life and his rich, often controversial musical career. Featuring unfettered access to the Zappa vault and a deep cache of archival footage.

titles.title: Zero Hour
titles.description: A young woman realizes she is being stalked and hunted by those responsible for her husband's death.

titles.title: Zombie
titles.description: A New York reporter (Ian McCulloch) follows a woman (Tisa Farrow) to an island where a doctor (Richard Johnson) faces an epidemic of the undead.

titles.title: Zombie at 17
titles.description: A 17-year-old girl begins exhibiting strange symptoms and realizes she's turning into a zombie. Desperate to find a cure, she turns to a loner who claims to be an expert in all things paranormal.

titles.title: Zorba the Greek
titles.description: Traveling to inspect an abandoned mine his father owns in Crete, English author Basil (Alan Bates) meets the exuberant peasant Zorba (Anthony Quinn) and invites him along when the older man claims he has mining experience. In Basil's father's old village, he finds himself attracted to a young widow (Irene Papas), and Zorba takes up with the woman who runs their hotel (Lila Kedrova). When things go wrong, Zorba teaches Basil how to enjoy life even under the most trying circumstances.

titles.title: Zulu Dawn
titles.description: Sir Henry Bartle Frere's vastly outnumbered garrison makes a stand against natives at Isandlwana in 1879.
